tei:titleStmt.tei:title: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/dbang chog chog
o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/dbang chog chog

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs smin byed dbang gi chu bo phyogs gcig tu drangs pa ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen las/ dbang chog chog khrigs dpe rnying gi skor phyogs bsgrigs bzhugs so/

oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab gter bdun cu'i 'jug sgo smin byed kyi/ /dbang chog chos bdag rig 'dzin brgyud pa yis/ /spel ba'i cha shas gang rnyed 'dir bsdus bya/ de la'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yab sras rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa/ gnam lcags chos sde'i smin byed dbang gi rim pa'i phyag bzhes lag len du bsdeb pa/ zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang sogs dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa'i dbang chog chog khrigs dpe rnying gi skor phyogs bsdus kyi them byang 'god pa la/ ka) khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po'i dbang mchog rdo rje spyi blugs/ kha) pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las/ snying po'i gtor dbang bskur ba'i tshul ye shes snying po/ ga) 'chi med yang gsang bcud dril gyi dbang mchog rdo rje snying po'i cod pan/ nga) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol gyi sta gon thar lam dkar po dang dngos gzhi dbang gi cho ga 'grigs chags su bkod pa/ ca) dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dbang chog ye shes me 'bar mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa phrin las me 'bar/ cha) rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur dang bcas pa 'chi med gter bum/ ja) nyer dgu pa zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las/ mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru/ nya) sum cu pa dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i las mtha' las byung ba'i sme brtsegs kyi byab khrus rgyud don rnam dag /ta) bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi dbang in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong bklag pas rnam grol ye shes drwa ba/ tha) byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun bklag chog tu bkod pa byad kyi sprin nag gzhom pa'i rdo rje'i 'thor rlung*/

bcas le tshan sa'i grangs ldan bzhugs pa lags so/ slar smras pa/ pad+ma bka' srol nye brgyud zab mo'i gter/ /brgya rtsa'i nang gses gnubs lugs gnam lcags srol/ /gter rnying cha shas 'bad pa'i phyogs bsdus byas/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // (ka) khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po'i dbang mchog rdo rje spyi blugs bzhugs so/ sku gsum ngo bo che mchog thod phreng rtsal/ /thugs rje'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bgrod pa bzhi yi 'jug sgo don gyi dbang*/ /spyi blugs kun khyab ye shes rdo rje bstan/ khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po sku lnga rigs 'dus kyi dbang bzhi'i chog khrigs rdo rje spyi blugs bstan pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid mthun gyi gnas su stegs bu rgya khyon ji ltar rigs pa la rdul tshon ras bris 'bru tshom sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i dbus su/ mañdzi'i khar rin po che'i bum pa chas ldan bcud kyis gtams pa'i steng du bhan+dha mtshan ldan bzang por bdud rtsis bkang ba dar dmar gyis kha bcad pa/ steng du me long dang man shel bzhag /sku tsaka rnams gnas so sor bkod/ 'og tu nya bo las phur btab pa 'jog

/byang shar du las bum/ mdun du sgrub gtor dang sman raka /rgyab tu zor gtor ji ltar bab par chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi mchod gtor/ khor yug tu phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor tshogs chad brtan rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang mngon par 'du byas la/ gsang sgrub kyi las gzhung bsrangs shing bstod pa'i mthar dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ /zhes se gol gtog / bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskul/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod cing mthu byin bsdus/ 'gro drug spyi dang bsgrub bya'i rgyud sbyangs te rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dbang bzhi thob par mos la bzlas par 'jug /grub mtshams su rnam bum la dmigs nas gzung thag 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥs phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas rtsa sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing gzung thag spos la/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur:

badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pa d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos la/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya rnams lan gsum re bzla/ thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: dung chu'i mchod yon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul la/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ /'dir spro na bdag 'jug blang bar gsungs kyang 'dir spros pa bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug par gsol ba gdab par gsungs pas/ dam ye'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin dbyer med du rtogs phyir/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/

zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ /slob ma 'jug pa'i gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes 'thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bka' gter srung ma spyi dang bye brag gi gsol kha rgyas par gtong*/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub gtor bsngo spyan 'dren yan grub nas tshogs mchod rlabs skong bshags bar/ phyi snod srid gsum sogs gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ bsgral bstab yan grub par bgyi'o/ /bdag 'jug bya na 'dir byed srol mchis/ dkyil 'khor yol bas sgrib/ gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub sogs 'don nas grol lo/ /gnyis pa dbang la 'jug pa'i thog mar slob bu rnams la khrus sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes chus: skal ldan slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la: gnas pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: bkru bar bgyi ste byang zhing dag gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ sarba bhu ta tri yaṃ dzaḥ zhes bgegs bkug bka' bsgo ba ni/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang*/ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya chos nyid don gyi bden pa'i mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la tshe rabs thog med nas byang chub kyi bgegs byed cing*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub zab mo thob pa la mi dbang bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bzang po 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig

hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dz+wa la ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ me ri'i gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rak+ṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rak+ṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rak+ṣa: tri shū la tsakra rak+ṣa: ram̐ dz+wa la tsakra rak+ṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rak+ṣa: de nas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ deng 'dir bka' gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang bla na med pa dbang drag rdo rje me 'bar gyi dbang gzhi zab mo'i snod rung du bya phyir/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa rnams yongs su 'bul snyam pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul te gnas la slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam chos zab mo gsan par bya snyam du thugs bskyed de gsan 'tshal/ de'ang lung las/ chos sgra sgrogs pa'i sgra thos sems can rnams/ /ngan song gnas grol nyan rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sgo gsum rnam par dag pas gsan dgos te/ lus kyi kun spyod g.yo 'gul dang bral ba ngag gi kun spyod brjod tshig dang bral ba/ yid kyi kun spyod rtog 'khrul gyi dbang du mi btang bar shes pa'i so btsugs te nyan dgos la/ lung las/ rtogs pa thams cad laigs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/

/bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsan bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ de'ang lha dang mi'i ston pa mnyam med shākya'i dbang po de nyid gzhi dbyings kun tu 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing rgya khyon blo 'das bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa khyab brdal gyi klong du/ ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i khrir ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid/ ye shes lnga'i rang rtsal chos nyid kyi rang sgra dang bcas te dus mnyam pa chen por bzhugs pa la/ thugs rjes lam gyi bye brag gdul bya'i zhing du rnam par rol pa'i sku'i snang ba rdo rje sems dpa' sogs ye shes kyi 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gdul bya'i shes rgyud du 'byung ba'i cha dang*/ dbyings kyi gzhi rnams brda sbyar ba'i chos theg pa rim dgu sogs bla med kyi don rgyud dpag tu med pa tshe lo grangs med nas brgya pa la thug gi bar du gsungs pa rnams/ byin rlabs brda'i ri mor gnas pa dbyings rang byung gi gsang mdzod chen po bskal pa ji srid du mi nub par bzhugs shing*/ de'i byin rlabs las 'bras bu sprul sku'i grub tshul ni/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas lha bu dam pa tog dkar po rang cag 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi ston par byon te mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis tshul du ma'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim par bskor te/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs shing*/ de'ang dbye na/ nyon mongs 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong*/ zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong*/ gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong*/ dug gsum cha snyoms 'dul ba la theg pa chen po sngags kyi sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs la/

bka' 'og ma sde snod gsum la sogs pa rgyu'i chos su 'du zhing*/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i 'khor rnams kyis thugs la mnga' ba las bstan pa'i gdul byar dgongs te bka' rnams po ti glegs bam gyi tshul du bsdus so/ /theg pa chen po ji ltar byung na/ lha klu mi yul du ston pa'i bka' bstsal ba/ rtsa ba'i sdud pa po rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon po sogs 'bum phrag bcu bzhi rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs bi ma sam bha wa'i ri la sogs par bka' bsdus mdzad/ gsang sngags ni/ o rgyan gyi yul grong khyer sham bha la'i yang thog tu rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi 'khor bcas bzhugs pa la/ dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po nyi zer la bzhon nas gshegs bzhud mdzad pa gzigs pas/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te kun la dris pa las/ dge slong gcig na re/ 'di ni shar phyogs bha ga la'i yul ri bo gangs can dang nye ba na/ chu bo skal ldan shān+ta'i 'gram/ drang srong ser skya'i bsti gnas dang mi ring ba na/ shākya zas gtsang gi sras po rgyal po don grub bya ba khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhig gis 'khor rnams la chos ston to/ /de'i dge slong rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams gshegs bzhud mdzad pa yin zhes skad pas rgyal po dad de/ bdag cag gi pho brang du byon nas chos ston par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab pas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen nas 'khor dang bcas pa gnas der byon te 'dod yon nye bar spang ba'i chos gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ lum+bi tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /wa skyes seṅger 'gyur yang sla/ /'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa ni/ /bcom ldan nam yang mi 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ ston pa nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur bzhengs te rgyal po'i pho brang yang gzhal med khang du byin gyis brlabs/

'khor nyan thos rnams kyang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs su byin gyis brlabs nas/ rgyal po dang btsun mo lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' yas pa bstan pas smin grol dus mnyam du gyur/ mthar gdos bcas kyi phung po 'od du yal te sangs rgyas/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos rnams gsang ba'i bdag pos bsdus te bde byed brtsegs pa'i mchod rten dang*/ steng 'og gnas chen grangs med pa la gter du sbas/ de nas ston pa nyid mya ngan las 'das khar 'khor rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i lan du bka' stsal pa/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /lo ni bzhi gsum bcu gnyis na/ /dha na ko sha'i pho brang du/ /nga las lhag pa'i pad 'byung 'byon/ /nga ni mngal skyes shākya'i gdung*/ khong ni brdzus skyes dri ma med/ /de phyir theg pa gsum gyis mtho/ khyed rnams mya ngan ma byed cig /nga yi bstan pa zab mo 'di/ /sangs rgyas dbang po de yis skyong*/ /'jig rten mun pa'i gling chen du/ /gsang sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /chos skyong nam mkha'i tshad dang mnyam/ khyed rnams mya ngan ma byed cig /ces lung bstan te dgongs pa chos dbyings bde ba chen po kun bzang yangs pa'i klong du thim pa la/ de'i ngang mdangs skye med shes rab tu dag pas rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bya/ 'gags med 'dod rgur bsgyur bas rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i rnam pa du mar shar ba las/ longs sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs rje ma 'gags par g.yos pa'i rtsal du shar ba/ rgya gar 'phags yul gyi nub phyogs o rgyan yul gyi lho nub rnga yab gling phran dang nye bar dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du/ pad+ma ge sar sdong po las rang byung brdzus skyes su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes/ mtshan yongs su grags pa skye 'chi bgres rgud 'das grongs sogs mi mnga' bar tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa/

gsung gi rig 'dzin sngags kyi bden pa grub pas lha ma srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba/ thugs rje'i rig pa ye shes kyi rtsal rdzogs pas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad ma lus par mkhyen pa/ yon tan dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas khams gsum dbang du bsdus shing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ phrin las thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas 'khor ba ma stongs bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas mi'i gzugs su byon pas gsol ba btab na byin rlabs dang thugs rje lhag par myur ba/ dpal chen he ru ka gsang ba'i bdag po nyid kyi thugs las sprul pas gsang sngags thams cad la mnga' brnyes shing las dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsung las sprul pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs su gyur pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i sku las sprul pas bstan pa 'di la ston pa'i rgyal tshab chen por grags pa/ sku che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa de nyid gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i gnas su srid pa gsum gyi bdud rigs log 'dren rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ thugs rdo rje dregs pa snying 'byin chen po'i dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ phyi nang 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams kyis tho 'tshams pas steng nam mkha' thog ser gyis bkang*/ 'og sa gzhi rlung dmar dang shwa rbud kyis bkang*/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs dang skad sna tshogs pa bsgrags/ de'i tshe rdo rje gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas thog ser phog pa rnams kyang nus pa nyams te sku la ma tshugs pas/ phyi'i 'byung ba 'khrugs par byas te yul thams cad du nad rims dmar bshal dang tre tre ho lhog yams dmar bshal nag po 'brum bu sogs bkra mi shis pa'i rtags ngan pa btang*/

yul bcud dang mi ldan pa'i rten 'brel ngan pa byas/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes dang rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi ḍāk+ki rnams mkha' la 'ja' lhags pa ltar byon te lung bstan pa/ e ma rang byung pad+ma 'byung : mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: ting 'dzin mi shigs go cha can: rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar sgyur mkhan: he ru ka dpal mchog la bstod: lha 'dre 'byung po mi min rigs: gdug rtsub che ba ru tra'i gzugs: smon lam ngan pa 'di rnams kyis: nyid la bar chad ma tshugs kyang : 'dzam gling kun la gnod par nges: 'phral du gnod dang phugs su phung : ci phyir rtswa phung 'og gi me: ma 'ongs dam sri kha dar bas: 'di nyid 'dul ba'i thugs dam bskul: nged cag rje yi grogs su mchis: zhes zhus pas gu ru'i zhal nas: skye med rig pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: gsang gsum mdzod kyi bdag nyid can: klong lnga gar sgyur sgeg pa'i gzugs: ye shes ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la bstod: skye med tshig la rjes yi rang : kho bo sems can don las med: bdag gis phrin las bskul ba'i tshe: mkha' 'gro rnams kyang dpung la bzhengs: zhes gsungs nas thugs mi g.yo ba'i ting 'dzin las bzhengs te: thugs dam gyi rgyud drag po bskul bas: stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kun yom zhing shin tu 'gul: de'i tshe 'og min rngam chen me ri 'bar ba'i klong : dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: khro rgyal drag po me phreng can gtso 'khor rnams stong khams tshwa tshwas khengs shing chu bur rdol ba ltar mdun du lhags so: de la gu ru nyid kyang dbyer med du thim: ye shes mkha' 'gro ma rnams las kyi khro maur gyur nas drag po'i yum dang phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs mo mdzad: de'i tshe drag po'i go cha khro tshogs dang bcas tai rdzu 'phrul gyis lam la zhugs nas ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mor byon: srid pa'i bya khyung sde lnga dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol te:

khyung la chibs nas bya khyung gi 'khor dang bcas te lho nub 'byung po 'tshogs pa'i gling du byon: 'byung po ma rungs pa'i rigs thams cad dam la btags: khrag 'thung 'byung po 'dul byed du grags: 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre ma rungs pa thams cad dbang du bsdus shing drag po'i rngam sgra las: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma khrag 'thung rgyal: 'jig rten dregs pa dbang du bsdus: lha 'dre ma rungs tshar yang gcod: skye med drag po'i hūm̐ sgra yis: bka' 'gal dam sri rdul du rlog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: om̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭ: dam sri mā ra ya gardza rbad bh+yoḥ zhes drag sngags btab pas dregs pa ma rungs pa rnams brgyal zhing rengs nas: dbang du bsdus te srog snying phul: de'i tshe drag po pad+ma khrag 'thung du grags: 'og klu'i yul du byon: klu srin ma rungs pa'i rigs thams cad dam la btags shing tshar bcad pas: drag po me 'bar khyung zhon du grags: de nas me ri 'bar bar byon: yul thams cad du drag sngags kyi char phab pas: 'go ba'i yams nad thams cad myur du zhi: 'jig rten du lo phyugs legs shing bkra shis par gyur: de'i tshe mtshan yang rdo rje me 'bar du grags: de nas rdzu 'phrul so sor bshigs te ye shes sprul pa'i khro bo rang sar thim: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang so sor gyur te zhus pa: rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru nyid bzhugs pa'i tshe: lha srin rnams kyis mi sdang bar 'gyur lags te: ma 'ongs pa'i dus su lha srin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs dang smon lam log pa'i dam sri rnams gdug 'drer skye zhing 'jig rten du yams nad sna tshogs dang : khyad par bdun drug nag po tre tre tar tar dang : lhog yams rgyug 'gyel sogs bcos thabs ma mchis pa'i nad rims dar: 'jig rten rnams la dmag 'khrug dang lo nyes 'byung : bde ba'i go skabs med: khyad par du rgyal 'gong gi dmag khrims dang dam sri nag po spun dgu dar:

bcos su med pa'i nad rigs 'byung ste mi thog 'bud: de'i tshe bsam gtan nyal chog lta bu'i gdams pa dang : dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa'i mtshon cha 'dra ba'i gdams pa gu rus gsung du gsol: nged rnams kyis gsang mdzod na yod pa'i man ngag kyang 'bul: zhes zhus pas/ ma hā gu ru thugs rab tu dgyes te ma 'ongs pa'i don du dmigs nas: bla ma drag po phrin las ltar sgrub pa'i gdams pa dang man ngag gi skor rnams dang : drag sngags me yi spu gri bzhi pa phul te gu rus brdar btab nas rin po che'i sgrom du bzhag ste rten rten 'brel lnga'i smon lam mdzad do: de lta bu'i srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i slob dpon chen po de nyid kyis o rgyan dang*/ rgya gar kha che bal po phan chad du lo sum stong tsam bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ khyad par o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ za hor gyi rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi rgyal khams thams cad chos la 'dus nas rgyal khams stong par grags/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan dang*/ na lan+d+ra'i gtsug lag rnams bcom pas slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas mu stegs kyi ston pa rnams tshar bcad/ log 'dren rnams chos la btsud pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la bka' drin zla med du mdzad/ de nas mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gangs can bod yul du spyan drangs te/ lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags nas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dben gnas dang ri brag rnams sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs/ theg pa mtha' dag gi chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor te gdul bya rnams smin grol du mdzad/ khyad par du'ang las can rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs thugs sras grub chen rnams la bka' dang gdams pa khyad par can dang*/ dran pa mi brjed pa'i snying po'i gzungs bzhi/ gsang ba'i gter lnga/

rten 'brel gyi shog ser mi 'dra ba brgya dang so lnga/ ri mo'i brda rtags sa ya ther 'bum/ gter sgrom gyi rnam dbye bco lnga/ rgya rtags kyi ri mo stong dang rtsa gnyis/ gter gnas kyi khyad 'phags 'bum phrag dang ther 'bum/ bka' bab kyi rnam dbye stong dang brgyad brgya/ dus bab kyi lung bstan brgya dang so lnga/ dag snang gi mdzad tshul khri dang 'bum phrag kha byang gi bab tshul khri dang sa ya/ gter gyi mtshan nyid dung phyur dang sa ya/ 'bebs lugs kyi rnam dbye bcu drug /gter ston gyi mtshan nyid so bdun/ gter gdan 'dren pa'i dus sa rtags dus tshod 'dul zhing*/ snod dang rten 'brel brtag pa bzhi bcu/ gzungs ma grogs kyi rnam dbye so bdun sogs legs par gsungs shing*/ mchod gter rdzas gter yab gter yum gter la sogs pa'i gter kha rgya bod gling bzhi'i sa 'og sa steng sa bla thams cad du 'khor ba ma stong gi bar mi 'dzad pa'i gter kha mtha' yas pa sbas shing*/ rjes 'brangs nyer lnga rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ chos thams cad kyi bka' gtad cing gter bdag srung ma dang las 'phro mi nyams pa'i tha tshig sbrel/ khyad par du'ang gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mor gu ru rin po ches dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro stong gi tshogs la gsang sngags bla med kyi chos 'khor rgya chen bskor zhing thugs sgrub sku lnga rigs 'dus dang*/ yang gsang rdo rje me 'bar gyi gter sgrom zhal phye ba mdzad pas/ bod yul kun du 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang phub/ gzho stod lung pa dri bzang gis khyab/ me tog gi char dpag tu med pa babs/ gsang ba'i brda'i yig 'bru re re la mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde dngos su byon/ de'i tshe jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal phul zhing tshogs 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba'i tshe/ mkha' spyod dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams til gyis gong bu ltar byon te gu ru yab yum la gsang rgyud gzhan la med pa'i mkha' 'gro'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa lnga gnang ba las/

gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i yi ge brda rtags khyad par can phal cher gu ru rin po ches zangs mdog dpal rir gdan drangs/ khag cig bod gangs can gyi ri bo ka ma la'i lho nub tu rgya rim pa bdun dang bcas te sbas/ khyad par gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi smin grol bskyed rdzogs gdams pa cha lag dang bcas pa mtsho rgyal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda bsgyur gyi yi ger btab nas gu rus rab tu gnas par mdzad/ phyi rabs kyi don du rgya rim pa gsum dang bcas nas ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong gi gter phug tu mi snang bar rgyas btab ste bzhugs su gsol/ 'dul zhing dang dgos ched dus bab kyi lung bstan pa yang*/ gzhung las/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i snyan brgyud zab rgya can: yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje me 'bar bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi mtha' ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags 'dzin tsam: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yis rkyen byas stong khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya can: bla ma drag por sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i gzugs: tshig nyung don che yang zab snying gi chos: yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: mtshan skar mang yang nyin mo'i skar ma gcig: me tog mang yang u dum wā ra gcig: saims can mang yang sa bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig: sgrub skor mang yang snying gi thig le gcig: zab rgya mang yang gnad kyi gzer bu gcig: de phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma gtogs par: yang gsang gcig dril 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed ri mor gzugs: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la:

pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: las kyi ma sring mkha' 'gros rgya 'di srungs: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor cig: dus drug ma yengs bya ra lhang lhang gyis: zhes lung bstan cing smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ 'dul zhing dang smon lam gzhan yid tshim par mdzad/ jo mo mtsho rgyal chos kyi mjug bsdu ba'i phyir bsrings gu ru rin po che'i sku dngos kyis gdul bya de tsam du dgongs nas: lho nub rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon la gshegs te da lta'i bar du skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral ba'i ngang rdo rje'i sku ru dngos su bzhugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bka' gsang zab mo gter gyi ring lugs la'ang dbye na/ dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu: shar gter 'dril ba sdong po lta bu: lho gter gyes pa yal ga lta bu: nub gter gsal ba me tog lta bu: byang gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bu las/ da lam 'di ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba'i skor du gtogs pa yin/ de'ang phyi gtair nang gter gsang gter yang gter ma ning gi gter la sogs pa'i gter gyi rim pa bco brgyad yod pa las/ 'di gsang gter yin pa'i tshul mdo tsam smos na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku yi sprul pa gnubs chen sangs rgyas yai shes/ dum rgya zhang khrom/ gnam lcags me 'bar sogs/ zab mo'i gter ston rim brgyud du byon pa las/ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skyabs mchog sa gsum na 'gran zla ma mchis pa/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod 'bangs phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par ched du bsngags par mdzad pa rdo rje'i lung du grub pa ni/ yang gsang gnad kyi zhal gdams las: dus mtha' sum cu kha ral nyi shur nye: mi rnams rang phung dug lnga spyod pa'i dus: sa gter mi thub gter ston mang 'byung zhing : sangs rgyas bstan pa dbus nub mtha' bzhis rtsod:

dam chos gsang sngags dkyil 'khor chu la 'dor: so skye bdud sprul dbus gtsang khrag mtsho bskyil: phyi nang grub mthas dbus su mi skad rdib: chos rgyal gdung rgyud mtha' bzhi'i 'dul zhing 'byung : steng 'khrugs 'og 'khrugs lha srin rnams kyang 'khrugs: mtha' bzhi 'khrugs nas 'dre rgod yul la chags: mi rnams stod smad rgya hor dmag gis 'ded: rong chen bzhi la bros pa'i gab ri 'tshol: bod khams mi rnams lho mon rong la bros: nor rnams dgra yis za zhing hab sha spyod: zog po khrims ral dam nyams lung pa khengs: tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: sum cu kha ral nyi shu la nye ba'i: ma 'ongs dus su chos brgyud mtha' skyong ba: da lta'i dpal chen ye shes mchog khyod kyi: skye ba 'khrul med mdo khams phyogs su 'byung : rgyal khams rngam sgra nag po yul gyi ming : bya nag gshog rdeb gcan gzan ngar ba'i rong : rtsi shing mdung rtse gzengs pa lta bu'i tshal: yab yum gshed gzhi zhe sdang lo 'dzin pa: shes rab blo ldan zab gsang las sad pa'i: lus la brda rtags sha mtshan ri mo ni: drag po'i rtags rgya spyi gtsug me ris brgyan: rgyud smin dbang rtags so zho tshe bum ldan: stong nyid don ldan snying khar sme bas brgyan: tshigs rnams pad+ma brda ni shes rab ldan: gsang bar hūm̐ mthing karma las 'brel gling : mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang : ma ngais brtul zhugs smyon pa lta bur spyod: phyogs med 'gro don rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: ti sgro g.ya' lung brag gsum nas bzung ste: rong chen lnga yi zab gter rtags bdun dbang : bka' gsang shog dril bdun bcu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhi blang zhing phab nas yang gter sbos: gsang ba'i bka' rgya bka' srung drag por gtod: dam rdzas byin rlabs phabs rgyun ma gtogs pa: dhū tir bskyil la smon lam bzang po thob: rten 'brel dus kyi smon lam ma gtogs pa:

lo bcu'i bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis: dus kyi sa rtags thams cad shar ba'i tshe: smin grol dus bab 'gro don dus der che: rdzogs mtha' chos kyi smin grol byang chub myur: de nas yang 'phos nga yi drung du 'ong : zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba mnyam med rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje bdud 'dul las rab rtsal sogs gsang mtshan dgu dang ldan pa de nyid thog mar sku bltams pa'i yul spa rong sa'i lte bar rigs ni dbang chen/ rus ni rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung la shing pho khyi'i lor sku bltams/ skyes mchog de nyid chung byis pa'i dus nas sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa'i mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing dgung lo lnga'i tshe nas rmi lam dang mngon sum rnams la slob dpon dang mtsho rgyal gyis chos gsungs lung bstan pa dbang bskur ba sogs gzigs snang du ma 'char zhing*/ bka' gter srung ma rnams kyis kyang rogs dan phrin las sgrub pa sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las bsgrub pa'i dam bca' dang srog snying phul/ de nas rim par kha byang gi dngos grub thob nas shing pho rta'i lo nas dbu bzung ste gsang gter dang khrom gter sum cu rtsa dgu spyan 'dren par mdzad pa las/ khyad par du gyur pa gsang chen bla na med pa 'di nyid zab gter nas gdan drangs tshul mdo tsam zhig smos na/ me pho spre'u lo'i rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mor sbas tshul gyis sku bskyod de: dbang drag me phreng rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor du ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma dbang du bsdus shing tshogs 'khor gyis mchod de tha tshig bsgrags pas/ mngon sum du snang ba gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs shing*/ dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i rang gzugs bstan te phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang gi bar khang la gdan drangs te/

ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong gi 'dabs nas zab gter gyi rgya bkrol cing*/ brda rtags lung gi shog dril dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i sku tshab gsang ba ye shes/ myong grol a ma'i ril bu sogs phyag tu phul ba'i tshe/ sku lus dang phyogs mtshams kyi yul ma lus pa 'ja' 'od zang thal thig le'i klong du sku dang zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang dgongs pa nam mkha' bzhin 'byams klas par gyur/ de nub thugs nyams dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i snang bar dri bzang gis lung pa khyab pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra du ma sgrogs pa dang bcas mkha' 'gro sde lngas rnga yab gling du gdan drangs pa las/ rak+sha gling drug byang gi gling du rig 'dzin rom+bu gu h+yas drag sngags dregs pa'i srog thig yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur zhing lung bstan/ de nas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang 'og mar gu ru rak+sha thod phreng gis rgyud sde rgya tsho'i brda rtags lung gi dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur te gsang mtshan la rdo rje bdud 'dul las rab rtsal du gsol/ de nas bar khang rnga yab mngon dga'i zhing du rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs grub thob rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa nyams mgur gyi dbyangs la bskyon te gsang ba brda'i sgo nas byin gyis brlabs/ de'i steng khang rnga yab stug po bkod du gu ru drag po ging chen 'bum phrag dang bcas pa'i 'phro 'du rol pa'i rtsal gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas yang thog pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyis dgongs brda brgyud kyi gter rgya'i lde mig dang*/ dmod las drag po'i sgrol dbang*/ he ru ka'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i chas dbang rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thab spyi blugs kyi dbang sogs bskur nas phrin las kyi rtsal chen gu ru nyid dang dbyer med pa'i dgongs pa mdzad/ lung bstan smon lam bkra shis bden tshig gis rab tu gnas shing*/ gzhan yang de'i rtse mor lta na sdug pa'i zhing du dga' rab dgyes pa rdo rjer mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba dang*/

rtse mo rgya phub kyi tog la 'og min gyi zhing khams 'ja' 'od lug rgyud mched pa'i klong du kun bzang yab yum nyi zla kha sbyor tsam gyi 'od 'phro ba'i zil mi bzod pa lta bu'i ngang dgongs pa chos dbyings su brdal zhing rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob/ de sogs rnga yab gling gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dam pa de nyid kyi rnam thar du gsal ba ltar lags shing*/ de ltar zab gter spyan drangs nas lo drug gi thog lcags mo glang nas dbu bzung ste gsang rgya bkrol zhing*/ chu mo glang lo yan chad du mkha' 'gro'i brda yig nyi shu rtsa gcig las/ bod yig sum bcu'i ka sder bsgyur te 'jug don gtad rgya dang bcas pa rdzogs par gtan la phab nas zab gsang chos kyi bdag po rnams dang*/ khyad par 'od gsal thugs rgyud kyi bka' bab 'dzin pa thugs mchog rdo rje la bka' lung gtad rgya dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bstsal cing*/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i dgongs gsang srog rgyud thugs thig mi nub par skyong ba'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ dam pa de nyid nas rim par smin grol gyi gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa kho bo cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bar la gang zag rtog ges bslad ma zhugs/ snyan brgyud kyi man ngag zam ma chad/ brda brgyud kyi phyag khrid gnad ma 'chug /byin rlabs kyi chu bo'i rgyun ma chad/ lung bstan gyi rten 'brel sa mtshams ma log /gtad rgya'i bka' lung don brgyud dang ldan pa'i yid ches shing khungs btsun pa yin te/ gu ru'i lung las/ gter la brgyud pa bdun dang ldan: dang po rgyal ba dgongs brgyud ni: kun bzang rdor 'chang o rgyan gyis: ma 'ongs 'gro 'dren sprul pa'i sku: gter ston de la dgongs pa gtad: gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda brgyud ni: gter yig rnams ni mkha' 'gro'i brda:

rdo rje'i dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi: phyag gis brda ru nges par bstan: gsum pa snyan khungs brgyud pa ni: chos kyi sku yis longs skur dgongs: longs skus pad 'byung bdag la bstan: bdag gis gter 'byin de nyid la: dngos nyams rmi lam lag khrid ston: bzhi pa mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud: chos 'di gter du sbas pa'i dus: mkha' 'gro ma la gtad pa dang : 'byin pa'i dus bab gter ston la: ḍāk+kis dngos su gtad pa'o: lnga pa smon lam dbang bskur brgyud: rim par smon lam rgyas btab ste: ma 'ongs bskal pa 'di tsam du: 'gro ba'i don du nus pa yi: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: ces pa'i smon lam bka' rgyas btab: drug pa byin rlabs gter gyi brgyud: gter nas gter du brgyud cing sbas: thugs rje zag med mdzod klong rdol: bdun pa shog ser tshig gi brgyud: me shog chu shog sa shog dang : rlung shog nam mkha'i shog bu sogs: rten 'brel gter shog brgya so lnga: brda rtags sa ya ther 'bum bcas: gzhi ni ro gcig lam brda'i chos: tshad ni shog ser don ni gter: gsang sngags 'dus pa rnam bzhi zhes: brda bzhi'i rten 'brel mngon phyung ba: dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhi: yongs su tshang bas spro ba bskyed: ces gsungs shing*/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi brda brgyud las kyang*/ gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /lo rgyus don gyis ma brjod na/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /de phyir lo rgyus brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos la/ smin byed kyi dbang grol byed kyi khrid rgyab rten gyi lung dang bcas pa mchis pa las/ 'dir 'chad pa'i skabs su bab pa ni smin byed kyi dbang yin te/ klong gsal las/ sems la chos nyid gnas gyur kyang*/ /dbang gis smin par ma byas na/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub ga la thob/ /ces so/ de la 'dir dbang thob pa'i phan yon/

ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas skabs grol byed kyi gdams pa zab mo gdab pa'i snod du rung zhing*/ mthar thug sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid phrin las bzhi rdzogs kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin te/ rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud las/ gang zhig dbang bskur 'dzin pa yi/ /sangs rgyas sku la 'di yis reg /'di la skyes bus dbang thob na/ /rig pa'i sku la rang dbang thob/ /ces dang*/ snying gi me long gi rgyud las kyang*/ dbang rnams rab tu thob byas na/ /gsang sngags thams cad ma bsgrubs 'grub/ /ces so/ /dbang tshul bzhin ma thob par ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa las sbyor sogs bgyis pa'i skal ba nges par mi ldan la/ der ma zad gsang sngags kyi rgyud tshig zab mo klog pa dang*/ phrin las tshig shar du gyer ba la'ang mi dbang ste/ kṛ ya dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ gang zhig gsang sngags dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil mkhor la ni ma zhugs dang*/ /gang dag byang chub sems dang mi ldan par/ /de yis gsang sngags bklag na phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ phyag chen thig le kha sbyor las/ dbang ma thob la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir bar mar med bzhin/ /de bas dbang bskur dam pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pas blang bar bya/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa la/ de lta bu'i dbang de nyid ji ltar bskur na/ klong gsal las/ skyabs 'gro thun mong nas brtsams te/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon dang slob mas bgyi 'os gnyis las/ sngon 'gro yo byad bsham bkod/ sgrub bzlas gnang ba zhu ba sogs slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub nas slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ thog mar sngon 'gro la thun mong dang khyad par gnyis kyi/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro ni lung las/ mir skye ba yang shin tu dka' ba nyid/

/grogs po gang dag dad dang chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal ba brgyar yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ zhes pas/ rang cag rnams skye bar dka' ba lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling du skyes/ thob par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin chen thob/ mjal bar dka' ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par bya dgos shing*/ gal te ma thob na mi lus thob kyang stong log yin par blo gros mi zad mdo las/ skye ba mang po thob gyur cing*/ /yun ring bar du bed spyad kyang*/ /chom pos 'phrog pa ji bzhin du/ /sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ de ltar na thabs ji lta bu zhig 'bad snyam na/ theg chen sngags kyi nye lam du zhugs nas bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab mo lhur blangs te tshe gcig la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de la khyad par gyi sngon 'gro skyabs sems sdom pa bzung ba rnams yin te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la lha dang bla ma dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen mthing gsal longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo dril bsnol te 'dzin pa/ snang la rang bzhin ma grub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs klong zab gsal nyag gcig tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed dman pa rnams theg chen byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang*/ spang blang gi chos thams cad blo bral stong gsal mnyam yangs chen por sdom zhing ye bsrungs chen por gzhol bar bgyid snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ

byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom:

zhes lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung : de ltar phyi so thar gyi skyabs 'gro /nang gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod pa bzhin srung dgos te/ dpal mchog las/ sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi gnas/ /de bsrungs dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces pas sdom gsum gyi spang blang mtshan ma thams cad rang grol ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bar chig chod du srung ba thabs kyi sgo zab pa'o/ /de ltar skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ rang nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo 'gro ba kun gyi dad dpon mchog tu gyur par bsams la/ dngos gzhi dbang gi slad du slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ kyai: rdo rje rgyal po rigs kyi gtso: dkyil 'khor kun gzhi mnga' bdag nyid: deng 'dir yang gsang dkyil 'khor 'dir: skal ldan las can 'jug par stsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: sgom sgrub snying po len nus sam: skal ldan yin na dbang mchog sbyin: skal med rnams la mi bstan no: zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bdag ni skal ldan dam tshig can: dkyil 'khor sgom sgrub snying po len: lus dang ngag gus mos blo brtan: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi bsres pa'i dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: khyed rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: las can bu la dbang mchog sbyin: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs thob: a mṛ ta sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig: ces bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar rtsa ba yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi btang bar yongs su bzung bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan ta na ra kan: zhes lan gsum/

de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams tha mal a 'thas kyi blo ngor dbang bskur ba'i yul min te/ dag pa ye shes chen po'i lha skur sbyang dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis bsang sbyangs la/ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas par mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las snod kyi 'jig rten e mthing nag gru gsum me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis 'jigs byed pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje dang dang me dpung*/ g.yon gsum thod khrag dang lcags sdig sbrul zhags 'dzin cing*/ shin tu khros pa'i dbu la bya khyung rigs lngas brgyan pa dur khrod dpal chas thams cad rdzogs shing sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs pa/ zhabs bzhi gyad dor gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi bya khyung mthing nag me gshog can brdzis pa/ yum mchog gsang bdag gtum mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ yab yum me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ gzhan yang phrin las bzhi'i lha tshogs/ phyogs bzhi ging chen dpa' bo yab yum/ mtshams bzhir rigs bzhi'i khyung chen/ sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul dpag tu med pas bskor bar gsal ba'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros shing slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog te thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad dbang drag rdo rje me 'bar gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar spyan drangs/

de'ang sku che ba rnams ri rab tsam/ chung ba rnams yungs 'bru tsam/ bar pa rnams rang gi lus kyi bong tshad tsam/ snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs drag dang bcas byon te/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim pas sku che ba yan lag rags pa nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar 'bar ba'i/ snang srid kun na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i skur mngon sum du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la byin dbab kyi rdzas bsregs shing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub yul: rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang nas: che btsan rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: laṅka mgrin bcu'i kha gnon mdzad: gdong dmar srin po dam la btags: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad: rje btsun de yi rjes 'jug phyir: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: drag po'i pho brang dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur: 'gyur med sku yi pho brang nas: bskyed rim stobs bcus byin gyis rlobs: 'gags med gsung gi sgo phyes la: tshangs dbyangs drug cus byin gyis rlobs: 'khrul med thugs kyi sgo phyes la: ye shes chen pos byin gyis rlobs: yon tan brgyad khri'i sgo phyes la: myang 'das chos kyis byin gyis rlobs: phrin las sna tshogs sgo phyes la: mchog thun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de ltar ye shes lha yi tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas sku bskyod la: rang bzhin dbyings su rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: thugs rje'i dbyings nas 'gro don du: dbang drag lha tshogs bdag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes ye shes pa dbab/ de ltar dam tshig sprul sku'i lha dang ye shes longs sku'i lha tshogs dbyings rig zab gsal gyi chos skur dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya phyir/

sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes gnas lngar rgya gram bya/ de nas khyad par gyi dbang bzhi'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ che mchog drag po rigs kyi bdag: dbang drag pad+ma he ru ka'i: dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi deng 'dir stsol: sgo gsum bskyed rdzogs ngang la gnas: lan gsum/ de nas dngos gzhi khyad par gyi dbang ni: seṅge rtsal rdzogs las/ dbang la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*/ /de bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi sprul sku bum pa'i dbang*/ nang longs sku rlung gi dbang*/ gsang ba chos sku thig le'i dbang : de kho na nyid rig rtsal brda'i dbang dang bzhi las: dang po la'ang phyi'i dri ma 'khrud par byed pa bum dbang*/ nang gi nus pa 'jug par byed pa lha sngags rig pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba skal pa ster bar byed pa rdzas dbang*/ de kho na nyid phrin las sgrub par byed pa sgrol dbang dang bzhi las/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du khrag 'thung khro rgyal yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ bum pa spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐:

skye med bum pa drag po'i mkha': bdud rtsi pad+ma he ru kaḥ yab yum gnyis med dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti muṃ ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum chu blud/ kha rgyan yal 'dab kyis spyi bor chu blug cing*/ de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa de la sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing*/ bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs du ma dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal paur mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: gnyis pa nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang gsum las/ thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur la/ khyed rang rnams kyang sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa la de ltar yin pa'i nges shes bskyed la/ slob dpon yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos su mos pa bskyed/ 'og min gyi zhing rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyi khro tshogs grangs med 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sku 'bag spyi bor bskur zhing*/

hūm̐: chos sku skye med he ru kaḥ gnyis med sprul sku khro bo'i rgyal: 'jigs byed yab yum dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug bde stong dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti muṃ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mchog thod phreng drag po'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing nas/ gu ru rdo rje thod phreng yab yum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thugs rje'i gzi byin nyi zla'i zer ltar 'phro zhing*/ gsang ba dga' bzhi'i brda skad dang bcas te gar nyams khyug khyug nam mkha' gang bar byon la khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ gti mug phung po'i bdud bcom/ zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i nus rtsal rdzogs shing*/ nyon mongs pa'i zug rngu zhi bar byed cing 'gro don phyogs med du grub pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / ces zhi sku spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dkar gsal mdangs ldan yum dang sbyor: mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor dang bcas: zhi ba yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal drag po'i mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo yon tan gter 'byung gi zhing nas/ gu ru zil gnon yid bzhin nor bu rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ nyi zla'i 'od phung 'khyil zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub char bzhin du babs pas nam mkha' gang bar byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas/ nga rgyal lha bu'i bdud bcom/ 'khor 'das lam gyi yon tan thams cad cig car du rdzogs shing*/ stobs dpal ye shes rgyas pas 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rgyas pa'i tsaka sku mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: longs spyod dbang phyug dzaṃ bha la: sa snying mdog can yum dang sbyor:

dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: rgyas pa yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ gu ru puṇ+ye ḍā ka ḍāk+ki ā pa ra mi ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog thod phreng drag po'i thugs chos dbyings ye shes kyi 'khor lo ka dag zang thal gyi zhing nas gu ru tshe dbang rgyal po rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ ye shes lnga'i 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba nam mkha'i dbyings gang bar byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas/ zhe sdang 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ thugs mi g.yo ba chos nyid kyi nus rtsal mngon du rdzogs shing skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur dang bral ba ka dag zab gsal gyi dgongs pas 'gro don phyogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces tshe lha snying khar bzhag la/ hūm̐: ye shes tshe bdag dbang gi sku: in+ḍa'i mdog can yum dang sbyor: tshe bdag mgyogs ma 'bum gyis bskor: tshe lha yongs rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ pad+ma hṛ dā ya ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mchog thod phreng drag po'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba 'dus pa'i pho brang nas/ dbang phyug mkha' 'gro sde lnga gnas nyul bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rjais chags kyi 'od zer kun nas 'phro ba'i 'khor 'das mnyam sbyor gyi brda gar rol rtsed dang bcas pa bar snang gang ba 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas 'dod chags nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ rtsa rlung bde drod rtogs pa'i nus rtsal yongs su rdzogs nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbyings rig 'od gsal gyis 'khor 'das kyi 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces mkha' 'gro lte bar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: las kyi dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro ma: ljang 'od rlung gi rang bzhin can: rang 'dra lnga dang yang 'khor 'bum: dpal bskyed mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ baṃ ḍāk+ki te dz+wa ha ri ni sa pra mo ti ri sid+dhi dza dzaḥ

a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mchog thod phreng drag po'i dbu gtsug nas rtsal chen ye shes kyi bya khyung rigs lnga me zer dang*/ gnam lcags kyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba krang kring 'jigs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan pas/ ma rig pa'i bdud bcom/ sgong chag khyung bzhin 'khor ba la ji mi snyam pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pas 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces khyung lnga spyi bor bskur zhing : hūm̐: ye shes bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ me gshog lcags sder zangs mchu rngam: deng 'dir khyed gyi dbu la brgyan: dbang rtags cod pan thob par shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ga ru ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i 'jigs byed ging chen bzhi las sprul pa'i khro tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i rngam sgra drag po dang bcas nas byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gnyis med du thim pas/ the tshom gnyis 'dzin gyi bdud bcom/ khrag 'thung khro bo rab 'byams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gzi brjid sprul bsgyur mthu stobs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces ging bzhi spyi bor bskur zhing*/

hūm̐: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las kyi ging dang yum chen bzhis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: dpa' bo yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ tshan+dha tshan+dhi an+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhi nas las byed sprul pa'i khyung chen rigs bzhi dpag tu med pa sa gzhi bar snang gang ba byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpung mgo lta zur g.yas g.yon gyi sgro gseb tu tshang bcas te gnas pas 'khu 'phrig re dogs kyi bdud bcom/ rlabs chen gyi rol rtsal thogs med du 'gyed pas srid pa mtha' sdud kyi thugs rje mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces khyung bzhi dpung mgo gnyis su bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kyi: sprul pa'i bya khyung chen po bzhi: krang kring sgra sgrogs klu gnyan 'joms: zangs mchu lcags sder me gshog can: rigs bzhi khyung gi dbang thob shog: om̐ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa tur mu kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas gdong mo rigs bzhis lcags sdig mgo dgu pa la bzhon pa/ rang 'khor 'bum sde rab tu 'khrugs shing me rlung thog ser 'tshubs pa grangs med pas sa gzhi gang bar byung ba/ khyed rang rnams dpal chen po'i tshigs kyi 'khor lo bzhir thim pas thogs bcas dgra bgegs kyi bdud dpung 'joms/ sha za las kyi ma mo'i srog la dbang thob cing dam sri 'dre rgod dus 'khrug nad yams mu ge dus kyi chad pa mi bzad pa cig car du gzhom pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gdong mo bzhi tshigs chen bzhir bzhag la/ hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : rigs bzhi gdong can sgo skyong ma: dam tshig las kyi bya ra ma: sha za rigs bzhi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ma ma kro ti mu kha li tsa tur a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa ye shes lha'i sgyu 'phrul che mchog thod phreng drag po'i phyag rgyar rdzogs pa la/

dpal chen po'i che rtags kyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du brgyan pas/ ma mo mkha' 'gros rje bor bskur/ dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud cing zil gnon gyi phrin las thogs med du 'gyed pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i go cha chen po'i dpal stobs dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dpal chas lus kyi gnas rnams su bzhag cing*/ hūm̐: prog zhu glang ko zhing lpags sbrul: khrag zhag thal tshom seṅge'i pags: thod phreng rus rgyan stag sham brjid: dpal chas lus rgyan dbang thob shog: om̐ shrī aṣ+ṭha dā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ rgyal ba'i sku ni ri rgyal lhun po ltar: gzi brjid lhun 'joms bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: lta bas mi mngon 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: yid bzhin nor mchog sku yi bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog gtor/ gnyis pa gsung gi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar dbyangs dang sngags phreng g.yas skor du rang sgra 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba las/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags phreng bar ma chad par 'phros te 'ur dir gyis 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod: ces ru rak+sha'i bgrang phreng slob dpon gyis gzung ba slob mar sbyin len tshul gyis dbyangs gsal dang bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkhas gar khyab tu theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos sgra bsgrags shing 'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs te/

'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas stong gsal brjod med rang byung ye shes kyi ngang la gnas pa ni/ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi don ston pa sogs phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub pa'i gu ru'i gsung gi mdzod klong rdol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces bgrang phreng lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: drag sngags rdo rje'i dmod pa ni: gzungs sngags snying po 'dren par bgyi: rtag tu rbad 'gugs bsgral thun sgrogs: las bzhi'i sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ man+t+ra dha ra tsaṇ+ḍa dha ra hṛ da ya wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying por longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ltar: 'ur ting sing khrol chos dbyings 'brug sgra sgrogs: 'gro rnams dbyangs can bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad: rang byung 'gags med gsung gi bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces me long bstan cing*/ hūm̐: ka dag rang bzhin rig pa'i mdangs: zang thal ma 'gags ngo bo nyid: khrag 'thung yab yum thugs kyi dngos: dbang bskur chos dbyings don ldan shog:

om̐ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti muṃ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag /de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba'i thugs ni skyon bral nam mkha' ltar: kun khyab bde gsal mi rtog thugs rje can: 'gro rnams yal bar mi 'dor bu bzhin skyong : mkhyen brtse'i ye shes thugs kyi bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor ro/ /gsum pa gsang ba yon tan gyi nus pa ster bar byed pa/ longs spyod dam rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba la/ thabs kyi bdud rtsi shes rab kyi rak+ta thabs shes dbyer med kyi gtor mchod phun sum tshogs pa lag tu gtad pa la brten nas/ 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba thugs rje'i thabs kyi bden pa'i stobs chen rgyal ba'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces gtor ma lag tu gtad cing*/ hūm̐: dam tshig rmad byung bha ling+ta: dbang bskur tshogs gtor bskang bshags dang : dus mchod la sogs 'dzin par bgyi: mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: om̐ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti muṃ gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar dngos grub yon tan rin chen bcud kyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol par dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chags thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan dpag yas shing :

'khor 'das dbyer med lhun 'byams yongs la mnga': gting zab yangs pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs: yon tan mi zad mchog gi bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog gtor ro/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid phrin las kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa khams gsum yongs sgrol gyi dbang bskur ba la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rtsal las grub pa'i phyag rgya sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ 'khor ba'i lam rgyun gcod pa'i gri gug khams gsum yongs su sreg pa'i me dpung*/ nyon mongs zad sar brlags pa'i thod khrag /stobs chen gdug pa kun sgrol gyi lcags sdig /bdud bzhi log 'dren 'ching ba'i sbrul zhags te/ dpal chen po'i phyag rgya yongs su rdzogs pa gtad pa la brten nas/ dgra bgegs nyon mongs bdud dpung tshar gcod cing gnas su stob pa la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces phyag mtshan lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: rdo rje gri gug me dpung dang : thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul gyi zhags: skal ldan g.yas g.yon lag tu gtad: bdud bzhi tshar gcod dbang thob shog: om̐ badz+ra ā yu dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang rig 'dzin thod phreng yab yum mkha' 'gro sde lnga dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum ging bzhi sha za khyung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : gter srung ma mo dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba:

lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: khyad par du nad bdag pho mo'i mkhar khang dang bcas pa: dmag jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren pa'i dam nyams dgra bo: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i byad ma: 'dre rgod 'byung po gdug pa'i tshogs thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ nya bor dgug gzhug byas la/ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i bde gshegs kyi sras mchog badz+ra ki' la yas phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril ba/ sku smad dbal phur zur gsum 'bar ba la thog mda' skar chen gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba srid gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa/ 'di nyid lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis thabs kyis mi thul ba'i gdul bya log 'dren bdud kyi dpung rnams shugs kyis sgrol ba'i mthu stobs dang nus rtsal yongs su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces phur bu lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi phrin las sku: phyag mtshan rdo rje phur bu 'di: skal ldan g.yas g.yon lag tu gtad: sbyor sgrol las mtha' 'dzin par gyis: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya karma dza hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa satwaṃ: zhes gzhung bzhin phur gdab gcig bya: dgang blugs gtad la/ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i thabs shes zung 'jug gi phyag rgya dgang blugs ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ phrin las bzhi'i rang bzhin can 'di nyid gtad pa tsam gyis phrin las rab 'byams kyi mtha' yongs su sdud pa la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: thabs shes kun gyi ngo bo nyid: las kyi mnan sreg 'phang ba'i zor: phrin las ma nges sna tshogs rigs: rgyud du 'dzin pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ karma pra wa ti a hi ti ru ku ru sa ma ya: zhes lag tu gtad cing tsher ma can gyi me hom̐ sbar/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i pho brang me hom̐ du: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i bud sh-ing sreg:

bstan dgra sger dgra'i tshogs rnams kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: ru tra nṛ tri dz+wa la ya swā hā: zhes ling ro dgang blugs kyis btab tu gzhug /de nas zor 'phang ni/ khyed rang rnams che mchog thod phreng drag por gsal bas gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags kyi thog ltar 'phang bas bstan dgra bdud dpung brlag pa la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces zor lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: dpal chen pho nya rbad pa'i rdzas: mu stegs nag po'i thod pa ru: dmar nag gtor ma rtsang gis brgyan: bskul lo phyi nang 'gal rkyen zlog: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kro ta bh+yo ya dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: las gzhung bzhin zor 'phang du gzhug /de nas sgab 'dre mtha' sdud mnan pa'i dbang ni/ slob dpon dpal chen po'i thugs rje drag po'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa phye mar gas pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas hab sgra dir gyis lhags pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bden stobs drag pos srid pa gsum gyi dgra bgegs dam sri bdud rigs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas 'chi bdag gi zhal du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la bden stobs 'gugs gzhug gi mthar/ hūm̐: mdun du gshin rje'i grub khung du: nṛ tri dgra bgegs dam sri khug: 'chi bdag kha tham khyod la gtad: nam yang ma shor sa ma ya: nṛ tri dam sri ya ma nan kha thaṃ swā hā: zhes gtad pas mthar shor med rgya mtsho'i klong du chol sgra dang bcas nas thim pa'i steng du ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa dpal chen po'i pho brang gsal ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams ma hā gu ru'i thugs rje drag po'i phyag rgya rdzogs pas srid pa spyi gnon gyi bro brdung bas gzir zhing bdud kyi tshogs nam yang ldang med du bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gtor gzhung kha sbub la las gzhung bzhin rta bro brdung*/

de ltar phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang bskur bas bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i nus rtsal mngon du byas la/ bdud rigs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyis bla med mchog la sbyor ba'i dpal dang ldan zhing 'bras bu mngon par byang chub pa'i sku 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba'i phrin las yongs la mnga' brnyes pa'i: thabs dang shes rab mdzad pa du ma yi: mthu stobs rtsal gyis 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzod: phrin las mthar phyin bkra shis yongs khyab shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog gtor/ de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa che mchog he ru ka'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnams pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las la mngon par byang chub pa'i mos pa mdzod: zhes me long dang shel rdo thogs la/ hūm̐: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid: snang stong ye shes rang bzhin mchog: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: spyod pa tshogs drug lam khyer gyis: om̐ tsar+ya pra ti spar+she ṣ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda'i dbang bskur ba la brten nas/ snod bcud gzhal yas lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin pa ngo shes par gyis la brnyas pa ma byed/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod dang bkur sti rgya chen po bgyid cing*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad snang stong dag pa rab 'byams su spyod pa la dbang*/ 'dzin rtog sogs zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub/ brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i sa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje dag pa gnyis ldan sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du bya'o/ /zhes gzengs bstod/ rje btsun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs: 'gro drug kun gyi skyabs gcig pu: yon tan rgya che mkhyen mdzad pa'i: 'bras bu smin pa'i bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes me tog gtor ro/ /de nas bgrod pa gnyis pa gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba la/ bhan+dha 'di nyid tha mal pa ma yin zhing zla gam bde chen dbang gi pho brang du mos pa'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum go cha'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa sbyor ba mdzad pa'i bde chen gyi sgras phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs khro bo rab 'byams spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems zhu ba mkha' gsang nas yab kyi byang sems dri ma med pa'i mdangs can dang*/ yum gyi byang sems mtshal zhun lta bu lhan cig tu babs pa bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kyi dbyibs su gyur pa 'di nyid/

khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing myangs pa la brten nas/ lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis khengs pas zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zag pa med pa nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: spros bral rang byung bhan+dha ru: dam tshig bla med rdzas kyis bkang : khrag 'thung yab yum ngo bo nyid: dbang bskur longs sku'i rtsal ldan shog: om̐ pad+ma he ru ka kro ti muṃ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa muṃ: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku las spros med nges pa don gyi dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rang byin brlabs kyis rdzogs rim gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ las rlung dbang du sdud pas las thams cad 'grub/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi sa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ ka dag rtog med nam mkha'i snying po can: sgyu ma'i gar gyis gzugs sku'i rnam rol ston: bde chen dbyings rig ngo bo lam gyi mchog: zag med dga' bzhi rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog gtor ro/ /bgrod pa gsum pa gzungs ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs ka nas byung ba'i lha mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dmar mthing bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ gcer bu bde nyams dang ldan pa'i gnas lngar 'byung lnga dag pa'i mkha' 'gro rigs lnga gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams dpal chen dbang gi rgyal po dmar la/ gcer bu rus rgyan can bde stong gi nyams dang ldan pa'i gnas lngar/ dug lnga dag pa'i ye shes kyi dpa' bo sde lngar gsal zhing zung 'jug dgyes rgur rol pas/

bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi'i dpal la longs spyod pa'i 'dun pa mdzod/ ces rig ma thogs la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren bzung : dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes slob bus 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar khyed rang yab yum gnyis ka lhar 'du shes pa dang*/ mkha' gsang rdo rje dang pad+mar 'du shes pa dang*/ yid chos su 'du shes pa ste 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su/ mngon sum du gzhon nu ma la bde ba'i ro myong ba ltar/ yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ste/ dbyer med kyi dus su rlung dbu mar tshud pas brjod bral lkugs pas rmi lam mthong ba ltar brjod bya kha las 'das te tshig gis mtshon du med pa/ ro gcig gi dus su bde stong du 'dzin pa gzhi la thim pas khyab brdal chen po ngos bzung dang bral ba blo 'das zang thal gcig tu spyod pa'o/ /zhes ngo sprad/ de ltar yum mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la shin tu spros med a nu yo ga'i shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lhan skyes kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ thig le bde chen bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbyings mi shigs pa mchog gi las thams cad grub/ bcu gnyis pa ma chags pad+ma can gyi sa non/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa chos sku bde ba chen po thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum dang : dga' rab shrī seng rig 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad: rtsa gsum lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis: sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis smon lam stsol: zung 'jug dga' bzhi'-i grol lam rnam pa brgyad:

yas babs mas brtan pho nya ḍāk+ki'i dbyings: gegs med gsang sngags rlabs chen 'dzin pa yi: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i yang dag don ldan shog: oṃ ma hā gu ru mu ṭā gu h+ya sarba hrīḥ zhes me tog gtor ro/ /bgrod pa bzhi pa rang byung ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nge zhog cig /de ltar bzhag pas sems zhes bya ba gzugs dbyibs kha dog dngos po mtshan ma can du ma grub pas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol ba chos sku blo 'das ye nas stong pa/ de'i mdangs ma 'gags pa 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad shar ba'i gzhir gyur pas/ chad pa'i mtha' las grol ba/ rang bzhin gsal la mi dmigs shing rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral te ka dag tu rdzogs pa'i rig pa bsal bzhag dang bral ba ye nas rang byung 'od kyi snying por sku gsum gyis mtshon pa/ stong pa chos sku sems kyi gzhi/ gsal ba longs sku sems kyi ngo bo/ thugs rje sprul sku sems kyi nges tshig ste/ chos longs sprul gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum sogs mtshan don ji ltar sbyar yang gzhan nas btsal du med par gdod ma nas lhun grub tu gnas pas/ deng phyin chad 'dzin med ngo bo rang gsal ye shes chen po la spyod pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzod/ ces man shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes snying khar bzhag la/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ de kho na nyid rab tu spros med a ti rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum gyi sdig ltung shes bya'i dri ma dang bcas pa sbyangs/

chos nyid khyab brdal chen po bsgom pa'i skal ba dang*/ nyams rtogs yon tan sogs rgyas pa'i las grub/ bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa non/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang : bla med chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi sgrogs par shog: zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs phrin las rnams: thogs pa med par rtag tu 'grub par shog: bslab gsum chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa dang : srid mtha'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par shog: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: tsan+dan nags su spyod par gshegs: stag zhon rdo rje gro bo lod: bkra shis khye'u 'dren mtshan ldan lcam: drag po yam yum bkra shis shog: mchims phu bde gshegs sgrub pa mdzad: grub thob rgyal po zil gnon zhabs: zung 'jug dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal ma: rig 'dzin yab yum bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i gnas mchog gter gyi sgrom: ke'u ri gsang ba brag gi rdzong : dregs sde srung mas bya ra mdzad: chos skyong gter srung bkra shis shog: ces sogs bkra shis rgyas par brjod: rjes su dbang srog 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin te/ klong gsal las/ gsang sngags srog ni dam tshig ste/ khyad par smin byed dbang dang ni/ /grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa la/ /bla ma mchog bsten 'grub gyur cing*/ /de yi rtsa ba dam tshig srungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar bsrung na/ sgra thal 'gyur las/ dbang brten pa yi dam tshig bshad: dbye na brjod kyis mi langs kyang : mdor bsdus sku dang gsung dang thugs: rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la sbyar: dmigs pa bla ma rdo rje mched: bsrung ba'i yul gyi rnam par dbye:

rdo rje gsang ba'i gnad bzung bya/ /zhes sngags bla med kyi don la dam tshig gi rnam dbye dang bsrung tshul dpag tu med par gsungs kyang*/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la 'dus te/ sku'i dam tshig tu gzhan phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la ma dag pa'i 'dzin rtog spangs te yi dam lha'i bskyed rim rgyun chad med par bsgom/ gsung gi dam tshig yar sangs rgyas nas mar gang zag phal pa yan gyi gsung rab mi brnyas snod bcud 'byung ba'i sgra thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung du mos pa'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar bya/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu mi dge ba'i rtog pa skad cig ma yan chad spangs la/ phan dge byang chub kyi sems rgyun chad med par chos thams cad de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par bya/ gal te dam tshig las nyams na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba stor ba yin te/ klong gsal las/ bla ma dang ni dbang mchog gi /gsung dang rgyud las 'gal ba na/ /na raka sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ ji bzhin ma 'gal bar bsgrubs pa'i yon tan ni/ de nyid las/ bka' dang ma 'gal yon tan ni/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po 'grub/ /phrin las bzhi la thogs pa med/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyid snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ches: dam pa'i bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig ma g.yel srog ltar bsrung : lan gsum/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i slaub bus slob dpon gyi dgyes pa skong dgos te/ rig pa rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la/ khu bo pha dang ma dang mig /bu dang chung ma nor dang mchog /sgo gsum zol zog med pa yis/ /rab tu gces dang yid 'thad 'bul/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar mnyes pa'i yon tan yang*/ de nyid las/ brten pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa 'thob/

/ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zab mo'i dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya chen spyod la skyong du gsol: lan gsum/ de nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen 'grub pa'i dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo bar ma byas na las mtha' mi btsan pas/ 'di ltar bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mdo las/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /zhes dang*/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yas de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rang gzhan rnams kyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams sems can thams cad byang chub kyi rgyur bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor kyang gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor thugs dam bskul ba chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdul tshon dang 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya/ che mchog thod phreng sku lnga rigs 'dus kyi/ /smin lam dbang khrid rdo rje spyi blugs zhes/ /rang nyid thos bsam rnam dpyod mthu dman zhing*/ /yun ring bsgoms pa'i nyams myong cung zad las/ /zab mo'i dbang bskur gnad la ches rmongs pas/ /bdag 'dra'i slob dpon sa 'dzin gzugs brnyan dag /gzhan gyis gnyer brdas 'jug bder bklag chog tu/ /bkod par mkhas rnams dbyings nas mi khrel zhing*/ /gti rgan smyon pa'i rang gshis tshul la dgongs/
