/nyog por bslad ces bka' bkyon mi gnang zhu/ /de skad skyid grong smyon pas sgra grags so/ /a khu kong po'i sngags 'chang dgyes gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // (kha) pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa las/ snying po'i gtor dbang bskur ba'i tshul ye shes snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma he ru ka ya/ rab 'jigs dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /rngam pa'i nga ros sa gsum g.yo/ /pad+ma khrag 'thung la btud nas/ /smin byed snying po'i lag len 'god/ /stegs bu'i steng du dug khrag gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍa lar 'bru tshom dmar po gcig bkod pa'i khar khri'u'i steng du/ zangs lcags sam thod pa'i snod du dpal gtor me ri sogs kyi rgyan spros can sku tsaka dar gdugs dang bcas pa bsham/ sman raka gtor gsum drag mchod brjid par bstar zhing*/ las bum sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang bsag go /de nas bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod skyabs sems tshogs bsags mchod rdzas byin rlabs rnams 'brel che ba'i dbang gis/ chos gling yab sras kyi lugs sam spyi mthun zhig gtong*/ las gzhung ltar bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrub cing dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang bcas bzlas pa ci nus mthar mchod bstod 'bul/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs la gnang ba nod/ las bum sgrub/ slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ mtshams sbyor gang 'os bye brag tu/

de la 'dir phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i stobs bcu'i nus rtsal gcig tu bsdus pa 'jigs byed pad+ma he ru ka chen po nyid/ zhi bas mi 'dul ba'i ma rungs gdul dka'i 'byung po gdug pa can rnams mthun pas 'dul ba'i phyir/ gtum chen shin tu 'bar ba chen pos rdo rje'i gar gyi rol pa ci yang bsgyur te nyon mongs pa'i g.yul ngo btsan thabs su bzlog par mdzad pa ste/ de nyid kyi rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa las gangs can tu byon pa rnams kyi nang nas yang zab snying po'i bcud dril 'ga' zhig 'dul ba'i dus dang 'tshams par sprul pa'i gter ston rnams kyis rdo rje'i gsang mdzod las rim par phyung ste 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas par mdzad pa las/ skabs su bab pa 'di ni/ gter chen chos rje gling pas tshad mar ngos 'dzin gnang zhing*/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje dang thugs mchog rdo rje rnam gnyis kyis mngon par bsngags shing zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pa/ dri med gling pa sogs tshad thub kyi dam pa mang pos tshad mar 'dzin pa ma zad/ mkhyen rtogs nus mthu 'gran zla dang bral ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul/ rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter gyi cha shas las 'phros pa pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa zhes/ snyigs dus 'dre rgod 'byung po 'dul ba'i gnyen po'i chos zab cing khyad par du 'phags pa 'di nyid kyi smin byed snying po'i gtor dbang bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar te maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slob dpon dang che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung dbyer med cing mi phyed gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /bdag ni 'khor ba'i duḥkha las/ /bsgral phyir byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ bla ma dpal chen he ru ka dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/

rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pa'i bsgom don re re nas gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrang ba'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /lan gsum/ byin rlabs kyi gzhi sgrub cing ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: gdod ma'i stong nyid ngang las snying rje'i rtsal: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus snod bcud sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang : dur khrod rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas dbus: pad nyi dregs pa rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng : sa bon phra thabs tshul du babs pa las: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po rtsal: dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar khro zhing gtum: spyan gsum sdang mig sma ra smin ma gzengs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: phyag g.yas rdo rjes snang srid zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas phur pa ma rungs snying la gzir: lcags sdig tshwa tshwas dam 'gong hub hub za: dbu gtsug rta mgo rdo rje dbyings su 'tsher: 'jigs pa'i gad mos stong gsum 'gul zhing 'khyom: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du rngam: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: drag me dmar nag 'khrugs pa'i klong na rol:

spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med pas mtshan: sku la zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'phro: gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge gsal zhing 'bar: thugs ka'i 'od kyis ye shes spyan drangs bsam: hūm̐ hrīḥ rak+sha srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: stong gsum dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma khrag 'thung drag po'i skur bzhengs nas: ma rungs log 'dren 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hrīḥ pad+ma kro dha he ru ka e h+ya hi hrīṃ hrīṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: dz+nyā na a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la ye shes pa bstim/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa brtan par bya/ dpal gtor thogs la/ phyi snod rab 'jigs dur khrod drag po'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du gtor ma che mchog pad+ma drag po rtsal/ rab 'byams khro bo'i sprin dang bcas pa mngon sum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ las 'od zer me phung ltar khro chung dkar po'i tshogs 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar zhugs shing lus la thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ bskyed rim snang stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang*/ khrag 'thung chen po'i sku phyag rgya'i dbang thob par mos shig /hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung sku: rtsa gsum rab 'byams sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi lus la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim sku yi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma dpral bar bzhag la/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer me phung khro chung ltar dmar po'i tshogs 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs shing ngag la thim pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ gsang sngags grags stong dbyer med bzlas pa la dbang*/ khrag 'thung chen po'i gsung gi nus pa'i dbang mchog thob par mos shig /hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung gsung : rtsa gsum rab 'byams gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi ngag la dbang bskur bas:

nus pa sngags kyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma mgrin par bzhag la/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer me phung ltar khro chung sngon po'i tshogs 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha nas zhugs shing yid la thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ rdzogs rim rig stong zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ khrag 'thung chen po'i thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang mchog thob par mos shig /hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub pad+ma khrag 'thung thugs: rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan bu yi yid la dbang bskur bas: rig rtsal don gyi dbang mchog thob par shog: sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma snying khar bzhag la: yang gtor ma che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung dngos su gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon/ gnas gsum nas 'od zer me phung ltar khro chung kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gnas gsum du zhugs shing lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi/ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ khrag 'thung chen po'i yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang mchog thob par mos shig /hūm̐ hrīḥ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pad+ma khrag 'thung rtsal: rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang gnyis su med: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sku yi dbyings su rdzogs: skal ldan slob ma'i spyi bor mngon sum byon: sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad sol: smin grol dbang dang byin rlabs char ltar phob: rang byung rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: sngags mthar: sarba sid+dhi hrī: gtor ma gnas gsum du bzhag la: spro na spyi mthun gyi bka' bsgo'ang bya/ gtor ma'i lha ye shes pa khyed rang rnams la thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'khyil bar rol zhing myangs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'bad med du thob par mos shig

/ byas la gtor zan gyi cha shas dang bdud rtsi sbyin/ me tog 'thor zhing shis brjod bya/ de ltar sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i smin byed snying po gtor ma'i byin rlabs legs par grub pa lags pas sogs mtshams sbyar la dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag phyin chod spyi mthun bya/ dkyil 'khor rjes chog sogs mchod bstod bzod gsol gshegs bsdu bsngo smon bkra shis bcas spyi ltar bya'o/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i go chas sgo gsum srung*/ /mthu stobs ral gris bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo zlog /drag rtsal me lces dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa/ /che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung myur 'grub shog /zab gsang snying po'i tshul 'di'ang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon pos bka' drin bstsal ba'i zhabs tog tu dmigs nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis shrī de bī ko tri'i sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // (ga) 'chi med yang gsang bcud dril gyi dbang mchog rdo rje snying po'i cod pan ces bya ba bzhugs so/ ā yu dhe wa na mo/ 'pho med zung 'jug rdo rjer mnga' brnyes pa/ /srid zhi'i khyab bdag rig 'dzin pad 'byung nyid/ /gsang ba tshe lha'i ngo bor ldang ba'i sku/ /'chi med dpal kun ster mdzad lha de rgyal/ /gang gi sgrub pa'i thabs tshul 'chi med bcud/ /bum bzang nus rtsal bskyil dang rjes 'brel dbang*/ /mthar byed g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i rdo rje yi/ /snying po'i cod pan zab mo 'di na spel/ /de la 'dir gar gyi dbang phyug chen po rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos gter byon pad+ma drag po'i dbang ltar sgrub pa 'chi med bcud dril dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur gyi rim pa la/ yo byad bsham pa/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur dang gnyis las/ dang po yid mthun gyi gnas su ji ltar 'os pa'i rdul tshon ras bris 'bru tshom la sogs skabs dang sbyar la/

dbus su tshe bum/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang*/ rgyab tu mda' dar gzhan yang las bum/ spyi dang bye brag gi chos srung*/ chad brtan/ phyi nang gi tshogs mchod sogs mngon par 'du bar bgyis te/ rang nyid pad+ma drag po'i nga rgyal brtan po sngon du 'gro ba'i mdun bskyed tshe'i las byang rdo rje'i snying po'i tshogs lhag gi bar/ ji lta ba bzhin las mdun bskyed dang rjes su 'brel bar las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bskyed bzlas kyang bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i las rim ni/ slob ma bsdus la/ las bum gyi chus/ ji ltar bltams p oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes khrus bya/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsang sbyang spyi ltar la/ bden brjod kyi dus/ khyad par mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'chi med dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma rnams la smin byed tshe'i dbang zab mo bskur ba la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad dpag tshad rgyang grags su ma nye bar dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas/ bsregs shing rnam par 'jom par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes dang*/ sum+bha ni? sogs drag sngags kyis brab cing 'tsham rngam bya/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis srung 'khor bsgom du gzhug /de nas maṇ+ḍal me tog bkye bsdu bya/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa ci nas kyang 'thob par bya/ de lta bu'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ skye ba dang yang srid thams cad dang khyad par sku tshe 'di nyid du dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i ched du/ 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo gsan snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rgya chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan par zhu zhing*/

chos la kun tu spyod pa yang*/ lung las/ chos sgra sgrog pa'i sgra thos sems can rnams/ /ngan song gnas grol nyan rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lus g.yo 'gul dang*/ ngag smra brjod/ yid 'khrul rtog dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ shes pa'i so btsug te gsan par zhu/ gang gsan bya'i chos kyi ngo bo ni/ lung las/ grogs dag dal 'byor rin chen snying po'i lus/ /'gro drug nang nas rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /ji ltar dbul pos rin chen gter snyed bzhin/ /rab tu dga' bas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang re rnams kyis thob pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing snyed dka' ba tsam du ma zad shin tu 'jig par sla ba/ chu'i chu sbur dang 'dra ste/ gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi 'jig pa ma yin te/ de'ang 'chi rkyen ni mang zhing*/ 'tsho rkyen ni shin tu nyung bas myur du 'chi bar nges te/ do nub tsam du yang mi 'chi ba'i gdengs dang bral bas na/ rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor thob dus chos la shin tu brtson pas 'bad dgos te/ de'i thabs tshul yang 'phags bod du yongs su grags pa'i bka' gter ji snyed cig mchis kyang*/ 'di ni sku gsum rdo rje'i klong du gzhol ba/ gsang chen kun gyis ṛgs bdag pad+ma thod phreng nyid/ au ḍī ya na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya 'di nyid nges pa'i don du sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang dbyer med pa las/ zhing 'dir bstan pa'i bdag po zas gtsang sras po'i rgyal tshab tu dha na ko shar pad+ma'i snying po las sku 'khrungs te/ ston pa nyid dang gnyis su med pa'i phrin las kyi mdzad pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par khyab cing*/ khyad par du mā ra ti ka 'chi med sgrub pa'i gnas su/ skye 'chi med pa tshe'i rig 'dzin chen po'i sku mnyes te 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po mngon du gyur/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan par ston pa gnyis pa lta bur gyur/

slar yang bod kha ba can du gdul bya dus la bab par gzigs nas/ mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi spyan drangs pa bzhin byon zhing*/ bod yul du mdo sngags gnyis kyi bstan pa 'gran zla med par spel ba'i bka' drin mdzad/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs bod kyi 'gro ba rnams gsang sngags phyi nang gi chos du mas smin grol du mdzad/ khyad par gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mor thugs sgrub sku lnga rigs 'dus/ yang gsang rdo rje me 'bar gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes pas/ bod yul du ma mo gsang ba'i brda rtags kyi rten 'brel ya mtshan du ma mngon sum du mdzad cing*/ phyi rabs ma 'ongs pa'i don du rgya rtags gsum dang ldan pa ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong gi gter phug tu mi snang bar rgyas btab te bzhugs/ dus mthar spyod pa'i smon lam du mdzad pa ni/ gzhung las/ phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug don gyi phyir: tshe sgrub dbang gi gdams zab khyad par can: 'ja' lus rdo rje snying po'i srog sgrub bzhag: 'di nyid sgrub cing nyams su len pa rnams: tshe tshad phug tu phyin kyang lo gsum bsring : de phyir gdams pa yang zab-i atsha rgya: ma 'ongs lnga brgya nyi shu shar ba'i tshe: pad+ma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: ces zab rgya'i smon lam gyis mtha' rgyan dang bcas bzhugs shing ma 'ongs pa'i dus su thugs kyi dgongs pa rab tu gtad pa'i mthus/ slar sprul pa'i gter ston chen po rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ gnubs ban gyi rnam 'phrul du gyur pa des/ kha byang lung gi don bzhin thabs sbas tshul gyis gsang gter du spyan drangs te lo drug gsang rgya dang bcas te/ skal ldan rnams smin grol mdzad tshul ni/ dam pa nyid kyi rnam thar du gsal mod/ zab chos de nyid kyi nang tshan du gyur pa/ 'chi med tshe'i chos skor 'chi med bcud dril zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar/

dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i rim pa yin la/ de'ang brgyud pa'i khyad par du gyur pa dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs pad du nye bar lhags pa rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje zhes/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa zab mo'i gter mdzod du spyod pa des/ bdag la'ang thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas byin rlabs cig car du lud pa'i gdams zab bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du nye bar bstsal zhing*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa 'di nyid la yang smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed khrid kyi rim pa gnyis las/ 'dir dbang bskur ba ste/ 'di'i dbang dang gdams pa lan gcig thob pas kyang*/ tshe zad kho na'i 'gro ba yin yang lo bdun bsring bar nus shing*/ mthar 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur mngon sum du spyod par 'gyur zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i phan yon can gyi dbang bskur ba la/ sngon du bgyi ba rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga rnams lhag chad med par song grub/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa ni/ thog mar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i tshe dbang zab mo gsan snyam pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyed zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /blo mchog ting 'dzin bskyed du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas mdun bskyed nam mkha'i gnas su rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol bar bya/ de'i ched du 'dir 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur ba na/ gzhan gyi don rgya chen bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs zhing de'i spyan sngar yan lag bcu pa dang ldan pa'i tshogs bsag pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro rnams tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing :

thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces lan gsum/ 'o skyabs yul rnams ltem gyis 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid chen por gyur to snyam pa'i mos pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi sgrub pa la ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas de'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ las bum gyi chus 'thor zhing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stongs pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'og min bde ba can gyi zhing khams su gsal ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma nyi zla thabs shes rdo rje'i khri 'phang mthon por khyed rang slob bu rnams kyi rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig in+d+ra nī la'i mdog lta bu las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad 'chi med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa 'chi med rdo rje'i sku mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon bhan+dha bsnams shing*/ dbu rgyan ga shal cod pan 'phyang ba/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khyud cing*/ phyi rol rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs rang mdog dang g.yas rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ g.yon pas tshe bum pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzin par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur to snyam pas 'dun pa gtad par zhu/ zhes brda sbyar/ spos rol dbyangs dang bcas nas/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: 'chi med dbang po rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: yab yum tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma 'bum gyis bskor: lhun grub tshe yi dal du gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes byin dbab/ de ltar byin dbab pas ye shes pa rnams brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rjes mgor rgya gram du bzhag

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ khyed rnams bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams khra spungs se bzhugs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bskur ba tsam gyis lus thams cad zhu lugs su gyur te nam yang mi shigs pa'i mchog thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe gtor spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐: mkha' dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i klong yangs nas: pad+ma dbang chen tshe bdag he ru kaḥ ḍāk+ki tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' spyod dag pa 'chi med gnas nas bzhengs: sngon tshe 'chi med gsang ba'i tshe sgrub ltar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la stsal du gsol: ngo mtshar yid 'ong rmad byung lha yi gter: 'dod pa'i re skong 'chi med bdud rtsi'i srid: kun 'byung dngos grub rtsa ba mchog stsol la: 'dzad med brgyud 'dzin smin pa'i dbang mchog bskur: oṃ pad+ma hrī ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi dza dzaḥ de nas dung chen bde ba chen po'i gzhal yas khang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang*/ 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs rnams mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po'i byang sems kyi rgyun/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par bskur ba'i ngag gi sgrib pa yongs su dag cing*/ gsung theg chen rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs la spyod pa'i dbang mchog thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dbyings kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun: kun 'byung byang sems thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: mkha' la rang byung rig pa'i bdud rtsi yi: skal ldan rtsa gsum snang ba gong 'phel rdzas: bde drod 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ pad+ma hrī dha ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi dza dzaḥ de nas/ tshe'i ril bu 'di nyid 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od lnga ldan lug gu rgyud kyi zer thag tu 'khrigs shing*/ thugs zag med bde ba'i rang rtsal rab tu 'bar ba 'di/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar bskur bas/ snying dbus srog gi 'khor lo mi shigs pa rdo rje'i ka ba tshugs shing 'khrul med zab gsang gi dgongs pa klong du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe ril snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐: byin rlabs rtsa ba rgyud kun gcig dril ba: 'jigs bral rdo rje'i tshe srid 'byung ba'i rdzas: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum ngo bo mchog: kun 'byung gdod nas zas bcud ril bu'i rdzas: dam rdzas bcud len snying po'i don thob shog: oṃ pad+ma hrī dha ā yur+dz+nyā na ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi dza dzaḥ de ltar dbang gi lha tshogs khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ yig in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i sku gsung thugs kyi mthu stobs gzi byin/ lha klu mi gsum dang drang srong rnams kyi tshe dpal mthu stobs/ 'byung ba lnga'i khams kyi dwangs bcud/ skye 'gro thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor dge legs snyan grags la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par pha rol mi dang mi ma yin gyis khyed rang rnams kyi/ bla tshe rku ba/ gzhom pa/ yar ba/ 'phrog pa/ nyams par byed pa de dag 'od zer des/ khab len rdo'i snang tshul bzhin 'ub kyi bsdus nas/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas shing 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces bzlas la/ tshe 'gugs ni mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: shar phyogs dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: lho phyogs ser mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la:

rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: nub phyogs dmar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: byang phyogs ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi ri rab bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: bud+dha rigs kyi tshe bdag ma: dbus phyogs sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: gling bzhi tshe yi bcud bsdus la: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par shog: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i mgyogs ma ni: rang rang rigs mthun dpag med 'phros: mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas pa yi: 'dzam gling kun gyi bcud bsdus la: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog sku lnga rigs 'dus lha: 'khor 'das lam gsum tshe dpal gzi 'bar lhun: pad+ma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin tshe yi lhas: ye shes rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dkar mo tshe bdag sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: dmar mo tshe bdag gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: sngon mo tshe bdag thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: ser mo tshe bdag yon tan dbang bzhi stsol: ljang mo tshe bdag phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: sku lnga rdo rje'i srog tu rgyas thob cig: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe 'gugs mthar/ hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs rdo rje rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: chu la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: sa la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas:

rin chen tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rat+nas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ hūm̐ baṃ: nub phyogs pad+ma rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: me la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: pad+ma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog pad+mas rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs las kyi rig ma'i gtso: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: rlung la dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: karma tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog rgya gram rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ dbus phyogs dbyings kyi rig ma'i gtso: nam mkhar dbang bsgyur ḍāk+ki mas: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: bud+dha tshe yi dbang mchog bskur: tshe srog g.yung drung rgyas gdab bo: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ de ltar tshe dang ye shes dwangs ma'i gzi byin gyis khyed rang rnams kyi tshe bcud nyams pa thams cad sor chud de slar yang mi 'gyur ba'i rgyas gdab pa yin zhing*/ deng nas gdon bgegs 'byung po log par 'tshe ba'i rigs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par rang lus tshags su tshud de/ rdo rje pha lam lta bu'i sra zhing brtan par gyur to snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gnas lngar rgyas gdab bo/ hūm̐: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rgya: longs sku mi 'gyur pad+ma'i rgya: sprul sku mi 'gyur g.yung drung rgya: ḍāk+ki mi 'gyur 'khor lo'i rgya: gter srung mi 'gyur phyag mtshan rgya: tshe srog mi 'gyur go khrab rgya: ye shes mi 'gyur stong nyid rgya: rim pa sra brtan 'jigs med rgya: skal ldan tshe srog brtan gyur cig: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki ā yu ṣe dza dzaḥ ha ri ni sa rā ga dz+nyā na ma ma wā shaṃ sid+dhi dza dzaḥ

me tog 'thor zhing*/ sku tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bur gyur cig /mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bur gyur cig tshe 'phel bar gyur cig /'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub la dbang 'byor bar gyur cig / ces dang*/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgy sogs shis pa brjod/ des bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur zab mo legs par grub pa yin pas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams mi nyams par bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar? sogs lan gsum/ de nas sku drin gtang rag yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor ba lta bur sprul nas/ cha shas kyi longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis/ khyed la bdag gis 'bul lags na/ /rje'i slob mar bzung nas su/ /rgya cher spyod la spyad du gsol/ /lan gcig brjod/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can la bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di? sgrol bar shog / bsngo smon byas la slob ma rnams grol/ de nas mchod kha gso la chad tho sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams las byang ltar mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /dran pa tsam gyis srid dang zhi ba'i dpal/ /dwangs bcud thugs dbus bskyed la lhag pa'i lha/ /ā yu na thā mtsho skyes rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor rjes 'brang dbang bskur khrigs su sdeb/ /shes rab stong gsal mkha' dbyings pad+mo'i klong*/ /rang byung thabs kyi rig rtsal rdo rje'i 'phrul/ /zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i gter mdzod zer brgya pas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i mun pa sel lo ang*/ /de yang tshe sgrub 'chi med bcud dril gyis bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba'i skal ldan dag gi /gzhan phan 'gro don rlabs po che spyod pa'i cha rkyen/

tshe sgrub rdo rje snying po'i cod pan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ spang ston grub pa'i dbang phyug theg gling karma 'gro don mthar phyin dang*/ zab rgya'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa smon lam rdo rje sogs kyis tshul 'di khyod kyis bgyis zhes bka' stsal gyi gnang ba thob par brten/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rgyal tshab dam pa rig 'dzin yongs 'dus thugs mchog rdo rje rol pa rtsal gyi zhabs pad du nye bar bsnyen pa'i mthus/ rig rtsal gyi snang ba yangs por byas te gtad med du spyod pa kong smyon rig 'dzin phrin las kyis rang lugs smyon pa'i lhab 'chol du bkod pa dza yan+tu/ dge'o// // (nga) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol gyi sta gon thar lam dkar po dang dngos gzhi dbang gi cho ga 'grigs chags su bkod pa bzhugs so/ na mo lo ki shwa rir 'dud/ 'dir 'khyer bde'i lag len 'chad pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur/ rten mtha' rgyas su bya ba'o/ /dang po sgrub chen skabs sgrub khog pra khrid ltar bya/ de man skabs su yo byad kyis shom la gnas khang gtsang zhing rgyan dang yo byad kyis spras pa'i gong du dbang stegs khar rab rdul tshon/ 'bring ras bris/ tha na maṇ+ḍal steng*/ 'bru tshom lha grangs ltar bkod/ dbus lding khri'i khar bum pa mgul chings dmar po can bum rdzas so lngas bkang ba kha rgyan gyi gseb tu thugs rje chen po'i sku tsaka kyang gzugs/ thog 'og tu thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du chos sman chang sbyar bas bkang ba'i steng du me long chang gis brlan pa la/ sin+dhu ra brdal te chos 'byung bris pa'i lte bar hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bris pa bkod/ dar dmar gyi gur phub me long dang shel rdo dar sna lnga dang lha tsaka rnams bkod/ sman raka gtor gsum/ tshe gwa /tshe chang*/ tshe ril/ tshe mda'/ chad brtan bskul gsum lha klu btsan sogs/ tshogs sngon gtor zhal zas bcas bkod legs bya/

nye logs su chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i dam chu/ srung skud rdor mdud can yi dam gyi sngags sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ so shing*/ mig dar/ ku sha'i chun po che chung bsnol ba bgegs gtor sogs nyer mkho tshang bar byas la/ sgrub mchod skabs las byang brgyud 'debs nas bzung bsnyen bstod bar gtso bum lha gzhung bya/ las bum rta mgrin bsgrub/ gzhung gi dbang bzhi blang ba sogs bya/ yang gter gzhung las/ las byang ngam: longs sku'i sgrub pa ltar byas kyang rung : gsungs pa ltar bya/ rig pa'i me tog dor/ min kyang 'od gsal ngang la dbang bzhi rdzogs zhes pa sgrub mchod kyi rim pa'o/ /dbang bskur gyi rim pa ni slob ma rnams la/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ mgraun dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rta mchog khro rgyal dbang chen gyi: thugs rje'i zer las pho nya dpag yas 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: om̐ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ gardza ya gnod byed 'byung po aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma phyir btegs la/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro rgyal khrag 'thung thugs khros nas: gzi byin stobs kyis drag po'i mtshon char 'bebs: phye mar brlag cing rdul phran bzhin du gtor: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis brab/ gu gul bdug /srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo'i rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: om̐ badz+ra ā yu dha dz+wa la ram̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom/ de nas dkyil 'khor yol bas g.yogs la slob ma sgo drung du 'khod de slob dpon gyis/ de'ang khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol nas 'jug pa yin kyang*/ dkyil 'khor yol bas chod pa rung mthun gyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar te sgo srung sgo ma rigs bzhi'i tshogs la/

phyogs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sgo dbye mdzad par zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥ phyogs bzhi'i skyong ba'i sgo ma bzhi/ /tshad med rnam bzhis snyan gsan la/ /thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir/ /nyon mongs zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes/ /ye shes bzhi sbyor lha ngo sprod/ /rnam dag smon lam sgo phye 'tshal/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir las can skal ldan ma gtogs pa/ skal med rnams kyis blta bar mi rung bas rigs dang skal bar 'dri ba 'di la gsan par khyab pa gda'/ hoḥ nged rnams sgo ma rigs bzhi ste/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i cho 'phrul las/ khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas/ sgo bzhi bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal/ zhes dris pa'i lan du de lta bu'i slob ma snod kyi skyon dang ldan pa ma lags shing rigs dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas thugs brtse bas dgongs nas 'jug par gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye hoḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor zhal mjal phyir/ /sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal/ /dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung*/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bka'i gnang ba thob nas lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pos 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar/ de nas ging dkar nag gis mtshams bcad kyi rdo thun dang bcas nas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: khyed rnams yang dag snod ldan na: dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug pa'i tshe: sgrub la mi dbang bdud dang bgegs: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: khro rgyal spros pa'i pho nya ni: 'bar ba'i ging chen glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed 'brang ba'i go skabs med: lan chags gtor ma 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: dbang chen rta mgrin thugs khros nas: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas gzhan du phyir dengs shig:

om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces rdo thun gyis brab/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo'i rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: oṃ badz+ra ā yu dha dz+wa la raṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ yol bas phyi nas 'di ltar zhu/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du thal mo me tog dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du 'jug pa'i phyir gnang ba zhu ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kyeḥ thugs rje'i dbang phyug bla ma rje: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dam pas rjes bzung gnang bar zhu: de ltar gsol ba btab pa la mkhyen brtse ye shes chen pos bka' yi gnang ba sbyin par bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: hoḥ rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: yang dag nges par 'jug nas su: dkyil 'khor gnyan las mi 'da' na: dam longs rdo rje'i dam tshig sbyin: de nas slob dpon gyi phyag tu rdo rje thogs te dbye ba'i rgya dang bcas te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar mos mdzod/ hūm̐: rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse mchog: rdo rje'i gsang ba chos sku'i dbyings: rdo rje'i lde'u mig sna tshogs thabs: rdo rje'i sku gsum sgo phyes ltos: om̐ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ sngags lan gsum/ yol ba bsal/ de nas ye shes lnga'i lam la 'khrid pa ni/ khyed rang rnams ye shes lnga'i dar thag la 'jus te tshad med bzhis 'jug pas bskor phyogs su dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi bye nas nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ nga ni rigs lnga spyan ras gzigs/ /skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod/ /ma rig dug lnga bsal ba'i phyir/ /rang byung dar thag sna lnga zungs/

/ye shes lnga yi lam la shog om̐ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma sarba puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor/ hūm̐: nga ni thugs rje chen po'i sku: gnas 'di ri bo tā la'i zhing : lha 'di 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor ma 'dres 'ja' ltar lhags: skal ldan rnams kyi smon lam 'grub: skal med sred na dung bas gdung : nges par snying nas gsol ba thob: om̐ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mu tra hoḥ zhes gral la 'khod cing lo rgyus dang chos bshad ci rigs bya/ chos bshad 'phrad tshad rang grol ni/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol 'di ni/ rgya gar skad du: tsit+ta badz+ra a ti hrī dha tri ya ma hā: bod skad du: thugs rje chen po bla med snying po'i rgyud chen po: o rgyan skad du: he ru ṇi laṃ sha d+dho ti: bod skad du: yang gsang sbas pa chen po'i snying thig: ghu h+ya ḍak+ki'i skad du: he laṃ ni ti tri ghi ra tri shrī dzaḥ bod skad du: don thig gcig chen po smra ba myur ba'i rgyu: gsum ldan mdzod kyi man ngag rlabs po che zhes bya ba: theg pa mtha' dag gi 'byung nas snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo: bla med gsang chen bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi rgyud: dang po lo rgyus kyi rnam dbye bstan pa ni: sngon bskal pa kun bkod ces bya ba'i dus su: 'og min snang mtha'i zhing khams pho brang dbyings kyi bkod pa blo las 'das pa'i dbus su: yon tan thams cad rab tu rdzogs pa'i khri'i steng du ston pa thog ma'i mgon po rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs so: yang de'i tshe gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar mas thog ma'i mgon po la dgongs brgyud kyi tshul du theg pa mtha' dag zhus te mkha' 'gro brda'i yi ger bsgyur nas dbyings la sbas: yang de'i tshe klong dgu'i rgyud kyi gsang mdzod 'dzin pa dbyings dga' rab rdo rjes brda bzhi'i tshul du rgyud rnams gdan drangs te:

rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la snyan brgyud mu tig rtsal phreng longs sku thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gi tshul du lung gnang*/ gu ru rin po ches gsang ba'i dbang phyug mtsho rgyal ma dang sangs rgyas ye shes lha lcam rdo rje dhe ba dha ra rnams la tshig brgyud brda'i shog ser la btab cing bka'i rgya gtad de ma 'ongs smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar rten 'brel sbas yul rgya rtags bka'i gnyer gtad dang bcas te ma 'ongs sems can gyi don du zab bzhes gnang ba sogs lo rgyus chos kyi byung khungs mdo tsam mo: dang po sngon 'gro thun mong gi rim pa mdo tsam bstan na: dus dang gnas skabs phun sum tshogs pa dgos zhes pa ni: yul phun sum tshogs pa ni 'dzam gling kha ba can gyi yul ljongs/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni byin rlabs rgyud kyis 'brel zhing rig 'dzin lung gis zin pa/ slob ma phun sum tshogs pa ni dad pa dang shes rab brtson 'grus tshang ba/ maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni bdag lus 'byor ba bu dang chung ma yul dang bcas pa phul nus pa dgos zhes pas/ 'o na thob dka' ba dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus gtsang ma rin po che thob/ yul phun sum tshogs pa gling mchog khyad par can 'dir las 'phro dang ldan pas 'khod/ mjal dka' ba ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon dang mjal/ lam zab mo gsang sngags rlabs po che sdig po che gsang lam du 'khrid pa'i dbang mchog zab mo bskur ba la dad ldan rnams kyi rig pa'i khye'u chung gis legs par nyon/ thar pa'i lam sna da res zin pa'i dus 'dir dam pa'i chos la 'jug dgos/ 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba/ rgya mtshor gzings thag chad pa'i tshong pa lta bu/ 'dab chags rnyi la zin pa lta bu/ 'jigs bcas kyi/ sa lam nor ba lta bu/ gshed ma'i dkyil du tshud pa lta bu/ dug sbrul gdug pa'i tshang lta bu las thar bar bya dgos/

dal 'byor mi lus rin po che thob pa'i dus su don chen zhig sgrub dgos te/ yang yang 'di 'dra shin tu rnyed par dkon/ de yang 'jig sla ba ni mi rtag pa sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam dang glog gi rang bzhin can/ deng 'chi sang 'chi cha ma mchis pa/ 'di lta bu'i dus su so so'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis 'chi ba mi dran nas sdig pa rngam po che bsags pa 'di rnams ni snying re rje/ bdag kyang dus de ring nas dam pa'i chos kho na byed pa cog bzhag ces dam bca' bzung*/ gsum pa bdag cag ni 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta yan chod du 'khrul zhing 'khyams/ de'ang rgyu dge ba'i 'bras bus bde 'gro mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna zin/ mi dge ba'i 'bras bus ngan song ste rigs drug gi duḥkha myong zhing thar pa'i dus ma mchis pas der mi skye ba'i thabs bya'o snyam pa'i blo rgya bskyed la dad gus kyis mchi ma snying nas phyung ba zhig dgos shing*/ rgyud las/ sems bskyed dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /ma gyur rigs drug sems can rnams/ /yang dag don chen 'grub pa yin/ /byang chub sems bskyed dam bca' zungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don 'gro drug sems can thams cad pha ma'i 'du shes bzhag pa'i sems nam mkha' mtha' bral lta bu dgos shing*/ yang rgyud las/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i mi lus 'di/ /'jig sla yang yang thob par dka'/ /don chen 'bras bu brtsam pa la/ /mi dge spang zhing nyes ltung 'dzems/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dge ba dag la 'bung zhing sdig pa phran bu'ang mi bya bar snying nas 'dzem dgos shing*/ dge bcu bsod nams stobs dag gis/ /bde 'gro mtho ris go 'phang 'thob/ /mtshams med pham ltung nyes smin gyis/ /rigs drug ngan song duḥkha myong*/ /de'i phyir rgyu 'bras kho na'o/ /zhes pas/ las dge ba'i rnam smin gyis bde 'gro mtho ris thob cing mi lus su'ang bu nor chos kyis phyug /mtshams med sdig byas kyis dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod blag med par myong ngo*/

/de yang pad+ma'i bka' lung las/ da lta'i lus 'di sngon gyi las kyis bsgyur: phyi ma'i lus ni da lta'i las kyis bsgyur: zhes gsungs pas/ lha dang bla ma la dred po'i chos bzhi dang bral ba'i ngang nas gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa dang dam tshig mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung ba gal che'o/ /de'ang rgyud las/ dus ngan mar 'grib rgyu 'bras rang gzugs kyis snod bcud sems can rnams la 'phel 'grib 'byung ba ni: sems can phrag dog gdug rtsub che ba yis: srid pa rlung gi 'khor lo gyen du log: char med nam mkhar me yi bskal pa 'char: rtsi shing 'bru zad lo tog myu gu skam: ri klung med par sad ser skya yam chags: sa bon mang rab 'bras bu shin tu dkon: grong pa phal cher chus khyer yul stong lus: de ni phrag dog 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can 'dod chags srid pa che ba yis: 'byung ba las kyi me dpung rab tu 'khrugs: dbyar dgun go ldog zla ba khod mi snyoms: dus char rlung 'gyur dus min dug char 'bebs: me las gyur pa'i tshad rims 'go nad dang : sha khol stag rgya kha tham stong grib dang : sa glang nag po srin glang par+pa ta: dmar bshal la sogs bdun drug nad rigs dar: me dpung 'khrug cing lo bcud than pas skam: ri byi dkar nag khra gsum lo la sdang : byol song yod kyang zho mar shin tu dkon: longs spyod phal cher sngar gyi ro bcud yal: lo re bzhin du mu ge'i bskal pa dar: de ni 'dod chags 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can zhe sdang drag po bskyed pa las: rak+ta srid pa'i chu klung rab tu 'khrigs: de yi rkyen gyis bdud rigs 'byung po dar: lo re bzhin du mtha' dmag dbus su bsnyeg: dbus dang mtha' gnyis go log mi min chags: phyi nas bdud kyi dmag dpung sprin ltar 'khrigs: bar du lha sde mi sdes dgon khag 'khrug: nang du dmag mi yul gru grong mi 'khrug: phyogs kyi sprang po bya bral rnams kyang 'khrug:

phyug po rnams kyi tshe srog nor gyis gcod: dmangs po rnams kyis za 'dod gnyis med phung : khyad par rgyal bsen ma mo gri bo 'khrug: rgyal 'gong 'khrug pa'i kha rlangs cho 'phrul las: ban btsun dam med phal cher smyo bar 'gyur: bud med snying rlung lang bas lha babs mang : rgyal po yul 'dres 'thab pa'i kha rlangs las: khyi rnams smyo 'bog ri klung nags chu nyul: ma mo'i rgyal po 'khrug pa'i kha rlangs las: lo tog mi skye sa yi bcud rnams bsdus: zhing kha rnams kyang dbus stong mtha' ru don: rlung dmar 'tshub dang sad ser rab tu ldang : ma mo dang ni klu bdud 'khrug pa yi: kha rlangs dug mda' nag po zhes bya ni: sa la gnas tshe lhog yams drag po 'tshub: mi dang srog chags phal che de yis 'chi: bar du srin bu ra tsa zhes bya 'byung : gzugs brnyan kha dog 'dra min sna tshogs kyis: 'bru bcud sa bcud rtsi thog brlag par 'gyur: 'o ma dkar yang bcud kyi mar ni med: lo tog skyes kyang 'bras bu'i rdog po chung : mi rnams thams cad chos kyi bag chags yal: srin po mi ma yin gyi gzugs ltar 'gyur: dai ni sems can zhe sdang drag po yi: las kyi 'bras bu dus der smin pa yin: sems can nga rgyal gdug rtsub skyes pa yis: srid pa sa yi rlung rnams shin tu sdang : de yi rkyen gyis pho lha dgra lha 'khrug: ma rgyud rten 'brel de yi sna drangs nas: pha dang bu gnyis mi 'chams rtsod cing 'khrug: pha spun chags sdang dme 'khrug nang rgyas byed: ka cha longs spyod 'thab rtsod zas la 'dzad: pho tshod mi zin rang mgo mi la 'chor: sngar gyi spyod 'gros yul shul rnams kyang stong : don med 'khur len rang srog mi sgor skyel: mtha' ma 'di phyi gnyis med don la thug: de ni phrag dog 'bras bu smin pa yin: sems can gti mug drag po 'thibs pa'i tshe: ma rig srid pa'i bdud bzhi'i rlung rnams 'khrug:

de yi rkyen gyis lus gdon nad gdon 'khrug: zog po dge bshes ban btsun pho mo dang : 'jig rten mi nag skyes pa las ngan rigs: chos la blo log mi dge sdig la dad: mtshan ldan bla ma sha gzugs sangs rgyas la: skyon du blta zhing smad pa'i rgyal mtshan phyar: gsang sngags mi bsgom sangs rgyas chos la 'bar: rgyu 'bras bslu med dge bcu khyad du gsod: yon tan ldan la sgro skur khrag kyang byug: 'di phyi'i thar pa'i 'ju thag ma lus gcod: tshe rabs gtan gyi bde 'gro dag kyang yal: cung zad 'dun pa skyes kyang phyi mjug thung : sems bskyed phan par 'dod kyang bdud dbang 'gro: drin gyis bskyangs pa'i sgo nor log par gsod: bzang por 'dod kyang ngan dbang skyon la shor: yin pa brgya bas ngan pa gcig gis bsgrib: sdug bsngal mi 'dod bzhin du khur gyis gnon: lus la nad mang sems la zug rngu che: lus sems dga' bder nyin gcig sdod dbang med: mi lus thob kyang mi tshe sdug la 'dzad: ci byed thams cad mi dge mtshams med las: lto med gos dbul yi dwags grong khyer 'dra: sha za khrag 'thung srog gcod srin po 'dra: dge med sdig chen shan pa'i yul gling 'dra: khrims med rku rdzun ya pho'i tshong 'dus 'dra: mna' za khrel med dam sri'i 'gyu lam 'dra: rgyu nag gnyen sdang long bas 'thab rtsod 'dra: kha dkar zhe gyong chu rdo dar gtums 'dra: bsam ngan ma rabs 'chi kha'i longs spyod 'dra: blo rmongs byed rgyu rkang bzhi'i bsam pa 'dra: grangs mang nad ngan rgyal 'gong tshong lam 'dra: de ni gti mug 'bras bu smin pa yin: de rnams thams cad snyigs ma lnga brgyar tshogs: rang byas las kyi rnam smin 'khor ba las: yid smod lha la byas pas ci la phan: sems can las ngan dug lnga rags pas lan: bsod nams zad bzhin chos la khyad gsod pas: rims nad rim bzhin dar zhing sdug tu 'gro: dper na btsan dug za bzhin langs pa 'dra:

ban de log lta can la sangs rgyas sdug: dper na chu bo gyen du ldog pa 'dra: mu stegs tshig bal bden pa'i chos la sdug: dper na g.yang sar lam 'phrang chad dang mtshungs: 'on kyang rung bas mi lus thob pa bzhin: dge bcu kun gyi nang nas dag snang gtso: mos gus kun gyi nang nas smon lam gtso: 'brel ba kun gyi nang nas dad pa gtso: yon tan kun gyi nang nas nyams len gtso: sgom sgrub kun gyi nang nas 'dun pa gtso: gsog 'jog kun gyi nang nas chog shes gtso: rgod po kun gyi nang nas chos rgod gtso: mkhas pa kun gyi nang nas tshod zin gtso: kha bshad kun gyi nang nas gnad 'gag gtso: shes pa kun gyi nang nas sdod shes gtso: de dag kun gyi nang nas nyams len gtso: de ni dgos pa dus bab rnam bzhi'i chos: go shes dbang po tshang rnams dang du longs: phyi mi 'phro bzang 'dod na bag yod kyis: blun rmongs dud 'gro'i tshogs kun ma lags na: lnga brgya'i dus 'dir bla mar mos gus gtso: 'di ni spyi bshad dus rim mdo tsam mo: khyad par 'gro don dang 'dul zhing ma 'ongs nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib bskal pa'i rlung g.yos pa ltar 'byung : ru bzhi'i dmag khṛms thams cad chu tshan khol ba ltar 'khrug: sems can gyi bde skyid 'dzad: khyad par nad rims sngar ma grags pa rnams dar: mi rnams tshe 'phrang bdud kyi dbang du 'gro: chos byed nyung zhing sdig spyod mang bas sems can rnams kyi bde 'gro mtho ris kyi them skas chag ste ngan song gi g.yang du lhung : de'i tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon 'di nyid zab cing 'brel tshad don ldan byang chub lam sna zin zhing phyir mi ldog pa mang du 'byung ste: spyan ras gzigs kyis sngon bskal pa 'bum phrag tshad med pa'i sngon du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od stong gi rgyal po zhi bar gnas pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ sangs rgyas des spyan ras gzigs bdag la phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs gsungs nas phyag gser gyi mdog can gyis spyi bor byug ste lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba'i tshe/

spyan ras gzigs kyis ma 'ongs par mig stong lag stong yod pas 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i smon lam btab bo: de yang sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtsho gling du me tog u dum wa rar brdzus te sku 'khrungs shing 'khor ba dong nas sprugs/ 'jig rten na sems can gcig kyang med par mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod do/ /de nas shar phyogs ri bo tā lar byon te slar gzigs pa na sems can ni sngar bas mang ba byung bas snying rje bzod blag med pa skyes te dbu lus tshal pa stong du gas so/ /de'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis dbu lus tshal par gas pa rnams bsgrigs te spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong du byin gyis brlabs te/ a mi dhe was rigs bdag mdzad nas 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'gro don gyis shig gsungs nas dbugs dbyung ngo*/ /de nas phyag stong gis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong du sprul/ spyan stong gis bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong du sprul te 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ khyad par du bod kha ba can gyi lha skal ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ chos skal ni gsung yi ge drug pa yin te/ de'i phyir lung las/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sa le'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i dus su/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum 'di ri dwags dang rkyang gis bzung*/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi ni ri dwags dang spre'us bzung*/ smad mdo kham sgang drug 'di spre'u dang brag srin mos bzung zhing ngam grog che/ g.yang sa mang*/ mtha' 'khob sha za gdong dmar gyi yul 'jigs su rung ba zhig yod pa la/ 'phags pa'i thugs rje las byung ba'i spre'u zhig gis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos shing bzhugs par/ sgrol ma khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa brag srin mo zhig 'ong zhing khyim thabs byed pa'i tshul bstan te tho 'tshams pas spre'us ci bzhin 'phags pa la bka' 'dri zhus pas khyod kyi rgyud la ston pa'i bstan pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas khyim thabs bya rung gsungs nas zas su 'bru sna lnga bskur/

gser phye khyor gang bod yul gyi phyogs su gtor nas thugs rje'i rjes su bzung ngo*/ /dus su bab par gyur nas pha ma gnyis dang mi 'dra ba'i bu zhig skyes pa/ kha ba can gyi mi ste de dag du mar 'phel zhing sa steng gang bar byung ba la/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa 'di'o/ /ji ltar na/ yul yar lung du sangs rgyas 'od srung gi sprul pa rgyal po tho ri snyan shal byon/ rje de'i sku mkhar yum bu bla sgang gi steng du spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo za ma tog gi yang snying gsung yi ge drug ma bod kha ba can gyi chos skal du nam mkha' nas babs pas bod du dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ 'di nas mi rabs lnga nas don shes par 'ong zhes rmi lam du lung bstan pa bzhin du/ rgyal rabs lnga pa'i dus su spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dngos chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po zhes spyi gtsug tu 'od dpag med bzhugs pa de'i sku dus su ri bo gru 'dzin gyi pho brang po tā las thog drangs/ gtsug lag khang stong phrag gcig bzhengs sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi rnam 'phrul rgya bza' dang bal bza' gnyis khab tu bzhes/ jo shāka rin po che rnam gnyis gdan drangs lo tsā thu mi sam+bho ṭa rgya gar du byon nas chos thams cad bod du bsgyur/ chos dge bcu'i khrims bcas/ de'i dus su chos rgyal chen po'i thugs dam yi ge drug pas bod yul 'dzam gling yangs pa'i sems can thams cad la thar pa'i lam sna 'dren zhing ma ṇi bka' chen sogs zhal gdams mang du bstsal ba dang*/ gzhan yang mdo za ma tog /rgyud don yod zhags pa sogs mdo rgyud tshad las 'das pa'i dgongs don gyi snying po yi ge drug pa ni/ dmyal ba 'joms pa'i sag rdar/ bar do gcod pa'i satwa re/ mtho ris bgrod pa'i rta pho/ mun pa sel ba'i sgron me/ dngos grub stsol ba'i nor bu 'di ni 'jig rten gsum na khyad du 'phags pa'i dam chos yin te/

om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzlas brjod byas na ngan song du mi skye/ mnar med par mi skye/ mdo sde za ma tog las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan dran pa de dag ni bde ba dang ldan pa lags so/ /skye ba dang rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su thar pa lags so/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas snang ba mtha' yas las chos nyan par 'gyur to/ /de dag gi lus la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ rgyud la nyon mongs pa dang bkres pa dang skom pa dang phongs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams mi 'byung*/ mngal na gnas pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ chos kyis bskyed pa'i pad+ma la brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yi dam du bsten par mdzad de/ sangs rgyas zhing de rtag tu 'dzin cing gnas zhes dang*/ om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes lan gcig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni tshad kyang bgrang bar mi nus so/ /ri rab gling bzhi'i rdul phran rnams bgrang du gtub kyang yi ge drug pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /'jig rten na chu klung che phra ji snyed gcig yod pa rnams chu thigs par bsags la re re bzhin bgrang du gtub kyang yi ge drug pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni bgrang du med do/ /'jig rten khams kyi rtsi shing dang bye ma rnams bgrang du gtub kyang yi ge drug pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni bgrang du mi nus gsungs so/ /gang zhig yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags ni lus la 'chang bas btags grol yin/ mig gi mthong bas mthong grol yin/ rna bar thos pas thos grol yin/ tshe 'di la yi ge drug pa'i thugs dam nar mar byed pa'i mi de la/ nad kyi bskal pa dang*/ mu ge'i bskal pa dang*/ mtshon gyi bskal pa sogs bskal pa bar ma rnams mi 'byung zhing*/ me chu dug mtshon sogs 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las thar zhing nor bu pad+ma can yin te/

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gor ma chag go /om̐ ni lha'i thub pa dbang po brgya byin yin te/ pham ltung gi sdug bsngal las grol zhing nga rgyal lha'i skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes so/ /ma ni lha ma yin gyi thub pa thag bzang ris yin te 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal las grol zhing phrag dog lha ma yin gyi skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes so/ /ṇi ni mi'i thub pa shākya thub pa yin te skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol zhing 'dod chags mi'i skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes so/ /pad ni byol song gi thub pa seṅge rab brtan yin te glen lkugs kyi sdug bsngal las grol zhing gti mug byol song gi skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes so/ /me ni yi dwags kyi thub pa kha 'bar ma yin te dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las grol zhing ser sna yi dwags kyi skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes so/ /hūm̐ ni dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal po yin te tsha grang gi sdug bsngal las grol zhing zhe sdang dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod nas sangs rgyas kyi sa brnyes pa yin no/ /gzhan yang yi ge drug po ni pha rol tu phyin drug gi rang gzugs bsod nams kyi zhing dam pa yin te thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la mnga' brnyes pa yin no/ /de bzhin du om̐ āḥhūm̐ om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: zhes pa ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi snying po yin/ om̐ ma ṇi pad+ma hūm̐: zhes pa ni gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i chos kyi yang snying yin te gang zhig 'di 'chang ba'i skyes bu ni shi 'phos nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ nam zhig 'od dpag med kyi rgyal tshab spyan ras gzigs dpal brtsegs rgyal po'i bstan pa la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gnyis su'ang zhal ta dang dam chos nyan par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/

ston pa shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das khar bod kha ba can 'di nga'i zhabs kyis ma bcag pas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs khyod kyis thul cig gsungs nas zhal chems gnang ba'i don gyis/ nged rang bod kyi lha skal ma 'chug pa yin zhing spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan yid la dran cing the tshom med par gsol ba btab na me dang*/ chu dang*/ gcan gzan chom rkun dang dgra dang rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ stag seṅge sbrul ro langs bya dang sha za dbul phongs la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar ba dang dug mtshon rims nad mu ge'i gnod pas mi tshugs shing*/ tshe 'phos nas kyang ngan song dang mi khom par nam yang mi ltung bar bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing du skye bar gsungs so/ /o rgyan pad+ma srin yul du byon khar bod thams cad la zhal chems bzhag pa las kyang*/ om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: yi ge drug pa 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi yang snying yin pas zhag re la brgya re bzlas na ngan song gsum du mi skye zhing phyi ma mi lus gtsang ma thob nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na skye ba 'di la sdig pa thams cad zad nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan nyer gcig bzlas na yid gzhung bar 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi don la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /zhag re bzhin lan 'ga' brjod pas sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /bkra shis bsod nams 'phel/ tshe rabs gar skyes kyang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /mi gang dag gdon gyis nyen pa la 'jig rten gyi rkyen bzlog byas pa bas yi ge drug pa bzlas pas bsod nams che'o/ /sman dpyad dang bcos ka ci byas kyang yi ge drug pa bzlas pas nad sos/ bod kha ba can gyi lha skal yin pas dad gus mos pas gsol ba thob cig dang*/ byin rlabs 'phral du 'byung ste the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed cig

/chos 'di las zab pa med do/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag ni da 'gro bas/ bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyi thugs la de ltar zhog /ces gsungs so/ /da lam skabs su bab pa 'di ni bdag cag gi ston pas gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i chos gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na theg pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ de'ang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus te/ kun byed las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'o/ zhes dang*/ theg pa'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa thams cad las/ che ba drug gis khyad du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma 'di la'ang*/ phyogs bzhir dbus lnga'i gter kha chen po lnga dang*/ de la'ang*/ bla gter thugs gter la sogs pa'i dbye ba bco brgyad mchis pa'i nang tshan/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor mdo rgyud nyer gcig bka' gter gsar rnying gi lugs srol mtha' yas par bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni lho gter 'bras bu lta bu'i yang snying*/ bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig /ma rgyud mkha' 'gro yongs kyi snying khrag /thugs gter chen po lnga'i ya gyal 'di nyid kyang*/ rang gter las kyang*/ ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu mar 'grib la: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags pas: bka' bab lung gi gter la spyod pa'i tshe: nam mkha'i rgyal po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyis: snying thig zab mo yang gsang shog dril 'di: kho bo'i thugs kyi sras la sprod cig rgya: pad+ma shel phug tu sbos gter srung rgya: zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul de nyid kyi rigs ni dbang chen rus ni rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung brgyud/ lus la rtags rgya lnga dang ldan pa rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob pas lha srin bran du khol ba/ gsang chen ston pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa zhes 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa de nyid kyis/ brag gad pad+ma shel phug nas khrom sum brgya'i dbus su gter nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon zhes/

mkha' la rdo rje'i ra gur ma nyams pa la mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs bun ne dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol gyi brgyud rim ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ spyan ras gzigs/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ rtsa gsum gling pa/ dkon mchog seṅge/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ 'phags pa rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa dge legs/ bstan 'dzin don grub/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ karma o rgyan/ bla rgan mkhyen rtse/ des sgo chen 'dus grwa la'o/ /yang na/ karma o rgyan nas rnam sprul pad+ma tshe dbang phrin las 'dus pa la/ /des nyi ma 'od zer la/ des bdag cag rnams la'o/ /zhes brgyud pa'i zam ma chad pa las 'dir dbang bskur ba'i rim pa de sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ slob dpon gyi bya ba grub zin/ da slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag phul zhing thal sbyar dang bcas pas 'khod la/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa'i nang du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos snyim pa'i me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas: dug lnga bag chags brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: gnas lugs mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rang byung zhing khams nas: bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus chos skur 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams nas: ma dad 'khrul snang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du:

pad 'byung rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab spyod bde chen drwa ba'i zhing khams nas: mtshan 'dzin phung po brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: ye shes mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs: rtsa rlung bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs: gtum drag me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas: rta mchog dbang chen sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi'i bar chad sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog pad+ma shel gyi sgrub phug nas: dam chos zil gnon rgyud la gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya gnyer gtad drag po'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong gza' mchog rgyal por gsol ba 'debs: bstan pa'i bya ra 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs: gdung bas rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: ma gyur pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog:

lan gsum/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ de nas chos thams cad kyi 'jug sgo'am rmang gzhir gyur pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dbyer med dus gsum gyi dkon mchog /skyabs yul kun 'dus su nges pa'i spyan sngar dgra gnyen ris su ma chad pa'i ma gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir snying rjes byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du/ lam zab mo thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni/ bla na med pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mi nyams par bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir mna' chu sbyin pa yin pas snyan gsan 'tshal/ dung zhal nang du bdud rtsi a mṛ ta chu dang sbyar ba de lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor dgos te/ ci zhe na/ lan gsum gyis ni/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum ste/ ma byin pa len pa mi gtsang spyod pa/ srog gcod pa sogs dang*/ ngag gi mi dge bzhi ste/ rdzun dang*/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'chal pa dang*/ yid kyi mi dge ba gsum ste/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste/ mi dge ba bcu'i sgrib pa dag pa'i ched dang*/

'phro ma rgyab tu dor bas ma dag 'khor ba ngan song dang rigs drug thams cad la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i brda mtshon par mos shig / dam chu thogs la/ hūm̐: 'di ni byang chub snying po'i chu: gsang sngags mos pa'i ye shes 'gyur: sngags la mi mos log lta can: dam tshig nyams pa'i dug chur 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: log lta can la shin tu gsang : zhes dam chu sbyin/ rdo rje'i bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ badz+ra na ra ka a su pre nṛ sa ma ya: i dan+te badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐: lan gsum 'thung la 'phro ma rgyab tu dor/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sngags 'dis byin brlabs bya/ om̐ badz+ra he ru ka yak+sha kā la badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdud pa'i sngags ni: raṃ tri tri tsakra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags/ de'ang dpung skud sbyin pa la phyag srol mi 'dra ba pho g.yon mo g.yas sogs bzhed pa mang yang tshul 'dir pho mo gnyis ka'i g.yon du 'dogs par gsungs pa/ ci zhe na/ de'i phyogs su nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi 'gyu lam gyi rtsa yod pas de ma 'ching na nyon mongs pa'i rtsa rgyud nas bar chad kyi rkyen zhugs pas/ rang lus 'dom gang gru bzhir srung skud 'dom gang de ye shes rigs lnga mtshon pas kha dog lnga ldan dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas gdab phyir rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor ba 'di nyid 'dogs pas nang ltar na ma dag nyon mongs pa thams cad dang*/ phyi ltar na rlung mkhris bad kan thams cad srung zhing dag pa ye shes kyi rtsa sgo bye/ 'bras bu sku gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon sum du zhal mjal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi legs mtshon pa: dam tshig sems pa gnas pa la: ye shes phab nas brtan pa'i phyir: de ring rdo rje'i rgya chings gdab: om̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsakra tsakra badz+ra tsakra swā hā:

zhes dpung par mdud/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab/ rmi lam brtag phyir skye med kyi yi ge āḥre gtad/ om̐ dang po skye med stong pa āḥ bar du 'gags med gsal snang āḥ tha ma bde stong 'dzin med āḥ rang sems dri med āḥdakar sgom: om̐ a a āḥ snying gar gtad/ de nas gdan ku sha gtad pa ni/ om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa sogs kyis bsang : swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs kyis sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las dhī dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i ku sha sngo ljang rma bya'i mgrin mdog ltar 'jam la reg na bde ba/ slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs shing gsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur: dhīḥhūm̐: bdun tsam bzlas rjes/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa de nyid mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sgo nas zhing 'dir phebs te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sngon chu bo nai rañdza na'i nye 'gram ma gha dha'i shing la sku'i rgyab gtad cing*/ rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan la skyil krung bcas nas dran pa mngon sum du bzhag ste byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ deng 'dir smin grol gyi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum smin par bya ba la rten 'brel zab mo'i rmi lam du legs nyes brtag pa'i rtswa ring ba rtse mo mdun du bstan nas sngas pa dang*/ thung ba gdan byas pa'i steng du seṅge nyal stabs kyis gnyid log la mgo dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su gtod/ rmi lam gang shar ba de sba gsang med par smra bar bya'o/ hūm̐: sngon byon rig 'dzin grub thob kyis: 'jag spyil phub nas ku sha yis: gdan byas rnam snang chos bdun gnas: de yi rten 'brel rtswa 'di zungs: om̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na dha ra gharba sid+dhi hoḥ zhes sbyin/ dkyil 'khor la so shing dor ba ni/ de yang slob dpon gyis so shing sbyin pa'i dus thal sbyar bar du blangs: rjes zlos kyi tshe mkha' dbyings phyag rgya zhes mthe bong lto sbyar ba'i bar so shing gi rtsa ba bzung nas sos 'cha' ba'i tshul dang*/

sor mo rnams thad kar brkyang ba'i gung mos so shing gi rtse mo me tog dang ldan pa bzung : de lta bu'i phyag rgyas so shing cung zad sos 'cha' ba dang lhan cig dmigs pa so shing las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis khong pa'i nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad/ sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin nag 'dur gyis phyir thon te dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim song snyam pa dang*/ sngags lung 'bog pa'i āḥde sems nyid dbye ba med pa de nyid rtse mo me tog 'dor yul gyi maṇ+ḍa lar gtad de dngos grub kyi mtshan ma gsal por ston cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ drug ldan rdo rje lus kyi dbu ma ru: skye med snying rje'i yi ge āḥdakar brgyan: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na: tshe rabs 'di phyi'i rten 'brel gang 'grub ston: om̐ dharma mu la puṣ+pa mu ṭa gar+bha āḥ zhes thams cad kyis dor/ ji bzhin gyen du phyogs na rten 'brel rab yin: thad kar sdod na snying rus dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bya: mgo mjug ldog na bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa bzang po bya: so shing gi mgo bo g.yas su gtad na zhe sdang yin: g.yon du 'dod chags yin: mgo nar mor 'phrad pa gti mug yin: zhe sdang la tshe thar gtong : 'dod chags la sbyin pa bya: gti mug la dkar me brgya tshar sogs gang mang*/ thams cad ngan na ngan 'gro yin pas dge ba rlabs chen bya: ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung : lhag par tshogs brgya sāts+tsha dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos so: de nas so shing gi cod pan de spyi bor btags nas sgom lung 'bog pa ni: hūm̐: deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sgor zhugs nas: yi dam spang blang mi bya zhing : dkyil 'khor 'di la gtso bo gyis: om̐ badz+ra mu tra sarba kā ya badz+ra dha ra hūm̐: zhes cod pan spyi bor brgyan/

'di'i don lnga ni: dam chu kha ru blud pa dam tshig mi nyams pa'i khas len: mna' tho rang chad kyi rnam dbye: cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags/ dpung skud legs par 'dogs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgya chings: āḥsnying khar sgom pa sems mi 'khrul ba'i dam 'dzer: rtswa gdan 'og tu 'deng ba sgrub pa mthar ma phyin bar mi 'gul ba'i dam bca' ste sngon du 'gro ba'i gzer bu lnga'o: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni/ thams cad kyi phyag rgya spyi bor thal mo sbyar la rdor sems sgom lung 'bog pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ bdag lus spyi gtsug dung khang pho brang ste: rdo rje sems dpa' dri med shel gyi mdangs: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes phyag rgya can: snyems ma dkar sngon rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: yab yum zung 'jug 'khril thabs skyil krung bzhugs: lha rdzas rin chen rgyan mdzes thugs ka ru: hūm̐ yig mtha' ru yi ge brgya pa ni: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas sdig sgrib bag chags dag: chu zla snang bzhin dri med rjen par shar: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: yig brgya bzla/ de dag gi sta gon gyi chos rnams grub bo/ dngos gzhi la sgrub cing mchod pa sogs spyi ltar song ste/ khrus nas dbyung ba bgegs bskrad pa/ lo rgyus rnams ci rig pa song*/ maṇ+ḍal skyabs sems rnams gong ltar bya'o/ de nas yan lag bdun pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du spel ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar/ yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bya bar 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod:

na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: de nas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma dang yi dam thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ pha ma 'gro drug kun theg chen gyi lam la 'god pa'i don du sems bskyed pa dang phar phyin drug thabs stobs smon lam sogs kyi sdom pa bzung snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems bdag la dgongs: bdag gis deng bzung byang chub bar: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas: tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa bsrung : bzod pa dka' thub brtson 'grus brtsam: ting 'dzin bsgoms nas shes rab 'chang : sbyin gtong smon lam thabs stobs 'byin: bud+dha rdo rje rat+na dang : pad+ma karma bi shwa yis: dug lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga: phung po lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dam tshig bzung : om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: ces sngon 'gro rnams grub/ da dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ sngon chad ma rig pas ye shes kyi mig ldongs shing sgrib pa dang bcas par mtshon pa'i brdar ras yug dmar po res gdong g.yogs par 'tshal: om̐ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐: zhes mig dar 'chang*/ slad nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyag stong du mjal mi rung bas/ phyag rten du u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i mchog gi me tog rnam pa lnga'i chun po yang zhing ma nyams pa re thogs par mos shig:

om̐ puṣ+pe sid+dhi hūm̐: me tog gtad/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zab mo la/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma nyid: rdo rje slob dpon rigs kyi bdag: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor du: bdag 'jug bka' stsal zhu ba'i rten: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang : zhing khams yul zhing chung ma bcas: 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya dang : grangs med 'jig rten dang bcas te: 'dzam gling 'di ru bkod nas kyang : maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bkram pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na: dbang bskur rjes su gnang ba stsol: om̐ badz+ra bhū mi i pa maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni/ khe nyes gnyis kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ hoḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po yi: dam tshig srog ltar srung ba 'di: snying la ye shes lha rnams gnas: dam nyams rnams la gshin rjer 'gyur: om̐ lo ha biṣatshas ha la i dan+te swā hā: de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag kyang snying gi dkyil du babs pas/ gal te dam tshig las 'gal na badz+ra yak+sha kro dha zhes bya ba sdig ltung zhing nyam thag par 'gyur la/ dam tshig bsrungs na lha ye shes sems dpar gyur nas snying ga ru byin gyis brlabs shing*/ 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus par ster bar 'gyur la/ zhes dam chu sbyin/ rdo rje'i bro bor ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ skal ldan dam tshig gnas pa rnams: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: khyed rnams 'jug cing smin pa'i phyir: dbang mchog bskur phyir legs par ltos: slob mas/ mig dbye bar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni grangs med 'khor bar 'khyams: a 'thas bag med 'khrul 'khor gyi: nyon mongs ling thog gis bsgribs pa:

dam pa'i thugs rjes phye bar mdzod: ces dang*/ zhes gsol ba btab pas ma rig pa nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum gyis ling thog 'dis bsgribs pa la smin byed dbang gi sgor zhugs nas/ rig pa gnas lugs ye shes kyi thur ma 'dis bsal zhing sa bcu lam lnga dang ldan nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje'i thur ma thogs la/ hūm̐: nga ni zag bcas 'khrul rgya zhig: 'khrul med shes rab spyan dang ldan: rtsal spros ye shes thur ma yis: khyod kyi a 'thas sgrib mun bsal: om̐ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces mig dar bsal/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan la phyag shing gis mtshon te lha ngo sprad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni spyan gzigs 'dus pa'i gtso: lha khrid bskyed rim phyi la bkram: brda don gsum gyi ngo bo sprad: gnas lugs dkyil 'khor nang du bkod: 'gyu 'ong gsum gyi ngo bo sprad: bskyed rdzogs nyi zla kha sbyor tshul: zung 'jug gnyis med ngo bo sprad: skal ldan rnams kyis legs par nyon: om̐ dharma shū n+ya ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: 'di'i yan dkyil 'khor mjal bar byed pa'i dam bca' bzung ba'o/ /brda sgo'o/ hoḥ de'ang skal ldan rnams legs par gsan 'tshal: deng 'dir thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor zab mo zhal phyes nas: skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la ngo sprod bgyis pa yin pas: thog mar gzhi nam mkha' kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i klong du snod kyi snang ba dang bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam pas mkha' klong gi dkyil 'khor bkod pa ni: chos sku'i rol rtsal ma 'gags pa'o: gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rin po che sna tshogs kyi tog bcas phyi nang gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa ni: longs sku sgyu ma mkhan gyi zhing khams bkod pa'o:

pad phreng dur khrod rdo ra me ri sogs/ de rnams kyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni: longs sku'i rgyan 'phyang la rnam pa ma nges pa'i rol rtsed cho 'phrul sna tshogs kyi don no: dkyil 'khor chen po de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku mdog dkar gsal 'od du 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis par dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing zhabs phyed pa'i skyil krung lam du bzhugs pa ni: rigs drug 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos 'gro kun thugs rjes skyob pa'i brda: yum dbyangs can dmar gsal rdo rje dung dmar gyis mgul nas 'khyud c-ing bzhugs pa ni: thabs shes zung 'jug bde stong rol pa'i brda: de'i spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag thog ma'i mgon po sku mdog dmar la pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan mnyam bzhag skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ni/ ye nas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan pa'i brda: phyogs bzhir thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi bzhugs pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes bzhi po mngon du gyur pa'i brda'o: yum chen ḍāk+ki rigs bzhis sku la 'khril ba ni 'byung lnga gnas su dag cing lam bzhi mthar phyin pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir sgo ma rigs bzhi bzhugs pa ni: bdud bzhi bcom nas tshad med rnam bzhis bde stong rol pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu drwa ba sham bu me long me tog phreng ba nyi zla mda' dar ral gri stag sham thod phreng rus rgyan phur pa mda' gzhu cod pan gnam rgyan sa rgyan yol ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cha lag tshang zhing 'tshogs pa ni: rten 'brel dge mtshan du ma dang ldan te bar chad bdud kyis glags mi rnyed pa'i brda: rdo rje slob dpon la che ba'i rgyal chas kyis brgyan cing khri gdan phun sum tshogs pa'i khar bzhugs nas nyer mkho'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang :

khyad par phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni: skal ldan dam pa'i chos la spyod tshe: 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i brda'o: slob ma dad ldan pho mo thams cad rgyan gos mdzes pa'i chas dang ldan zhing gral du 'khod pa ni: phyis 'byung rgyan dar phun sum tshogs te rten 'brel 'phro bzang mthud nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du sleb par 'gyur ro: de ltar dkyil 'khor zab mo 'di 'dra'i sgor zhugs pa ni smon lam mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur pa yin no: 'o khyed rnams de snga phan dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ma mthong bas khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug tu 'khyams pa yin gyis kha sang phan chad shin tu col chung gis mi tshe stong zad byas pa don med de tsam byas: da ni dkyil 'khor 'di lta bur tshud cing mjal bas da lta shi yang bde ba chen por 'tshang rgya ba yin pas dga' ba dang spro ba sgoms shig:

thams cad kyis me tog mtheb srin bar du bzung la/ sngar byin pa'i me tog de nyid tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel ba'i lha skal la phog par shog cig snyam pas ltos pa med par 'dor te tshig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ bdag ni grangs med lus blangs dang : 'di dang phyi mar nyer len du: bsgrubs dang sgrub par byed pa yis: lhag pa'i lha dang bdag sprod cig: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes me tog dkyil 'khor du dor bas phyogs bzhi mtshams dang dbus sogs gang du phog pa'i rigs dang sbyar la dbus su babs na gsang mtshan/ rnam snang rdo rje'am mtha' yas rdo rje/ shar du mi bskyod rdo rje/ lhor rin chen rdo rje/ nub tu pad+ma rdo rje/ byang du las kyi rdo rje/ mtshams bzhir phrin las rdo rje sogs btags/ de nas cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa ni/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos phyag gis bzhes te slar yang dbang rtags cod pan gyi tshul du spyi bor bcings par mos shig: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags te: rigs lnga'i cod pan sa bon brgyan: deng 'dir lha dang skal pa mnyam: rtag tu chos 'di spyod par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ ku mu ṭa sarba pañtsa su pra tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: zhes cod pan mgor bzhag la rtag tu 'chang ba'am ci rigs bya/ khyed ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'tshang rgya ba'i ming ni: rig 'dzin gzhon nu 'od zer dpa' bo rnam par rol pa zhes par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro: de nas spyi bor rdau rje bzhag cing lag tu phur pa gtad la/ khyed rang rnams la phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du 'grub pa'i gsang ba srog gi phur pa 'di byin pas bla ma dang yi dam rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis phrin las bsgrubs/ dregs pa lha srin rnams kyis srog snying phul zhing*/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/
