hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: bla med dkyil 'khor srog ltar srungs: dam tshig rdo rje'i rgyas gdab nas: bar chad srung ba'i phur bu chongs: om̐ badz+ra tsakra: om̐ badz+ra kī la ya dha ra hūm̐: zhes pas gong ba la 'dogs/ de nas slob mar las bum chus bsang sbyangs la/ de nas dbang gi gzhi dgod pa la ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig: slob ma rnams/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ bsang*/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang slob ma rnams pam̐ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon sku mdog dkar gsal 'od du 'bar ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam bzhag gi zer las shel phreng dang pad dkar yu ba 'khril ba longs sku'i cha byad can mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa: sku la rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing : zhabs phyed pa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa: yum dbyangs can ma dmar mo dung dmar mgul nas 'khyud pa'o: de yi spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag thog ma'i mgon po sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs pa: phyogs bzhir thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi yab yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: shar phyogs ri bo tā la nas: thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon la: sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba sku che ba ri rib tsam chung ba nas 'bru tsam/ yang sprul rdul phran tsam/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos shig om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ

ār+ya lo ki shwa ri badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥphaiṃ phaiṃ: spyan 'dren spros pa ltar na/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: 'khor 'das zil gnon gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ hoḥ ye shes pa brtan par gyur cig: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rdo rje rgya gram bya/ slob dpon gyis/ hoḥ bla med yang gsang snying po mchog: ye shes sprul pa'i pho brang 'dir: skal ldan 'jug cing smin rlom na: dam tshig snying po 'bul bar gyis: slob mas/ zhes dris pa'i lan gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kyaiḥ rdo rje rgyal po rigs kyi bdag: theg chen gsang sngags mdzod kyi mchog: deng 'dir 'phags mchog dkyil 'khor du: dam bsrung skal ldan 'jug par stsol: de nas dung dmar gyi chu sbyin la/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa 'di la snyan gtod 'tshal: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: bsrungs na dngos grub sna tshogs rnyed: ma bsrung ngan song dmyal bar skye: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : dam tshig gi gnas la tshul bzhin du bslab bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ om̐ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes mna' chu sbyin/ sku bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas sku bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i sku'i dbang bskur ba yin te: bum pa 'di nyid phyi ltar na ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang : nang ltar na bum chu yi dam lha'i ngo bo yin pas: slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te: spyi bo'i gtsug nas sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: bum pa longs sku'i gzhal yas khang : bdud rtsi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs:

skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dbang lha dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: sku yi bkra shis mdzad du gsol: des sku'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gsung bhan+dha thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi dbang bskur ba yin te: bhan+dha 'di nyid phyi ltar na rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin: nang ltar na a haṃ byang sems dkar dmar yi dam lha'i ngo bo yin te: slob ma rnams kyi mgrin par dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te mgrin par sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: bhan+dha ye shes 'khor lo lnga: byang sems 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sngags dbang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: gsung gi bkra shis mdzad du gsol: des gsung gi dbang thob ngag gi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad nas sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: thugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas thugs kyi dbang me long ngam dkyil 'khor gang rung thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: dkyil 'khor 'di phyi ltar na chos dbyings thig le chen po'i dkyil 'khor:

nang ltar na yi dam lha'i thugs kyi ngo bo yin pas: slob ma rnams kyi snying khar bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas: snying khar sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor ka dag chos kyi dbyings: ngo bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chos dbyings dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: thugs kyi bkra shis mdzad du gsol: des thugs kyi dbang thob yid kyi sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad yid ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas yon tan gyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas gtor ma thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: gtor ma 'di nyid phyi ltar na rmad byung dngos grub 'byung ba'i dam rdzas: nang ltar na ro bcud yi dam lha yi ngo bo yin te: slob ma rnams kyi lte bar dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas lte bar sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: gtor ma rmad byung bla med rdzas: dngos grub bcud mchog spyan ras gzigs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zung 'jug las tshogs dbang thob shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra ghu ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: yon tan bkra shis mdzad du gsol: des yon tan gyi dbang thob: sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag: deng phyin chad dbang bskur 'chad rtsod sgom sgrub las su rung ste dbang :

'bras bu mchog thun dbyer med 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: phrin las kyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje rgya gram thogs la/ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thugs rje chen po'i yongs rdzogs phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: sku dang rdo rje rgya gram 'di: phyi ltar na yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lam du lhong : nang ltar na ting 'dzin mi shigs rdo rje lta bu'i rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur ba'i brda yin pas: slob ma rnams kyi gsang bar dbang bskur bas thugs rje chen po'i sku che phra 'bring gsum kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon te gsang gnas su sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūm̐: rdo rje'i sku mchog longs spyod rdzogs: spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum sku: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ri gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor: hoḥ 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal: nor bu pad+ma'i cod pan 'dzin: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: phrin las bkra shis mdzad du gsol: des phrin las kyi dbang thob bdag 'dzin phra rags kyi bag chags dag: deng phyin chad las mtha' sna tshogs kyi bya ba la dbang : 'bras bu yongs rdzogs 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas lha dbang yongs rdzogs zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas rigs bdag thogs la/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog ldan: ye shes drwa ba'i bdag nyid mchog: rigs kyi bdag po thog ma'i mgon: bla med theg chen dbang thob shog: om̐ a mi dhe wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: mtha' yas thugs rje'i sems can mgon gyur pa: gangs ri'i mdog can mnyam bzhag pad phreng 'dzin: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum skus: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang?

om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms: rnam snang spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: tsha grang dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rat+na spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi sdug bsngal 'joms: rat+na spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: pham ltung lha yi skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi sdug bsngal 'joms: pad+ma spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: 'dod chags mi yi skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥpad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: karma spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag lha min sdug bsngal 'joms: karma spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: phrag dog lha min skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bud+dha spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal 'joms: bud+dha spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: gti mug byol song skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi sku thogs la/ hūm̐: ser sna rnam dag yi dwags sdug bsngal 'joms: kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs dbang skur bzhengs nas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ser sna yi dwags skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ

sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: sa khams rnam dag mngal skyes sgo gcod ma: gsang ba'i yum chen sangs rgyas spyan ma yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ma dag mngal skyes skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mā ma kī'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: chu khams rnam dag sgong skyes sgo gcod ma: gsang ba'i yum chen mā kī ser mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ma dag sgong skyes skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gos dkar mo'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: me khams rnam dag drod skyes sgo gcod ma: gsang ba'i yum chen gos dkar dmar mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ma dag drod skyes skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: rlung khams rnam dag rdzus skyes sgo gcod ma: gsang ba'i yum chen dam tshig sgrol ma yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: ma dag rdzus skyes skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

lcags kyu dkar mo'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: shar phyogs sgo skyong lcags kyu dkar mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: byams pa tshad med tshogs lam mthar phyin shog: dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhags pa ser mo'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: snying rje tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: lho phyogs sgo skyong zhags pa ser mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: snying rje tshad med sbyor lam mthar phyin shog: hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lcags sgrog dmar mo'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: nub phyogs sgo skyong lcags sgrog dmar mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: dga' ba tshad med sgom lam mthar phyin shog: baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dril bu ljang mo'i sku thogs la/ hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: byang phyogs sgo skyong dril bu ljang mo yis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: btang snyoms tshad med mthong lam mthar phyin shog: hoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan sna tshogs kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: shel phreng pad dkar rdo rje dang : nor bu pad+ma lcags kyu dang : pad+ma zhags pa nor bu sgrog: dung dril me long dbang bskur ro: om̐ sarba bhi shwa dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: rigs lnga'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang : snyan rgyan mgul rgyan stod g.yogs mdzes: phyag gdub zhabs gdub se mo do: smad dkris dar tshon dbang bskur ro: om̐ bhi shwa ar+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rigs lnga'i tshom bu dang shel rdo thogs nas: hūm̐: snang stong lha sku grags stong sngags: dran stong shes rab ye shes sku: sna tshogs gsal stong ngo bo nyid: ngo sprod tshig gis dbang bskur ro: om̐ dharma swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ngos sprad pa ni/ hoḥ

tshom bu ye shes lnga dang ldan pa ni bskyed rim sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur yin pa'i brda: ngo sprod tshig ni grags stong yin pas 'byung 'jug sngags la dngos po bral ba'i brda: shel rdo'i 'gying log 'di snang stong yin pas: rig pa ka dag zang thal yin pa'i brda: bskyed rdzogs thams cad tshig gis mtshon tsam yin pas 'dus ma byas la rtag chad dang bral ba'i brda: de ltar phyi nang gi dbang bzhi legs par thob pa yin pas: bka' drin gtang rag gi yon gyis bla ma mnyes par byas so: da de rnams kyis rtsa ba'i dbang bskur rgyas pa grub nas mtha' rten bkra shis 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul: gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'chi med mgon po pad+ma 'byung : 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas skrag pa la: thugs rje chen pos nyer dgongs nas: tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lan gsum/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams 'chi med pad 'byung dngos su gsal la/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer grangs med 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe 'khyams pa yal ba stor cing gas pa chad nyams dang*/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung gi dwangs bcud stong gsum skye 'gro rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor/ rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus bcud thams cad bdud rtsi'i 'od zer khyed rang rnams la sib sib thib pas bla tshe dbang thang nyams pa sos/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams la thim pas rdo rje'i bcud len du gyur par sgoms shig: mda' dar g.yab la tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐: tshe yi bdag po 'chi med dbang gi lha: rig ma mkha' 'gro ḍāk+ki mched lnga yis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: 'ja' lus rdo rje tshe yi srog sgrubs shig: ces bskur/ 'chi med pad 'byung gi sku thogs la/

hrīḥ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu yi: tshe yi bdag po pad+ma dbang gi lhas: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog grub shog: om̐ gu ru ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mgyogs ma lnga'i tsakli thogs la/ hūm̐: rig ma mkha' 'gro ḍāk+ki mched lnga yis: steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun gyi tshe bcud sdus: skal ldan lus la 'od phung ltem gyis thim: mi shigs rdo rje lta bu'i skur grub shog: om̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yu sid+dhi pha la kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: tshe gwa thogs la/ hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rdo rje mi 'gyur klong yangs nas: pad+ma dbang chen tshe bdag he ru kaḥ ḍāk+ki tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' spyod dag pa 'chi med gnas nas bzhengs: sngon tshe rig 'dzin gsang ba'i tshe sgrub ltar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la stsal du gsol: ngo mtshar rmad byung yid 'ong lha yi gter: 'dod pa'i re skong 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud: kun 'byung dngos grub rtsa ba mchog stsol la: 'dzad med brgyud 'dzin smin pa'i dbang mchog bskur: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā yu sid+dhi pha la kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes spyi bor bskur/ tshe chang thogs la/ hūm̐: dam tshig rnam lnga'i rgyun lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: de ring skal ldan khyod la blud: zag med bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yu sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mgrin par bskur la myong*/ tshe ril thogs la/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das lha mi'i bcud bsdus nas: 'chi med zas mchog ril bu bsgril: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: 'dod yon longs spyod dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ni ha ri ni sa ā yu sid+dhi pha la tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying gar bskur la sbyin/ rgyas gdab ni/

tshe'i dwangs bcud thams cad snying kha'i gwa'u nang gi srog yig la thim: rdo rje'i rwa bas rgyas gdab: lus thams cad rdo rje chos bdun dang ldan pa'i go cha bgos nas nam yang skye 'chi gzhom zhig dang bral ba'i rtag brtan rdo rje'i phyag rgyas btab par mos la: mda' dar bzung la/ hūm̐: dang po chos dbyings nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa rig 'dzin drug gi rgya: bdun pa sangs rgyas rab bdun rgya: brgyad pa nye ba'i sras brgyad rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya: yab yum bcu yis rgyas gdab pas: nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa yi: ka dag ye shes gter sbas so: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ni ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na pad+ma hrīḥdha ya sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes spyi bor tshe mda' rgya gram du bkod pa'o/ /de nas mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i bka' bsgo med du mi rung ba ni/ da gtor ma 'di nyid thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dngos su gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi bla ma/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi bla ma/ gang zag snyan brgyud kyi bla ma/ drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs dang*/ bar gyi cha la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la dam pa ye shes kyi chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad/ sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba nas 'bru tsam/ yang sprul rdul phran tsam/ sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams la rgya mtshor kha ba babs pa ltar dbyer med du thim pas byin rlabs thams cad da lta nyid du thob par sgoms: hoḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro: longs sku thugs rje chen po:

rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: mchog sprul o rgyan rig 'dzin/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las/ kun bzang 'chi med nor bu/ rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug /rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje/ rig 'dzin snyan grags rgya mtsho/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje/ bka' bab kun dga' blo gros/ ngag dbang dkon mchog seṅge/ lung zin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ brgyud 'dzin ār+ya dh+wa dza/ phrin las rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa dge legs/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ karma o rgyan/ gnam sprul pad+ma phrin las/ nyi ma 'od zer/ des da lta'i brgyud 'dzin bcas dang*/ chos bdag rig 'dzin bcu gsum: bka' bab grub thob rtsa lnga la sogs pa drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyi sngon las 'phral rkyen du gyur pa'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig: nam zhig mi rtag 'pho ba'i dus su ma dag rigs drug gi skye sgo khegs nas bar do drug gi 'phrang las sgrol zhing sku gsum skye ba med pa'i don rtogs nas: shar phyogs ri bo tā lar yi dam thugs rje chen po'i sku dang dbyer med du sangs rgyas te 'gro don thogs pa med par 'byung bar gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma ṇi? kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs grub nas gzhan don dpag med la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo rin chen rnam bcu ldan: 'khor ba'i 'khor tshogs rgyun bcad nas: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed dbang : skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog:

om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: btsun mo rin chen bsod nams gter: pha rol phyin bcu'i gzugs dang ldan: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i dbang : yid bzhin dpal 'byor thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ wa tī rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: nor bu rin chen phun sum gnas: bsod nams tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: lhan cig nor bdun phyug par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: blon po rin chen blo gros ldan: gang la ji 'dod dpag bsam 'dra: gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs shing : shes bya thogs med dbang thob shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: ma hā ma ti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: dmag dpon rin chen stobs rtsal ldan: brtson 'grus go gyon 'khor ba 'joms: thabs ldan skyabs kyi dbang mchog 'dis: 'jig tshogs lta ba 'joms par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: rta mchog rin chen sa lam bgrod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar brgal: bde chen thar lam zhing du 'dren: rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: glang po rin chen theg chen stobs: bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpung dang ldan: stobs chen gzhan gyi don byed cing : yang dag snying po'i don rtogs shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ rigs kyi bu rnams la rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas: bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang : 'phags pa'i don bdun dang ldan nas/ gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang ni/ gdugs/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na gdugs bzang gser gyi yu ba can: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod pa ltar:

dbu la gdugs kyi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ maṅga laṃ tsha khraṃ ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gser nya/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na gser gyi nya mo 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod pa ltar: spyan la nya yi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ maṅga laṃ ma tsha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dung*/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na chos kyi dung sgra sgrogs mdzad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i gsung la mchod pa ltar: gsung la dung gi bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ maṅga laṃ shaṃ ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na pad+ma dmar mo 'dab brgyad pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod pa ltar: ljags la pad+ma'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ maṅga laṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bum pa/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na rin chen bum pa rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i mgul la mchod pa ltar: mgul la bum pa'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ maṅga laṃ kum+bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpal be'u/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na dpal gyi be'u 'od 'bar ba: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod pa ltar: thugs la dpal be'u bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: om̐ maṅga laṃ bi war+pa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rgyal mtshan/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na rin chen rgyal mtshan rab mdzes pa: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i sku la mchod pa ltar: sku la rgyal mtshan bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: maṅga laṃ dh+wa dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'khor lo/ hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig mchod pa'i lha mo yis: phyag na gser gyi 'khor lo 'od 'bar ma: bsnams nas rgyal ba'i zhabs la mchod pa ltar:

zhabs la 'khor lo'i bkra shis thob par shog: om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: maṅga la tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur ro/ /gsum pa rjes la/ de ltar sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter las byung ba'i thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi dbang mchog 'gro ba kun grol zhes/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo legs par bskur grub pa lags pas khyed rang slob ma rnams kyis/ da nas bzung byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du tshe rabs lha skal du 'dzin snyam pa dang*/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dam tshig gis gtsos bsrung bya thams cad mi nyams par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p zhes lan gsum/ de ltar smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi tshul du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ sa gzhi spos? sogs/ slar sgo gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa yid kyis blangs te bla ma la 'bul ba lags na cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste sogs lan gsum/ de ltar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar gyur pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing*/ me tog man+da ra bas char phang phung du bsnyil bas/ khyed rang rnams la dbang gi ye shes pa sngar ma skyes pa skyes pa dang*/ skyes pa rnams mi nyams par rab tu gnas pa'ir mos pa mdzod cig /jo bo skyon gyis ma gos? phyag stong 'khor lo'i? dpon slob mi 'bral? gnas 'dir nyin mo? dkon mchog gsum gyi bden? de lta bu'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i dge ba la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la spro ba khyad par can bskyed la 'di nyid lhan cig tu gsung bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis? 'jam dpal dpa' bos? dus gsum gshegs p bla ma sku khams? phan bde?

zhes bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs sogs bya'o/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi sta gon 'di bsam lhun sta gon la khog phub/ 7 ngag dbang phrin las rnam rgyal gyi zhal rgyun bka' phebs ltar cung zad kha bsgyur yod pa la gzhir byas/ sgo zhus thugs rje chen po'i lha gzhung la bstun pa'i kha bsgyur cung zad dang*/ dngos gzhi lha dbang bskur bya gter gzhung lha tshom bsdus tshig tu gyur pas/ yang dag nges pa'i don la byin rlabs myur yang*/ sgrub chen skabs su khrom dbang bskur bar drang don spros bcas kyi dbang chen lha tshom tha dad du bsgyur rgyu la tshig sna bsring ba dang*/ tshe dbang tshe sgrub rnam gzhi las bkod pa bcas/ lhag bsam 'dun pas bstan 'gro la phan sems kyis bris pa/ btsun ming grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bgrang bya dngos po zhes pa'i gral tshes mnyam med bu ram shing pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen zla6tshes4nyin spel ba la yi ge pa ni in+d+ra'i m-ing ngo*/ /gong 'di rnams kha 'thor ltar 'dug pa dkyus gcig tu bkod pa/ las dang po pa la phan phyir mtshams sbyar te bris pa/ bstan 'dzin pad+ma phrin las kyis sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // (ca) dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo las/ gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dbang mchog ye shes me 'bar mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan pa phrin las me 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa kro dha rā dza ya: dug gsum rang gzugs gdon gyi tshang tshing kun/ /'joms mdzad dus mtha'i me las mthu che ba/ /bde gshegs stobs 'dus 'jigs byed srin po'i gzugs/ /bzod dka'i gzi ldan de la phyag byas nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs sngon byon las/ khyad 'phags zab cing mkho rgu kun/ /ma tshang med pa'i rmad byung mdzod/ /'jug sgo smin byed 'di sgrubs 'tshal/ /zab mo'i gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su len par 'dod pa'-i+i snod ldan la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sgrub pa la gsum stai sbyor ba/

dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yid mthun gyi gnas su stegs bu'i steng du drag dkyil gzhung mthun ras bris bkram par/ 'bru nag gis tshom bu gtso bor bcu gcig bkod/ de dbus khri'i khar rin po che'i bum pa rgyan ldan kha rgyan mgul chings mthing nag gzung rdor dang bcas pa'i khar rigs bdag gtso bo gnas lha lnga dang bcas pa'i sku tsaka dgod/ mdun du las bum/ g.yas su rten gtor/ rgyab tu zor gtor/ g.yon du phyag mtshan gri gug sbrul zhags dang*/ 'khor lo nad rkyal dbyug pa rdo rje lcags sdig me dpung rnams phyogs bsdus bcas kyi tsakli gnyis/ bar mtshams su ha la'i sman chen dum chung du/ sman raka gtor gsum dngos sam bris pa/ spos dkar khu ba/ btsag bu dang spra me/ dur khrod dpal chas/ gzhung mthun srung 'khor rnams dgod/ 'og tu bsgral ling las phur btsugs pa/ mnan pa'i ri rab/ me hom rnams kyang 'du bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yug tu sman raka gtor gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ bka' srung 'bul gtor/ tshogs mchod sogs phrin las la dgos pa rnams las byang phyag len ltar dgod par bya'o/ /de nas tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi tshogs bsags nas brtsams mthar chags su gtong*/ bstod pa yan bdag mdun gcig rdzogs su btang nas sgrub dkyil gyi go sar 'dzab dgongs dbye/ sgrub yig snying byang dmar khrid ltar dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du gsal btab la rtsa sngags dang sgrub sngags bzla/ bsgrub bya'i rgyud sbyangs nas rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod par mos/ mthar 'dzab bstod bya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya brjod/ bka' gter srung ma'i gtor 'bul dang tshogs mchod bsgral bstab yan grub nas/ las bum sgrub/ phrin las kyi gsham nas 'byung ba ltar dbang blang la gnang ba nod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang gsum ste 'jug pa/ dbang dngos/

mjug gi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma rnams kyis phyi rol du las bum gyi chu dang khrus tshig gis khrus bya zhing*/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ sarba pa paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod/ bgegs gtor byin brlab las byang ltar/ hūm̐: nga ni ye shes khro bo'i rgyal: dmar nag pad+ma dbang gi sku: rdo rje'i dbyug pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: gnam lcags rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: hūm̐ phaṭ sgra yis bgegs dpung brgyal: log 'dren bdud rigs tshar gcod gyur: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma tsaṇ+ḍa kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ che ba bskyed/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: tshe rabs lan chags 'byung po'i rigs: 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te 'tshe zhing glags lta na: rab tu gzhom par gdon mi za: sarba bhū ta gats+tsha: bsngos la bskrad/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : lcags sdig bya khyung tshwa tshwa 'khyug: sku smad sgrol mtshon dbal phur gyis: log 'dren bdud rigs srog snying la: gdab bo badz+ra kī la ya: bro brdung phye ma rdul du bshig: na ma sa man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra nan: oṃ gha gha: gha tā ya gha tā ya: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ: gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad mā ra ya rbad: kī li kī la ya: sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra dha rod ādz+nyā pa ya ti: kā ya wāk+tsit+ta: badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ srung 'khor brtan por bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu byas/ chos bshad spyi dang bye brag gi mtshams sbyor la/ de'ang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su byon pa gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis phyi rabs gdul bya nyam thag pa rnams kyi don du rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nā gardzu na/

pra bha hastī/ khrag 'thung nag po sogs las 'jam dpal klu 'dul/ rta mchog klu 'dul/ gtum po klu srin/ bya khyung klu 'dul/ klu bdud dug ri me 'bar la sogs pa'i rgyud dang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan cing*/ bod du dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la grogs po klu'i dug zer gyis bsnyun mdze btab pa'i tshe/ nā ga rak+sha'i gsang rgyud rgya mtsho dug ri me 'bar gyi khong bcud gdams pa'i gnad btab pas rgyal po bsnyun las grol: ma 'ongs snyigs dus yang mtha'i 'gro ba rnams gdug pa'i gdon gyis nyen pa la dgongs te ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i nā ga rak+sha'i gdams bskor rgyas bsdus du ma mdzad nas gter kha du mar sbas pa rnams/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug /chos rgyal rin chen gling pa sogs kyis spyan drangs pa las/ sgrub sde brgyad kyi zab bcud gcig tu dril ba'i gtum chen nā ga rak+sha'i gdams skor man ngag du mas khyad du 'phags pa 'di ni/ 'on bu stag tshang rdo rje'i phug tu jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rlangs chen dpal seng*/ shākya pra bha/ nam mkha'i snying po sogs las can rje 'bangs rnams la rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor lhan cig tu gnang zhing de nyid du gter rgyas btab/ dus phyis tshe lo nyi shu'i kha dar zhing 'dul ba'i dus rtags rnams mngon du gyur pa'i tshe mchims shākya pra bha'i sku'i rnam 'phrul/ pad+ma'i rnam thar thang yig chen mo las o rgyan rog rje gling pa zhes lung du bstan cing*/ rgyal po bka' thang las kyang*/ shākya'i zhing khams bsam yas phu dung na: byang sems gsang sngags theg chen rnal 'byor pa: sngags kyi bdag po nam mkha' zhes pa 'byung : zhes dang*/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter lung las/ dbus ri nag po'i lho ngos 'dabs shod du: ri bo tsit+ta 'dra ba'i nang dkyil na: dbang gi ming can shes sgo yangs pa'i bu:

skal ldan rig 'dzin de la gtad rgya gyis: zhes sogs tshad thub kyi gter lung mang pos zin pa/ rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje'i thugs sras/ rig 'dzin grub pa yongs kyi dbang phyug skyid grong ngag dbang bslab gsum mam/ 'gro 'dul thugs mchog rdo rjer mtshan du 'bod pa de nyid kyis/ yum bu bla sgang*/ mchims phu dang ti sgro/ bsam yas bar khang yang rdzong sogs gter gnas mang po nas ngo mtshar ba'i zab gter spyan drangs pa las/ gdams pa'i skor 'di ni 'on phu stag tshang gi gsang phug nas rdo rje phur pa drag sngags dregs 'dul dang lhan cig tu spyan drangs/ gsang rgya rten 'brel sogs mthar phyin par mdzad nas skal ldan chos bdag rnams la spel ba'i gdams zab 'di nyid kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa sgrub pa de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul ba sogs sngon du song nas/ 'jug pa'i chos la gnyis las thog mar thun mtshams sngon 'gro skyabs sems sdom bzung rnams chabs cig tu sgrub pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma lha dang dbyer med rdo rje 'chang*/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ngang mdangs thugs rje'i rnam rol bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgongs klong zab gsal mchog tu bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba saugs bsag sbyang so so'i 'dun pa dang*/ phyi ltar so thar gyi skyabs 'gro/ nang ltar gzhan phan gyi byang sems/ gsang ba ltar sngags kyi dam tshig ste sdom gsum cig car du nod cing bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i bgegs:

nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang : dag pa'i mtha' bzhi'i dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: phar phyin drug la bslab sdom bzung : ma bsgral bsgral zhing ma sgrol sgrol: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: ces lan gsum gyis dam bca' zhing sdom pa bzung*/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas khyod rang rnams la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos shig /de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyeḥ thugs rje dbang phyug bla med mgon: gsang sngags sdom pa rdo rje 'chang : brtse chen dgongs pas bdag la skyobs: rjes bzung thar pa'i grong gzhugs gsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis lan gdab pa/ hoḥ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang : phrin las 'khor los rab bsgyur ba: gsang sngags rtsa ba dbang la thug: tshul bzhin dam tshig srung nus sam: zhes dris pas dam tshig spang blang la nges par gnas snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kyeḥ ston pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi: bka' bzhin dam tshig srog ltar bzung : gsang sngags dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: zhugs shing smin par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs la/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi zla dkyil la don dam byang sems rdo rje rtse lnga 'od 'phros pa gsal bar gyur: om̐ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi: zhes snying khar rdo rje bzhag om̐ su ra ste sa ma ya satwaṃ: hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ: lag tu rdo rje gtad/ nang mchod bdud rtsi byin la/ hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam srung dngos grub sna tshogs 'thob:

nyams na snying la gzir zhing bsreg: de bas dam srung chu 'di 'thung : a mṛ ta sa ma ya tsit+ta ni hūm̐: rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: ye nas rang byung khyod la rdzogs: dam tshig nyams na de las sgrib: de bas dam tshig thub par srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi sgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par bcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t sogs las chus bsang : bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las e las gru gsum mthing nag mtha' dbus med par brdal ba'i dbus su dug mtsho khol ma'i klong du klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gis btegs pa'i pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: khyed rang rnams skad cig gis gtum po nā ga rak+sha mthing ga dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad sku smad dug sbrul dug ri la lan gsum dkris pa phyag g.yas dgus gri gug dang : g.yon dgus rtsibs ldan klad la bskor ba: rtsa zhal sdig pa dang lhag ma srin po'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa spyan dmar glog ltar 'khyugs pa la sbrul nag gi ral pa bskal pa'i mun ltar gtibs shing : thod skam lngas dbu brgyan sbrul rigs lngas yan lag dkris pa la rdo rje'i rgyan drug dang spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs pa: gsang ba'i yum mchog klu mo dug sbrul 'khyil ba zhal gcig spyan gcig pa nad rkyal dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pas mgul nas 'khyud pa: yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sku las ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar bzhugs pa'i dbu gtsug tu rigs 'dus slob dpon: dung khang du bya khyung nag po dang 'jam dpal:

mgrin par rta mgrin: thugs kar gsang bdag: lte bar pad+ma drag po: gsang bar rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor om̐ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phros pas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: de las 'od zer dpag med phyogs bcu'i zhing mu med par spros te rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs ma lus pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar byon te: khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la sib sib thim song snyam pa'i mos gdung drag po rtse gcig tu gnang bar zhu: spos rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams: 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rjes skur bzhengs la: 'jigs pa'i sku dang rngams pa'i rigs sngags sgra: dpa' ba'i thugs kyi ma rungs bdud dpung tshogs: gnyis med byang chub sems su shugs kyis sgrol: thugs rje chen po'i tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: badz+ra dha ra khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phe laṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ zhes byin dbab/ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: om̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐:

spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /de dag gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub/ dngos gzhi la phyi phan par byed pa'i dbang*/ nang nus pa 'jug pa'i dbang*/ mtha' brten gtor ma'i dbang dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po bum dbang gi slad du 'dun pa 'di ltar du mdzod: bum dbang dur khrod rol pa'i pho brang du khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs: rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i bdud rtsi khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs: 'khor lo lnga po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs: gtum chen gsang ba'i sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces brda sbyar la bum pa spyi bor bskaur zh-ing : hūm̐: bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin can: gsang ba gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun: skal ldan bu la dbab par bya: om̐ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang : nyon mongs pa lnga'i nad gdon sdig sgrib dag: ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas: bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems pas dbu brgyan par gyur: me tog 'thor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sngags brjod/ rjes 'brel du rigs bdag gi sku spyi bor bzhag pas rgyal ba thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam par byon nas khyod rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhugs nas dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag por byin gyis brlabs par mos shig: tsakli spyi bor bzhag hūm̐: 'khor los bsgyur ba stobs po che: sngags mchog sngags bdag rigs sngags rgyal: gtsug tor chen po rmad byung ba'i: don brgyud theg pa yongs rdzogs shog: badz+ra dha ra hūm̐ om̐ swa ā hā: gnyis pa nang nus pa'i dbang la lnga yod pa las/

thog mar sku'i nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa las khro rgyal ye shes kyi sku grangs med pa 'phros: khyod rang gi dpral bar thim: gti mug gi phung po'i bdud bcom: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i nus rtsal rdzogs shing 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi mchog: gshin rje'i gshed po rigs sngags rgyal: nā ga rak+sha'i dbang bskur bas: rtsal bcu yongs su rdzogs par shog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka phe lam du dzaḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: tsakli dpral bar bzhag /gtso bo'i mgrin pa nas pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs byon: khyod rang gi mgrin par thim: nga rgyal lha bu'i bdud bcom nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi nus rtsal rdzogs shing : pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: ham̐'u: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi bdag: rngam sgra hu lu'i sgra dang ldan: dbang chen pad+ma'i dbang bskur bas: gsang sngags nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: hrīḥ h+ya ghṛ ba hu lu hu lu kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes mgrin par bskur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas gsang bdag me 'bar gyi lha tshogs byon: khyod rang gi snying khar thim: zhe sdang 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi nus rtsal rdzogs shing yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i 'od: rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog: lag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas: mkhyen brtse'i nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: badz+ra dha ra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying khar bskur/ gtso bo'i lte ba nas khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs byon: khyed rang gi lte bar thim: 'dod chags nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom:

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nus rtsal rdzogs: che mchog gi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: khrag 'thung bde gshegs kun gyi dngos: rdo rje 'joms byed 'joms par byed: che mchog drag po'i dbang bskur bas: mthu stobs nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: badz+ra artsig nirtsig kī ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes lte bar bzhag /gtso bo'i gsang gnas nas phrin las badz+ra kī la ya'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon te khyod rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog gi bdud bcom: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje rnon pos ma rig gcod: ye shes gsang ba bde chen gar: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur bas: sangs rgyas phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ badz+ra kī la kī la ya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gsang bar bzhag /gtso bo'i dbu gtsug nas dpal chen khyung nag 'jigs rngam nam mkha' gang bar byon: khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bor brgyan pas ma rig 'khrul pa'i bdud bcom: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje thogs pa med pas klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul ba'i 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen yang sprul klu gnyan srog gi gshed: khro rgyal kun gyi stobs 'chang ga ru ṭas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur rgya yis gdab: rtsal chen phrin las thogs med 'gyed par mdzod: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ḍa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spyi bor bzhag /de ltar phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas lus tha mal du 'dzin pa dag: lha sku gsal stong dbyer med bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku thob ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: shis brjod sngags bcas/ gnyis pa gsung bzla ba sngags kyi lung sbyin pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing gi mthar dbyangs gsal dang sngags phreng g.yas bskor rang sgra dang bcas 'khor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa 'phros:

zhal nas thon te khyod rang lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs: mgrin pa'i lam brgyud thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar 'khod cing g.yas bskor du 'ur ldir gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: 'gro ba'i las rgyud sbyangs: tshur 'dus pas gsang sngags mtha' dag la dbang brnyes pa'i mos pas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod: sngags phreng bgrang la dbyangs gsal bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug cing bgrang phreng lag tu gtad/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung 'bar ba gsung gi rang bzhin can: badz+ra dha ra phe lam khrom̐ hrīḥhūm̐: 'byung 'jug rlung sngags grags stong rig sngags rgyal: rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra phe lam khrom̐ hrīḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar gsung phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa dag: grags stong dbyer med kyi bzlas brjod la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: shis brjod sngags bcas/ gsum pa thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba la/ brda don zung du 'brel ba'i phyag mtshan rnams rim par gtad pas thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob: thugs rje dang phrin las thogs pa med pas gdul bya rjes su bzung pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal ba rnam rgyal dgra las rgyal: bdud dpung tshar gcod ka ta ra: nyon mongs 'ching sdom sbrul zhags gtad: gdul bya rjes bzung dbang thob shog: badz+ra ka ta ri pa sha tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gri gug dang sbrul zhags lag tu gtad cing snying khar bzhag /phyag mtshan gzhan rnams kyang de bzhin byas la/ hūm̐: lcags zangs 'khor lo'i rtsibs stong 'bar: nad rkyal dbyug pa rdo rje dang : lcags sdig me dpung 'bar ba gtad: rig pa stobs kyi dbang thob shog: badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa tsakra dz+wa la tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar thugs phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur bas yid tha mal du 'dzin pa dag:

rig stong 'od gsal gyi t-ing 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: shis brjod dang sngags bcas/ bzhi pa yon tan rdzas kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi bskur ba la/ 'byung bzhi'i bcud 'dus pa'i hā la'i sman chen 'di nyid khyod rang rnams kyis myong ba tsam gyis: dug gsum dug lnga'i rtog pa las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i zug rngu las grol ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: 'byung bzhi'i bcud bsdus hā la'i sman chen po: rigs sngags nus pas bdud rtsi'i bcud chen sbar: dug gis dug 'joms skal ldan bu la sbyin: sman sbyor stobs bskyed nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: sarba hā la pañtsa a mṛ ta kun+dha lī hoḥ sman chen gyur mid byar gzhug /thabs shes dbyer med sman raka gtor gsum gtad pas 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i thugs rje'i yon tan rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: thabs kyi bdud rtsi'i shes rab rak+ta dang : zung 'jug 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi rdzas: chags bral ye shes chen po'i klong du rol: mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: pañtsa rak+ta bha li haṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes lag tu gtad cing rol du gzhug /ljon pa'i rtsi mchog gtad cing byug pas 'byung ba cha mi snyoms pa'i nyon mongs kyi zug rngu rang sar zhi bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: mi bzod gdug pa'i nad kyis zin gyur pa: tshad med thugs rjais bzung phyir thabs shes rdzas: chu bur stobs sdud dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsi: byugs pas nyon mongs nad kun gzhil bar shog: khri k+ṣa a mṛ ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spos dkar gtad cing lus la byug /gtar sreg gi chas rnams gtad pas dug lnga'i nad kyi zug rngu rtsad nas 'byin cing thugs rje'i nus rtsal phyogs med du 'bar ba'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: dug lnga'i dbang gyur klu gnyan sde brgyad kyis:

mthong reg kha rlangs bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dug: rtsad nas 'byin phyir mtshon rnon raṃ 'od gtad: mtha' sdud gtar sreg las kun mthar byed shog: badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha na dz+wa la ram̐ dha ra hūm̐: zhes lag tu gtad/ de ltar yon tan rig 'dzin rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas: rtog sgrib nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag: gzhan don re ba yid bzhin du skong ba la dbang : 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no: shis brjod sngags bcas/ lnga pa phrin las khams gsum yongs sgrol las kyi mtha' sdud rnams kyis dbang sbyin pa la: thog mar dur khrod dang dpal gyi chas rnams byin pas rgyal byed dpa' bo'i chas rtags yongs su rdzogs pas gdug pa can zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu thob par mos shig: hūm̐: thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phreng : sbrul rigs lnga dang khrag zhag me: rdzu 'phrul 'dab gshog rdo rje'i go: dpa' chen dpal rtags yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro don spyod pa'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra ga ya dhā ra sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes gnas so sor bskur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang byin pas lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis btums shing bar gcod log 'dren gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gzhal yas khang : klong lnga mi shigs stobs ldan rdo rje'i go: lhun grub klong du sgo gsum mnyam nyid rdzogs: mi mthun bdud kyis sbyor ba mi byed shog: badz+ra kā wā tsi bh+rūm̐ swā hā: srung 'khor spyi bor dang lag tu bzhag /slob dpon dang khyod rang rnams kyang 'jigs byed gtum chen khro bo rgyal po'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal lhag par brtan pas dgra bgegs 'gugs sgrol gyi las mdzad par mos shig: nya bo mdun du bkod la las gzhung tshogs tha ma'i skabs su gsungs pa'i 'gugs gzhug bya: phur pa sras mchog kī la yas srid gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus rtsal dang ldan pa 'di nyid lag tu gtad pa tsam gyis:

thabs kyis mi thul ba'i log 'dren bdud dpung rnams shugs sgrol mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod pa'i dbang thob par mos shig: gdab phur lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: e las grub pa'i gnam lcags brub khung du: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma rig klu gnyan bdud: tshad med thugs rjes shor med byad du bcings: skye med dbyings su sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra phe lam khrom̐ hrīḥhūm̐ kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān nṛ phu tri trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐ āḥ de nas gdeng gsum gsal gsum tshe lung khrus lung gi dgongs pa ldan pas bsgral las la 'jug par zhu: las gzhung gi / hūm̐: sgrol byed sras mchog kī la ya: khro rgyal kun gyi stobs shugs 'chang : srid pa gsum yang sgrol byed na: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: bstab po gdug pa'i snying la ya: theb par mdzod cig kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐: kī li kī la ya sarba bighān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ nya bo bsgral du gzhug /tsher ma gyis me hom̐ sbar la/ rab tu 'bar ba'i me'i klong du gtum chen nā ga rak+sha'i lha tshogs gtso bo rnams skad cig gis gsal ba'i zhal khyams gnam sa gdangs pa lta bu'i nang : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum lhag med du phul bas dgyes bzhin bzhes par mos shig: ling ro me hom̐ du 'bul gzhug /hūm̐: dug rdzas rten 'brel nag po mngon phyung nas: rigs sngags 'bar ba'i spu gri'i dbal rtse la: gnod byed bskyon nas rdul du brlag pa'i dbang : bu la sbyin pas bdud dpung bsreg par shog /badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān nṛ phu tri mā ra ya dz+wa la ram̐: sreg thab tu gtor ma btab/ de nas khyed rang rnams gtum chen du gsal ba'i gtor zor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags kyi thog ser ltar 'phangs pas: bstan dgra bdud dpung ma lus rdul du brlag pa'i dbang thob par mos mdzod: zor lag tu gtad/ hūm̐:

srid pa'i dug rdzas 'dus pa'i gtor nag la: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan tshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan: ye shes las grub mched pa'i sgyogs chen 'dis: gnod byed bdud dpung gzhom pa'i dbang thob shog: sarba nṛ tri mā ra ya tshin+dha rbad: lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam dus la babs: byin rlabs mthu stobs nus rtsal deng 'dir skyed: bdag lus phung khams lha yi dkyil 'khor la: 'bar ba'i stobs bcu rdzogs pas gzi byin mched: srid pa gsum yang rngams drag rol pa'i rtsal: me 'bar chu 'brub ri nyil rlung chen 'ur: 'brug sgra thog ser drag po'i ngar dang bcas: bdud dang dgra bgegs phye mar mya la la: byad ma gnod byed gzhob tu thu lu lu: rgol ba brtsams pa'i bdud rigs snying la ya: trig nan hur thum sha badz+ra tshin+dha rbad: brlag cing bcom nas nam yang ldang med du: ye shes 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas thob la: rig 'dzin rnams kyis bden pa'i stobs skyed cig: yi dam lha yis bskyed rdzogs rtags phyungs shig: dam can rnams kyis dmod pa'i mthu skyed cig: khro rgyal rnams kyis mi shigs rgya sdoms la: mthar zhing gzhom pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ badz+ra phe laṃ khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ kī li kī la ya: ru dra nṛ tri sha trūṃ gardza gardza ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhan+dha bhan+dha hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha tshin+dha tshin+dha bhin+dha bhin+dha s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa mā ra ya sarba big nān trig nan a yaṃ phaṭḥ

ces zor gtor gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phen du gzhug khro rgyal thugs kyi 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas sa gzhi phye mar gas pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong du las kyi gshin rje kha gdangs nas byung ba la: srid gsum log par 'dren pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug ste zhal du sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: bden stobs 'gugs gzhug gi mthar/ hūm̐: khams gsum dpyi gnon ye shes ri rab brjid: rgyud drug bdud bzhi ma lus ldang med gzhom: skal ldan bu mchog dpal chen gsal ba'i 'og: ma rungs dgra bgegs 'byung po'i zhal du bstab: mthar byed ldang med mnan pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ phe laṃ sarba bam̐ ram̐ sum̐ yam̐ e nan: zhes 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi gzugs gtad/ 'chi bdag kha btsums nas sa 'og tu song ba'i steng du gtum chen khro rgyal 'khor bcas kyis bro brdung zhing gzir bas nam yang ldang med du gyur par mos shig: gtor zor 'phang gtor gzhong sbub/ rdo rjes rgyas gdab la rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: rngams chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'bar ba dpal gyi bro brdung bas: srid gsum bsdus shing dpyi nas 'joms: bdud dang dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams: byang chub mchog sems ma bskyed bar: nam yang ldang med rgyas btab bo: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwam+bha ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la 'bru 'thor/ gsum pa mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba la/ gtor snod rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang du gtor ma nyid gtum chen nā ga rak+sha gtso bo'i chas yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba/ khyed rang gi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas: sde brgyad dregs pa mi bsrun pa'i gnod 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing khyad par klu gnyan sa bdag ma rungs pa'i mthong reg kha rlangs kyi dug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi: dbang bzhi rtsal rdzogs su thob: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stan thog gcig tu thob par mos shig:

rten gtor spyi bor bzhag /hūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki dam can chos srung tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs skal ldan slob bu la: dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: sarba sa ma ya badz+ra ghan+dhe a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra a āḥ de rnams kyis dbang gi dngos gzhi rgyas par grub nas mjug gi bya ba'i thog mar/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis shis pa'i tshigs bcad dbyangs su len cing*/ me tog gi char rgyun sil mar bsnyil bas dbang don gyi ye shes brtan cing gong 'phel du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod: ye dharma dang las gzhung zur 'phyang ltar shis brjod rgyas par bya: me tog 'thor zhing rol mo bya'o/ /dbang legs par thob nas dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pa gal che ste gzhung las/ hoḥ gsang sngags bla med sgor zhugs nas: dbang srog 'dzin par dam tshig gnas: lus ni bskyed rim lha yi sku: ngag gis bzlas brjod rgyun mi bcad: yid kyis gsal stong ting 'dzin bskyang : snod bcud thams cad ye shes dal: gnyis su med par ye shes sbyor: brten la gus pa'i bya ba spyod: gdug can bsgral ba'i zhing gyur pa: thugs rje'i mthu bskyed dbyings su bsgral: rdzas dang sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis: rten 'brel sbyor ba mtha' ru dbyung : kun kyang lta ba'i rtsis zin pas: sangs rgyas spyod pa'i phrin las yin: bla ma lha dang mched lcam gyi: dam tshig nyams pa med pa yis: srung mtshams bral ba'i dbyings su skyol: dam ldan nor bu thogs pa bzhin: ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad 'thob: dam med sa bon rul ba 'dra: sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob mi srid: de phyir rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig gnas rnams ma nyams srungs: zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i dam tshig gi rim pa la spang blang tshul bzhin du bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che:

dam pas bka' ni legs bstsal ba: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung : lan gsum/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slar yang lus longs spyod thams cad deng nas bla ma la phul bas cha shas nas longs spyod gsol lo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yis slob mar bzung nas su: rgya cher spyod pa bskyang du gsol: lan gsum dang dge bsngo spyi ltar byas la slob ma gyes so/ /gsum pa cho ga'i rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor thugs dam bskul ba chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs dang rdul tshon 'bru tshom sogs la gshegs bsdu bya/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod las gzhung ltar byas pas grub bo/ /'jam dpal grub gang byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs/ /rnam smin lus la ye shes phyag rgyas thebs/ /cis kyang gzhom med rdo rje 'jigs par byed/ /'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bdag po nyid gyur cig /gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i dbang bskur ye shes me 'bar gyi mtshams sbyor tshig sna cung zad bsdus shing lag len rnam gsal gyis brgyan pa 'di'ang*/ pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // (cha) rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur dang bcas pa 'chi med gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /tshe dbang bcud sbyin 'phags ma'i zhabs pad la/ /mi phyed gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol na/ /'di bzung tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin stsol/ /'phying bar bang so'i gsang gter bcud/ /jo mo'i nang sgrub zab pa'i phul/ /lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i/ /rjes gnang ji bzhin nyung gsal 'god/ /skyid grong rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i zab gter las byon pa'i mtsho rgyal nang sgrub 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi gdams pa'i snying por dril ba 'di la gnyis/

sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ gtsang zhing dge ba'i gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng du/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog can nam 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu gtso bo gcig la 'khor nyer gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzu'i steng du/ bum pa gang chu dang nyer lnga rdzas kyis btams pa mgul chings dkar po can bzhag /de'i steng du bhan+dha a mṛ tas gang ba dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng du me long dri med shel rdo 'god/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du mda' dar/ rgyab tu tshe chang*/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ zhi mchod g.yas skor/ byang shar du las bum/ tshogs gtor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ /de nas thog mar khrus dang dkar bgegs/ mtshams gcod spyi 'gros ltar bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang ba mtha' yas tsaṇ+ḍa li: las kyi dbang mo nā gardzu: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bla ma rje btsun 'phags ma la: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gzhom du gsol: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: bdag gis 'phags ma khyod bsgrubs pas: tshogs gnyis yongs su smin nas kyang : bde gshegs mdzad pa bdag gis bsgrub: pha rol phyin drug la gnas pa'i: 'gro kun mchog tu 'god par bgyi: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ hoḥ 'phags ma dkon mchog 'khor bcas la: rab tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: las dang nyon mongs ci mchis bshags: 'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba bsod nams ci bsags pa: 'gro kun yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs su: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdang ni:

a las thod par om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhu ba las byung nyer spyod dang : 'dod yon sman raka gtor ma sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni: zad med nam mkha' gang bar gyur: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po bdag mdun dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : steng 'og phyogs kun rig 'dzin 'bar ba'i dal: 'od zer lnga ldan kun nas rab 'khrugs pa: mi shigs sra brtan gser 'khor rtsibs stong ldan: pad dkar zla steng tāṃ yig dkar ser ni: ring cha tsheg drag can las lnga ldan gyis: 'od zer 'phro 'du yid bzhin 'phags ma'i sku: dkar gsal gser 'od zhi 'dzum spyan gsum ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchog sbyin rgya: g.yon pa ut+pal dkar po'i yu ba nyid: mtheb srin gyis 'dzin snyan g.yon me tog rgyas: phyag zhabs mthil du zhi ba'i spyan res mtshan: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bcu drug lang tsho can: dbu skra mthon mthing ser 'bol spyi bor bcing : zar bu 'phyang zhing dar sngon cod pan 'phur: dar dkar stod g.yogs dar dmar smad dkris bklubs: dbu rgyan snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do la sogs: rin chen rgyan mdzes 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'ja' zer 'od lnga 'phro ba'i klong na 'gying : tsit+ta pad dmar 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i: nang du gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad dbus dang ni: rtsibs steng zla dkyil tāṃ yig sngags 'bru re: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar gyur: om̐ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā: tāṃ yig las 'phros 'od kyis mdun gyi dal: pad dkar 'dab stong zla dkyil tāṃ yig las: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin lha mo ni: rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum zhal: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin ut+pal dmar po'i steng :

dus gsum sangs rgyas ye shes 'od phung 'bar: g.yon par mnyam bzhag tshe bum bcud kyis gtams: rdo rje skyil krung zhi ba'i spyan bdun ldan: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dbu gtsug mgon po 'od dpag med pas mtshan: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin 'od du 'bar: khor yug 'dab stong 'phags ma nyer gcig la: sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpa' bo dang : 'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe lha rig 'dzin sogs: til gang phyur ltar thugs rjes rol bar gsal: thugs rje kun sgrol thugs kar rtsibs brgyad la: zla steng tāṃ yig sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: gnas gsum zla ba pad+ma nyi zla la: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsal de las 'od 'phros pas: mdun bskyed rgyud bskul thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing kun rab tu g.yos: dwangs ma'i gzi 'bar sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs: 'phags ma thugs rjes kun sgrol skur bzhengs nas: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun gang ste: bdag mdun gnyis la thim pas dbang rdzogs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ om̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: thugs rjes smon lam las sprul pa'i: 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas rnams: dad pas bdag gis spyan 'dren na: brtse bas dgongs te gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa'i skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ār+ya tā re badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ āḥ pho brang gzhal yas 'od du 'bar: pad+ma ge sar zla ba'i steng : bcom ldan 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams kun: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: 'gro drug bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma: rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo: lha mo thugs rje'i ngang can ma: brtse gdung mkhyen stobs nus par ldan: yid bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa:

mi mthun phyogs rnams kun skyobs ma: skyabs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ār+ya ta re a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: dri med dag pa bdud rtsi'i chu: yan lag brgyad ldan dge ba'i rdzas: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs: 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ ār+ya tā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin pā d+yaṃ dang mañdza ma nam sbyangs pas mchod/ spro na maṇ+ḍal gang rung lan gsum sogs 'bul/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten phyogs dus thams cad du: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i bye brag ni: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs su smin par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhai nai wi d+ye shab+da hūm̐: nang mchod ni: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos ji snyed pa: rdo rje 'dod ma'i tshogs su mngon sprul nas: 'dod yon mchod pa dbang po rnams la 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskang gyur nas: ye shes dbang po drug gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma mu dra pra tīts+tsha ham̐'u: gsang mchod ni: hūm̐: sku lnga rigs 'dus rje btsun 'phags ma la: dug lnga'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: ye shes lnga yi bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul: kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig: om̐ tā rā dz+nyā na sarba pū dza sa ma ye swā hā: sman raka gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi 'dis: slob dpon gnyan dang yi dam lha: 'phags ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam can gter bdag rnams la mchod: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes mchod/

kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blangs/ hūm̐: thabs shes rten 'brel rgyu las byung ba yi: bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskang gyur nas: bdag 'dzin 'khor ba stongs par mdzad du gsol: oṃ tā rā dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī ma hā rak+ta pū dza ye hūm̐: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi phung por gsal: dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍāk+ki nī a mṛ ta ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni/ āḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum: 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma: lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud: 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma: tut+ta re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol: tu re'i nad rnams kun las skyobs: sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes bzung nas: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa dang : bar chad bdud las rgyal bar mdzod:

bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ thugs srog mtha' mar snying po 'bru brgyad pa: g.yas su 'khor bas lnga ldan 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed lha mo'i rgyud bskul sngags phreng bskor: de las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'jig rten gyi: zhing kun g.yos shing tshe bcud dwangs ma ni: a nṛ dza yis rnam par stong khams kun: nyi zla'i 'od 'bar them mer gang ba rnams: mdun bskyed la thim stobs dang gzi byin 'bar: sangs rgyas zhing khams ma lus gcig tu rdzogs: mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro: thugs kyi bdud rtsi lnga ldan 'od zer rgyun: bar mi chad par bdag nyid thugs kar thim: nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chod kun zhi zhing : gzi brjid 'od 'bar 'khor 'das stobs bcu rdzogs: snang srid brtan g.yo kun la dbang bsgyur bas: bskal bzang stong gi bstan pa ma rdzogs bar: tshe gcig bya ba byed pa'i yon tan ldan: thugs rjes stobs kyis bden pa 'grub gyur cig: om̐ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla/ bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs dzap dmigs zhib cha ni gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa las shes par bya'o/ /brgyad pa tshe 'gugs ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā yu sid+dhi āḥ snang srid rnam dag pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dby-ings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags brjod/ rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams:

'ja' dang 'od du me re re: sku dang tshom bur shigs se shig: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: byin rlabs char rgyun si li li: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi me re re: ma rig rtogs pa sangs se sang : gzugs phung 'od du ya la la: bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur grub nas: 'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thob cig: om̐ tā re sogs brjod/ dgu pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus shig 'bul/ nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku: rgyal kun bskyed yum yid bzhin rnal 'byor ma: mi phyed gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na: ma gdung bu bzhin brtse ba'i thugs rjes gzigs: bdag ni bla med theg chen sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong 'gyod drag pos 'phags ma'i spyan sngar bshags: nyes ltung sgrib tshogs byang zhing dag pa dang : tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ bcu pa mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : mkhyen brtse thugs rje'i rol pa'i phyag rgya sngags: lhag med rtag tu gsal mdzad brtan par bzhugs: bde legs yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes brjod pas me tog 'thor ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ dang po tshogs mchod ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i tshogs rdzas bsang chus bran la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros me rlung chus: rnam rtog bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'phros bdud rtsi zhu: 'dod yon nam mkha' mnyam par spel: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba bha ga'i klong : rnam dag dam tshig gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma: a ma mtsho rgyal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: lā s+ye dkar mo 'phags ma tshe yi dpal:

dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku bcom ldan ma: kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ba: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga yi bcud: zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod dam pa 'di: zhal du bstab bo rol gcig kha raṃ khā hi: thugs dam bskangs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bla med snying po'i sgor zhugs nas: nongs par spyad pa'i nyes pa ci mchis pa: kun nas yangs pa chos dbyings bha ga'i klong : 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyis bskangs shing bshags: g.yar dam sor chud mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces dang yig brgya brjod/ tshogs la rol pa'i mthar lhag ma byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: dbang phyug dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: pha ma rigs drug sems can dang : lan chags bgegs rigs thams cad la: bka' yi pham phab 'di bsngos pas: zad med bdud rtsir longs spyod shog: ces bsngo/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ om̐: ye shes lha tshogs dgyes pa'i 'od rab 'byin: 'byung lnga dbang sdud mchog gi bde stong ma: yid bzhin tshe 'phel kun skyob lha mo dgongs: sgrub mchog bu la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dpal bcu'i dbang thob las bzhi'i grub chen brgyad: ma lus deng 'dir thogs med mthu thob nas: 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol zhing : tshe gcig 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur stsol: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ ma ma kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod do/ /de nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang nongs bshags gong smos ltar bya/ tshogs zhing sogs rten la brtan bzhugs bya zhing bsdu rim ni/

hūm̐: chos rnams gzhi med rtsa ba bral: rig stong ye shes snying po can: spro dang bsdu bar mi dmigs kyang : kun rtog sbyang phyir dbyings su muḥ zhes lta ba rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la: gnas sh-ing thun mtshams khyer so lam du slong : smon lam ni/ hūm̐: de bzhin rang rig dbyings kyi klong chen ma'i: bla med dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi 'dzin pa'i mthus: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i mthu stobs yongs rdzogs te: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: shis brjod ni/ rang byung dpal gyi lha lam rdo rje'i sku: thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i byin rlabs mthus: dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshe dpal rdo rje'i srog: skal ldan bdag la rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces dang dbyangs gsal rten snying brjod do/ /gnyis pa dbang gi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi las byang gi dbang bskur smon lam gong ltar la/ byang shar du las bum dgod/ sngon gtor nas brtsam las gzhung bsang*/ 'dzab bzlas ji ltar nus pa bya/ tshe 'gugs nas bar brtsam tshogs dang bshags pa'i bar du gtong*/ las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed bzlas kyis bsgrub/ dngos sam ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs shing slob ma bzhugs par gsol ba gdab bo/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ bgegs bskrad cing srung 'khor bsgom/ chos bshad ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar la/ de'ang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer las byung ba lha mo 'jigs pa kun skyob: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rgyud dang rig sngags rnams bstan pa 'di nyid la ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos rgyal po ma skyes dgra la gsungs: khyad par o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti la rje btsun ma nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyud mtha' dag legs par bstsal pa rnams o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen por bzhugs pa la: dus re zhig gi tshe mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che la lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lis lung bstan pa ltar gsang mdzod rdo rje'i rgya bkrol nas 'phags pa klu sgrub la gnang*/

de nyid las ji skad du/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: snang ba mtha' yas zhal yang mthong : 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes: las kyi dbang mo'i gsang mdzod brtol: nā gardzu na'i thugs bcud len: ma rgyud shes rab bka' chen phab: ces gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma kā ras rgyud dang gdams skor yongs su rdzogs pa gdul bya gzhan don du gsan nas/ bod du phebs pa'i tshe gdams skor thun mong ba rnams mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gnang*/ de nyid kyi gter kha bye ba phrag brgyar sgrol ma'i gdams ngag mi 'dra ba mang du sba bar mdzad pa'i nang tshan/ khyad par du gyur pa thugs gter chen po rnams kyi ldebs su jo mo nyid kyi phyi nang gsang sgrub kyi tshul du bstan pa 'ga' zhig zab pa gu ru chos dbang*/ rat+na gling pa/ bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs kyis spyan drangs pa las skabs su babs pa 'di ni pad+ma bka'i thang yig las o rgyan rog rje gling pa zhes dang*/ rgyal po bka' thang las sngags kyi bdag po nyer lnga'i grangs su lung bstan cing : rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po dang bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs kyi gter lung las gsal bor zin pa dang : rang gter las/ nam mkha'i snying po shākya pra bha ba: zung gi sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul: rdo rje'i ming 'dzin 'jigs med go cha can: zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gu ru rin po che'i thugs sras bka' bab grub chen brgyad kyi nang tshan lho brag nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ mchims shākya pra bha zung gi zlos gar 'gro 'dren sprul sku rim par byon pa'i ya gyal gsang chen ston pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa/ bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i mnyam med rig 'dzin chen po 'gro 'dul thugs mchog rdo rje zhes grags pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid kyis yum bu bla sgang gtso bor gyur pa'i gter gnas khyad 'phags bcu phrag brgal ba nas/

sku gsung thugs rten dang myong grol du ma spyan drangs pa las 'di ni/ yar lung 'phying bar stag rtse zhes pad+ma he ru ka'i pho brang bang so dmar po nas gsang gter ḍāk+ki'i snying bcud du byon pa ste/ de ltar jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi nang ltar du sgrub pa 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /thog mar rgyud ma dag pa dag par bya ba'i slad du 'dun pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sa phyogs 'di nyid dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i gzhal med khang du gyur pa'i nang du/ slob dpon nyid dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yab yum rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo dngos su gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas yar la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' bskor du bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad ji srid byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro'i snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: na mo: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang ba mtha' yas tsaṇ+ḍa li: las kyi dbang mo nā gardzu: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bla ma rje btsun 'phags ma la: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gzhom du gsol: lan gsum/ bdag gi 'phags ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas rdo rje'i tshe brnyes par byas te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgo nas 'gro ba rnams bde chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: na mo: bdag gis 'phags ma khyod sgrub pas: tshogs gnyis yongs su smin nas kyang : bde gshegs mdzad pa bdag gis bsgrub: pha rol phyin drug la gnas shing : 'gro kun mchog tu 'god par bgyi: sogs lan gsum/ zhing mchog khyad par can de dag gi mdun du thabs khyad par 'phags pa yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos/

hoḥ 'phags ma dkon mchog 'khor bcas la: rab tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: las dang nyon mongs ci mchis bshags: 'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba bsod nams ci bsags pa: 'gro kun yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: slob dpon rje btsun 'phags ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du nges par gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: kyaiḥ dbang gi bdag nyid che ba'i mchog: thugs rje chen pos bdag la dgongs: 'phags ma tshe sbyin dkyil 'khor du: gzhugs shing smin grol dngos grub stsol: lan gsum/ 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig bsgrag cing dbang po'i mna' chu sbyin pa yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig gsang ba'i chu: tshul 'di gzhan la smra mi bya: nyams na lcags sdigs mgo dgu pas: khyod kyi snying khrag 'phrog par byed: de ma thag tu drag tu gshegs: de bas dam srung chu 'di 'thung : om̐ a mṛ te tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes dam chu blud: rdo rje'i bro bor ba 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes lan gsum gyis khas blang*/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa la dmigs par 'di bzhin du mdzod: las sngags dang bum chus bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag gzhan snod dang bcas pa rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs kyis sa gzhi ye shes kyi 'od lnga 'phro ba'i klong du trāṃ las gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ khyed rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo tāṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus te rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bde ba la bkod: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rje btsun 'phags ma thugs rje kun sgrol dkar gsal bcu drug gi lang tsho can/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchod sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs rjer 'dzin pa'i snyan g.yon gyi me tog rgyas pa: phyag zhabs kyi mthil rnams su zhi ba'i spyan gyis rnam par mdzes pa: dar lnga'i staud g.yogs dang dar dmar gyi smad g.yogs byas pa: rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras shing zhabs phyed skyil gyis 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i klong na bkra gsal ler bzhugs par gsal ba'i/ spyi bor zla ba la om̐ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la a dmar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ mthing ga /de dag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ slob dpon thugs rje kun sgrol du gsal ba'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te/ gnas gsum las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu rgyal ba rab 'byams ma lus pa 'phags ma tshe sbyin lha mo'i rnam par nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang bar byon pas/ khyed rang rnams dam tshig sems dpar gsal ba la dbyer med du sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces brda sbyar la las gzhung gi spyan 'dren gyis byin dbab/
