de nas tshe 'gugs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod: khyed rang 'phags ma sgrol ma dam ye gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar/ tsit+ta pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kha zum pa dwangs gsal mchong gur lta bu'i nang du/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla dkyil tāṃ yig gi mthar/ sngags phreng dkar por rang sgra dang bcas nas g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer gyi tshogs lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pa'i sne la tshe'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa stong khams gang bar byung bas/ rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi thugs rjes byin rlabs/ bstan g.yo snod bcud kyi tshe bkrag /'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe srog rnams bsdus te rang la thim pas sha khrag drod dbugs kyi khams nas sor chud/ 'byung ba'i snyigs ma dwangs ma'i ye shes su rgyas te 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bde blag tu thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā yu sid+dhi āḥ snang srid rnam dag pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dby-ings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags brjod/ rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'ja' dang 'od du me re re: sku dang tshom bur shigs se shig: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: byin rlabs char rgyun si li li: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi me re re: ma rig rtogs pa sangs se sang : gzugs phung 'od du ya la la: bdag nyid rdo rje'i sku thob nas: 'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thob cig: om̐ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

de ltar gyur pa de nyid la tshe'i pho nya rnams kyis 'bral med du srung zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad kyi thugs rje 'dus pa'i ngo bo om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas/ cis kyang mi 'gyur zhing mi shigs pa rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor rgyas btab pas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi 'ja' lus 'od sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces mda' dar gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rnams: skal ldan bu la dbyer med bzhugs: mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i rgya: ye shes lnga yi srog sgrub shog: badz+ra ka wa tsi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes srung zhing brtan par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba rnams grub nas dbang gi dngos gzhi bskur ba la/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rgyas gdab bcas drug tu yod pa la/ dang po sku bum pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum pa 'di nyid ye shes kyi rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du/ 'phags ma tshe sbyin lha mo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ khyod rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas lus thams cad gang*/ 'phags ma'i sku dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig / bum pa mgor bzhag la/ hūm̐: bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : lha dang dbyer med byang sems chus: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi: thugs rjes kun sgrol dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum chu blud/ gnyis pa gsung bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ba la/ bhan+dha 'di nyid zla gam dbang gi pho brang chen por tshe sbyin lha mo thabs mchog dbang gi rgyal po dang gnyis med du bde sbyor mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun na ra ra babs shing bhan+dhar 'khyil ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis rgyun/

khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i lam nas zhugs te/ rtsa khams thams cad bde bas gang*/ 'phags ma'i gsung dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig / bhan+dha mgrin par bzhag la/ hūm̐: bde chen bhan+dha'i gzhal yas su: thabs shes gnyis med byang sems bskyil: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung thig le ye shes su: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi blud/ gsum pa thugs man shel gyi dbang gi ngo sprod pa la/ lha sngags kyi mtshon pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kyi mdangs cha tsam las logs su med cing : rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba gsal stong dbye ba med cing 'chi med snang mtha'i ngo bo shel sgong dri ma med pa'i dpes brda tsam du mtshon te: rtsol bral ma bcos lhun grub kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas 'phags ma'i thugs dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig: shel rdo snying khar bzhag la/ hūm̐: rang byung ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha/ rang sems smra brjod bral ba'i gzhi: rtsol med ma bcos chos kyi sku: 'chi med snang mtha'i dgongs pa las: mi g.yo gsal stong la gnas shog: rtsa sngags/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzhi pa yon tan tshe rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba la/ tshe ril 'di nyid 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ yid bzhin 'dod rgu'i phung po 'bar ba/ 'phags ma'i thugs rje ye shes kyi rang bzhin can 'di nyid myang ba la brten nas/ phung khams thams cad dwangs ma'i 'ja' lus skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral zhing 'phags ma'i yon tan mtha' dag dang gnyis med du gyur par mos shig: tshe ril sbyin la/ hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud: 'dod yon mi zad tshe yi gter: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin: 'gyur med tshe la mnga' brnyes nas: bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin par shog: rtsa sngags/ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ:

lnga pa phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur ba la: me long 'di nyid dwangs gsal 'od kyi phung po chen po: dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i ngo bo: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dpa' bo ḍāk+kis bskor ba 'od du lam gyis zhu ba khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas sib sib thim pas: dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje mthu stobs nus rtsal ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs shing : 'phags ma'i phrin las rab 'byams dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces me long spyi bor bskor zhing / hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi dngos: pad+ma thod phreng dbang gi sku: thugs rje phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba'i: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog: om̐ badz+ra gu ru kā ya mu tra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: drug pa mi shigs pa rdo rje'i rgyas gdab pa la/ rdo rje 'di nyid dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ hūm̐ gi bu yug 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar 'phros pa kun kyang khrag 'thung khro tshogs su gyur te/ bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus nas/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la thim pas/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khro bo'i tshogs su gtams pas/ bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba he ru ka'i dpa' rtsal dang drag rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rdo rje spyir bzhag la/ hūm̐: dbang po thugs rje'i rol pa las: thabs shes gnyis med ye shes sprin: hūm̐ gi bu yug 'jig rten gang : tshur 'dus khro bo'i bde tshogs gtams: bdud bzhi g.yul las rnam rgyal shog: om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa maṃ: de nas mtshams sbyor bcas shes pa brjod cing tshe nas gtor/ de ltar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo thugs rje kun sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gzhung las/ lus ni lha la ngag ni sngags:

sems nyid 'od gsal phyag rgya che: rtag tu spyod pa'i dam tshig sgo: zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang srog 'dzin phyir dam tshig rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag? sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phyin chad spyi ltar bya/ slob dpon gyis tshogs la rol zhing lhag chog phyin chad las gzhung gi mjug bsdu ba rnams kyang gzhung bzhin byas pas grub bo/ /'phags ma'i thugs rje zla ba'i 'dzum zer gyis/ /sdig dang 'chi bdag mun pa mthar bskrad do/ /ring 'tsho'i chu gter rdo rje'i srog spel nas/ /bstan 'gro phan bdes yun du skyong gyur cig /ces pa'ang bla ma dang lha gnyis su med pas rjes su gnang ba stsal ba ltar/ khyer bde'i yan lag tu 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas dben khrod kun bzang bde gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ// // (ja) zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las/ mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rgyal ba kun yum chos sku kun bzang mo/ /rgyal kun phrin las longs sku myur ma dpal/ /rgyal kun dgyes bskyed sprul sku mkhar chen bza'/ /sku gsum dbyer med mkha' 'gros dus kun skyongs/ /de la thog mar mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du smin par bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po mkha' 'gro'i sku rten bkram pa'i mdun du dbang bzhi brtsegs thabs su bkod pa'i mthar/ gtor ma chad brtan bskul gsum/ chu gnyis nyer spyod nang mchod bcas dgos pa'i yo byad 'du byas la/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i skabs thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs dang*/ skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar rig pa'i me tog tsam gyis bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/

slob ma 'jug pa'i gsol 'debs rnams bya la dkyil 'khor yol bas dgab/ gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ de nas bsgrub bya rnams gral du 'khod pa dang las bum chus khrus byas la/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams sogs kyi mthar las sngags dang*/ yig brgya'i mthar/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyis tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i tshogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ de nas bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ h+ya ghṛ wa sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhu ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi? dge 'dun gyi? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du ma cig mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir gsang ba zab mo'i byin rlabs kyi dbang bskur bar byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar nas bgegs khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes drag sngags dang sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bskrad la gtor ma gtong*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ slob dpon gyis zhwa chos bcas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bka' gsang bla na med pa'i mtsho rgyal gsang sgrub ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo legs par gsan nas/ tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs ba'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnams legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ rgyal ba tshad med pa'i thugs rje mnga' ba rnams kyis gdul bya thar lam la 'dren par bya ba'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs zab cing rgya che ba dag bka' bstsal la/ de dag thams cad kyang bsdu na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin la/ de dag gnyis kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su nges par gcig mod kyang*/ gsang sngags ni khyad chos du ma'i sgo nas/ khyad par du 'phags shing lam myur ba yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs shing*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gsang sngags la'ang phyi nang rgyud sde gong 'og sogs mtha' klas par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rang re'i bod yul du sngags gsar rnying gnyis su byung ba las/ gsar ma las khyad par drug gi 'phags par gyur pa snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ rnying ma de nyid la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ste brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum du mchis pa las/ da lam zab mo dgongs pa'i gter gyi phyogs su+u gtogs pa yin/ de la'ang*/ rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ da lam gyi skabs 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul/

gter chen o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku'i sprul pa'i zlos gar lnga pa nges don chos dbyings grol gyis/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug lor mchog gyur zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nub mor mtsho rgyal dngos kyis sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum mtha' gtad dang bcas brda'i bskul ba las byung ba'i dus dman nyams chag skyon gyis lo brgyad gsang rgya btab cing*/ phyis su yul dus rten 'brel gyis bskul bas mtsho rgyal gsang sgrub sa bon tsam phab par mdzad pa ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi byin rlabs dbang bskur mdor bsdus su sgrub pa yin la/ de'ang rdo rje theg pa'i lam las dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha gtso bo ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid yin te/ de'ang don la lha yab yum la bzang ngan med kyang*/ 'dag bya dag byed kyi dbang du byas na shes rab rtsa ba dang thabs yan lag yin pa dang*/ bde ba chen po'ang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong par sgrub dgos pa dang*/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral yang*/ pho nya mo rnams bdag gi rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa'i phyir/ mchog 'dod pa rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha yi gtso bo mkha' 'gro yin par gsungs pa bzhin da lam mkha' 'gro'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur sgrub pa la'ang bdag nyid kyis bgyi 'os rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams deng 'dir yang gsang bla med shes rab ma rgyud don gyi theg pa rin po cher 'jug pa las su rung phyir/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod ltos par bcas pa yongs su 'bul snyam pas zhing khams shig 'bul bar zhu/

zhes maṇ+ḍal phul bcug de nas dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i don du snyim par me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa mchog gi grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal dang tha mi dad pa la/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ dbyings rig ngo bo ka dag spros dang bral: ye shes rab dga' bde chen g.yo ba mo: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i grol lam mchog gi sku: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ de nas mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du smon 'jug bla na med pa'i sems mchog dam pa bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can kun: tshe rabs thog med a 'thas 'khor bar 'khyams: 'khor 'das cig car rig pa'i yo lang gis: kun khyab byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ slar yang tshogs zhing de dag gi dkyil 'khor du phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/

/so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum/ dam chu sbyin la/ khyod nyid rnal 'byor grong zhugs nas: rnal 'byor ma yi ye shes ni: gang yin khyod la sbyin byed na: de bdag rdo rje slob dpon gyi: dam tshig gang yin khyod kyis srungs: badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dam tshig rdo rjes snying gar reg /ji ltar bsgom pa las mi 'da' bar thugs kyi dam tshig yid kyis bsrungs snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ dam chu lce thog tu myong*/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ye shes dbab pa la/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad legs par gcun te dam tshig pa'i lha sku 'di bzhin gsal thob cig: oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hoḥ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis/ /sna tshogs ge sar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng : rang rig ma bcos ye shes mtsho rgyal sku: gzhon nu sku lus bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: mtshan bzang dpe byad dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan: gser g.yu mu tig rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: sngo dmar ljang gu'i na bza' rnams kyis bklubs: sa le sbram gyi ska rags rdor mdud bcings: dpral bar rat+na'i me tog 'od lngas mtshan: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs bdag pad 'byung mtshan: lhag ma tsho gsum sku rgyab sked par bslebs: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dhar bdud rtsi tshe bum 'dzin: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum nu ma bha ga rgyas: lang tsho rab rgyas thugs kar pad nyi'i steng : rje btsun sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol: skyabs sbyin pad+ma longs sku'i rgyan chas spras: de yi thugs kar pad nyi zla gdan steng : yum chen sher phyin kun tu bzang mo mthing :

dbyer med rgyan spangs mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i zhing dang*/ khyad par lho nub rnga yab dpal ri rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing nas rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ de thams cad kyang mkha' 'gro'i sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod/ man ngag las byung ba bzhin du ye shes 'bebs sbyor gyi rdzas sreg cing rol mo dang bcas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ ma: mi dmigs 'og min zhing khams su: snang ba sna tshogs sku yi bkod: lhun gyis grub pa gsung gi rol: ka dag spros bral thugs kyi ngor: sku gsung thugs mchog spyan drangs nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir byon cig dbang mchog bskur: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin rlabs 'od dpung thibs se thib: dngos grub char rgyun si li li: rol mo'i sgra dbyangs di ri ri: dri zhim spos ngad chi li li: dam tshig bzhin du ci bder gshegs: log 'dren bgegs tshogs ma lus sel: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas ye shes pa dbab cing rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod pas de nyid brtan par bya'o/ /thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bum pa 'di nyid ye shes 'od lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ bum bcud ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mngon sum du bzhugs pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bskur ba'i mod la/

lha rnams bdud rtsi mer gyis zhu ba spyi bor sib kyis thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ skye ba thog ma med par lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las nyon thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bum pa dbyings phyug rdo rje'i mkha': bdud rtsi ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku+u yi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum chu blud/ des phyi mtshan ma sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus smin par byas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje mngon par byang chub pa lnga ldan sprul skur 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dang rang 'od kyi dpa' bo snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad/ rjes su chags pa'i mes bde ba'i ngo bor 'od du zhu ba thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu gyur pa nyid lce thog tu bzhag pas gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bhan+dha chos dbyings skye med klong : bdud rtsi ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gsung gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas/ ngag tha mal 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod rtsa rlung dang bcas pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro yab yum bde stong chen por zhu ba'i thig le lnga ldan khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas/

bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces snying khar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum gyi ngang : maṇ+ḍal ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying khar sin+dhu ra'i thig le bya/ de ltar bde chen ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ sems gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag /thig le bde ba chen por bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dbang dus su skyes pa'i zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bde ba chen po ji ltar nyi ma dang mar me nor bu'i 'od ltar dag cing gsal ba'i ye shes dri ma med pa'i snying po kun tu rtog pa'i rlung gis mi bskyod pa de ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas te/ de'ang rang gi sems nyid las gud na med de/ de ltar rtogs shing shes par byos shig /de ltar don dam byang chub kyi sems mtshan ma med pa shin tu spros med/ chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du nam mkha'i rdo rje'i de bzhin nyid kyi dbang thob/ sgo gsum smin par byas/ phyag rgya chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ so so rang rig ye shes kyi spyod yul dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum chen mo rnam par thar pa sgo gsum gyi skur 'grub pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ ces rtogs pa bskyed/ rnal 'byor ma yi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi ni dam tshig rnams: khyod kyis deng nas 'tsho ba'i srog bzhin rnam bzung la: rnal 'byor ma yi go 'phang mchog la blo chen gzhan yang sbyor bar gyis: zhes bsgo bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar?

de nas dbang bskur legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ltos med du bla ma la 'bul bas cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol/ dbang bskur thob pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams gzhan don du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor lhan cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams? sogs brjod la slob ma rnams grol lo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor thugs dam bskul ba chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol brtan bzhugs dang*/ rdzogs rim bsngo smon shis brjod sogs las gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sgo chen dgon pa'i dbu mdzad chen mo tshe dbang bdud 'dul mchog nas mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa zhig dgos gal che bas thugs sgrub kyi sgrub chen skabs 'di rang du grub pa mdzad rogs zhes nan bskul ngor/ sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags nas rigs mthun gzhung las kha bskangs nas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing mo bya'i lor cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes 15 la grub par bgyis pa'o// // (nya) rdo rje phur pa dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i las mtha' las byung ba'i dme brtsegs kyi byab khrus rgyud don rnam dag ces bya ba bzhugs/ thugs la shes bya'i sgrib pa mi mnga' bas/ /mchog gi ye shes dgongs par 'pho 'gyur med/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /rje btsun hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul spyi bos mchod/ /lcags kyis lcags khams rdul phran byed pa dang*/ /dug gis dug nus brlag par byed pa bzhin/ /dme ba brtsegs pas dme ba'i dri ma 'khrud/ /de phyir khrus chog zab mo khrigs su bsdeb/

de la 'dir rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter ston rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ chen kā ras stag tshang gnyis pa nas klong dgu'i brda shog spyan 'dren par mdzad pa'i gter chos dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i las mtha' las byung ba'i dme brtsegs khrus chog chu babs su bkral ba la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so/ dang po la gnyis shom 'god 'du bya ba dang*/ bdag mdun gyi rnal 'byor ro/ dang po ni/ ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs bu khebs ldan 'bru tshom dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ bum pa mgul chings mthing ga srog chags med pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chus gzugs sku gnyis kyi cha khengs par dam rdzas a mṛ ta sel med bcud du sbrams la/ de'i mdun du nyer spyod lnga yang bsham/ ci bde bar bsgrub bya'i glud skye mched shin tu dod par bzos pa'i mtha' bskor du glud rdzas ji ltar 'byor ba dang*/ khyad par du gtor yas kyi rigs thams cad la gsog thog nas gyer dang*/ gyer thog nas gsog thon pa zhes pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i gyer gzhung gis rtsis mgo bsdus te/ thams cad tshogs par bya/ ku sha dang rma bya'i mdongs kyi bya ba rdzas kyang bsag go /gnyis pa la gnyis las dang po bdag bskyed ni/ rang rig kun bzang rang ngo ma 'phrod par/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs/ /dag byed khro rgyal sme brtsegs bsgom par bya/ lan gsum gyis skyabs sems sngon du grub rjes rig pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du ka dag gi gsal cha lhar ldang ba ni/ skad cig rig pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du la: dme brtsegs mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rgod gshe rngam: g.yas gsum rdo rje rtse dgu ral gri zhags: g.yon gsum dgra satwa tri shūl gun+dhe bsnams: zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang nyi ma'i lte bar gnas: g.yon bskum zla ba'i steng na 'gying zhing brjid:

dur khrod dpal chas yongs rdzogs me dpung 'tshubs: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing raṃ gyis tshwa tshwa can: de mthar sngags phreng las 'phros me zer gyis: byad grib dme grib rtsa rlung nyams pa'i grib: bsreg sbyang ba spu'i bu gar khro chung dang : rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa me dpung stong gsum 'khyil: oṃ badz+ra bhur khung ma hā pra ma na ye bhur tsi bhur khi bhi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro ta rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: zhes gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dmigs gnad zur gsal gyi dgongs pas bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni bdag nyid nus ldan du bya ba yin no/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ gdod ma'i stong chen gyi don dran pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen bum pa'i nang : rgyu yi rig pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: sme brtsegs mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rgod gshe rngams: zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa me dpung stong gsum 'khyil: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim: badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ thugs ka nas 'dod yon gyis lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa spro zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi rab brgyan te: thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra u tsuṣ+ma kro ta rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ

sogs dang*/ sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe spyi dpal chen po yis/ /dug gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe/ /snam nas byung ba'i he ru kaḥ mthu stobs dpal ldan khyod la bstod/ dzap dmigs ni/ bdag nyid khro rgyal du gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ srog yig sngags phreng dang bcas gsal brtan gyi gzi byin 'bar/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad khyab cing thugs rgyud bskul ba dus gsum bde gshegs zhi khro thams cad nam mkha' bar snang khengs par byon/ bum lha sngags phreng dang bcas par thim pas mthu nus gzi byin thams cad mchog tu 'bar/ sngags phreng las byung ba'i 'od zer me stag 'phro ba lta bus snod bcud kyi grib gdon byad phur/ sdig sgrib thams cad dmigs med du bsregs te srid rtse nas mnar med yan chad me dpung gcig tu 'khyil bar dmigs la/ oṃ badz+ra bhur khung sogs ci nus bzla/ thun mthar 'od zer me dpung dang bcas pa tshur bsdus nas bum nang du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'khyil bar dmigs nas/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ sogs kyis mchod bstod nongs bshags grub rjes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : 'gal rkyen nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dang : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: mi mthun byang zhing dag par mdzod: bum lha bde stong chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi byab khrus bya ba ni/ 'o/ de'ang rang cag rnams sngon gyi tshogs gnyis zab mo'i 'phen pa la brten nas/ dge bcu sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor mi lus rin po che thob kyang*/ thog ma med pa nas goms shugs brtas pa'i gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa ma dag pas/

snang ba dgrar langs kyi cho 'phrul la brten nas/ byad gdon sri keg dme yugs/ grib rigs mi gtsang ba'i nus pas/ nyer len gyi phung po dang bsdongs nas/ dge legs kyi myu gu sad kyis 'khyer bar byed pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje rmad du byung ba rnams kyis de dag sel ba'i thabs dang rten 'brel zab pa dang rgya che ba ji snyed cig gsungs mod kyi/ de dag las khyad par du gyur pa ni/ ji skad du/ he badz+ra las/ dug gis dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'ching bar byed/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa yis/ /dug gi dug ni 'bigs par byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar mi gtsang ba'i dri ma 'khrud pa la khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa las khyad par du gyur pa gzhan med la/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i spyi rgyud dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rgyud kyi le'u bco lnga pa nas ru tra btul zhing khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ston pa'i skabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo chen po de dag gi snam nas bton te/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam gyi rgya mtshor tshud pa las snam nas u tsuṣ+ma kro ta phyung nas 'dam kun 'thungs te/ zhes 'og sgo nas khro bo sme brtsegs phyung nas/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam kun khro bo des 'thungs par bshad la/ bye brag tu gter kha 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus thun mong ma yin par/ sngon tshe dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: lta log ru tra bsgral phyir gnas su byon: ru trar brdzus te kro ti shwa rīr sbyor: sras mchog khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa 'khrungs: de yang rdo rje gzhon nu ji lta ba: zhal gsum phyag drug khro tshul 'jigs rung gis: ru tra 'khor bcas skrag cing brgyal bar gyur: thar pa nag po bsgral zhing 'khor bcas btul: bu yis pha bsad sme ba brtsegs pa zhes: thugs rje chen po sku mchog ye shes che: rten 'brel rol pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo las:

dri mas dri ma 'khrud pa ji bzhin du: ma 'ongs mi gtsang grib 'joms lha ru gyur: spyir ni sdig sgrib nyams grib yugs grib dang : bag grib mdze grib shan pa sdig can grib: pha spun nang 'khrugs phal pa'i dme grib dang : chos pa spyi 'khrugs khyad par gsang sngags kyi: dkyil 'khor gcig 'dus mched lcam 'khrugs pa ni: rdo rje'i dme grib nyams pa chen po ste: gang dang 'brel kyang 'di phyi gnyis ka phung : de phyir sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs bshad: ces dang*/ e ma zab pa'i mthar thug pa: sme brtsegs sgrub thabs byab chog bcas: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin pad+ma yis: theg chen dgongs 'dus rgyud nas bsdus: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: pha bu 'khon zhing yul mi 'khrugs: gsang sngags nang dme spyod pa'i tshe: sems bskyed ldan pa'i skyes bu yis: 'di ltar yul gyi chu mgo dang : chu chen chu phran lu ma sogs: skye 'gro spyod pa'i yul la bsgrub: lha rten gtsug lag kun la gtor: mi 'khon lha la 'phog pa dang : lha 'khon mi la 'phog pa'i grib: nad rims btsa' than sad ser zhi: gtsug lag 'dus sde rgyas pa dang : sgom chen ting 'dzin 'phel bar 'gyur: ces dang*/ 'ja' tshon ma ning gi sme brtsegs las mtha' las/ de ltar yang gnas khang grib can dang : gos btsog dang : mi grib chen dang 'grogs dgos pa byung na yang : sngags lan bdun btab pas chog go: gzhan yang zas grib: kha rlangs ro grib la sogs mi gtsang ba'i rigs thams cad la sngags chu slebs pas chog go: yig brgya dang rnam 'joms sogs kyis ma dag pa byung na: 'di kho na mchog tu 'gyur ro: de ci yin na: dri mas dri ma bkru ba dang : dug gis dug nad sel ba lta bu'o: zhes rgyud dang man ngag mang po nas bsngags pa chen por mdzad pa'i khrus chog zab mo las/ da lam skabs su babs pa ni/ ji skad du/ o rgyan chen pos/ nam mkha'i snying po shākya pra bha yi:

zung gis sprul pa'i 'od zer sgyu ma'i 'phrul: rdo rje'i ming 'dzin 'jigs med go cha can: zhes dang*/ pad+mas byin rlabs mtsho rgyal snying gi bu: thugs mchog rdo rje rtsal dang 'phrad nas kyang : snyigs ma'i 'gro ba skyobs pa'i dpal du shog: ces rdo rje'i gsung gis bsngags pa bzhin rtsod med kyi gter ston chen po thugs mchog rdo rjes laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du grags pa stag tshang gsang ba'i phug nas/ spyan drangs par mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa dregs 'dul gnam lcags 'khor lo'i chos sde las byung ba'i sme brtsegs kyi sgo nas khrus chog bya ba yin pas/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon yang tha mal du 'du mi shes par/ khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i gzi byin bzod par dka' ba'i rang bzhin du bsgoms nas/ grib gdon zhi ba'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs par zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ hūm̐: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang : 'gal rkyen nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dang : bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: mi mthun byang zhig dag gyur cig: ces dmigs gnad dang ldan pas rtsa sngags gang mang bzla ba dang mnyam du khrus bya zhing*/ khu ba glud nang du blugs/ de nas ku sha dang rma bya'i mdongs thogs la byab tshul gyis dri ma glud la bstims pa'i stangs ka dang bcas/ 'o/ de ltar nang ye shes lha'i bdud rtsis bkrus shing dag par byas nas/ phyi rten 'brel rdzas kyi phyag rgyas byab pa tsam gyis tshe rabs thog med kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams chag rtog sgrib rkyen ngan bar gcod mi mthun pa'i tshogs/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyis btang ba bzhin skya sangs sangs dag nas grib gdon mi shis pa thams cad glud la thim ste rang lus shel gong lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa yi: thugs rje'i 'od zer rtsal shugs kyis: khyod kyi nad dang gdon gyi rigs:

thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: thog med dus kyi nyams chag dang : rtog sgrib 'khon dang mi gtsang grib: rkyen ngan bar gcod mi mthun tshogs: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga: lci ba bzhi dang log pa brgyad: kha na ma tho sdig pa'i las: ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu thams cad: yongs su byang zhing dag gyur cig: las kyi grib dang nyon mongs grib: bag la nyal dang shes bya'i grib: lta ba dman dang chos spong grib: mtho ris thar pa'i gegs gyur rnams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: mna' tho khrel dang ngo tsha nyams: so thar rigs bdun sdom nyams dang : byang sems bslab bya sems bskyed nyams: gsang sngags sku gsung thugs dang nyams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor: sku glud 'bags dang log par bltas: dam rdzas bstan dang nyams chag rigs: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: snang ba a 'thas phyi yi grib: dug lnga 'dod zhen nang gi grib: tshogs drug bslu brid bar gyi grib: ma rig gzung 'dzin gsang ba'i grib: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: kha 'khyal bab chol khrom gyi grib: tho co rtsing spyod bag med grib: 'dod blo rngams pa sems kyi grib: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: bdag bstod gzhan smod nga rgyal grib: zhe 'dod gzhan bslu g.yo sgyu'i grib: ma rtogs shes brdzu rdzun gyi grib: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: dam bca' re ltos bcings pa'i grib: kha lta stong skad lta ba'i grib: le lo phyi bshol lam gyi grib: ma rtogs log rtogs 'bras bu'i grib: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: kha 'dzin chos spong grub mtha'i grib: the tshom som nyi rkyen gyi grib: bying rmugs 'thib gsum rtsa rlung grib: re dogs thams cad byang gyur cig: bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'khon: gzungs ma mched dang lcam dral 'khon: chos mdzad spyi dang 'khon pa'i grib:

thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: dpon po grogs dang pha ma gnyen: lha 'khon mi 'khon la sogs pa: rtsing spyod bag med 'khon grib rnams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: mdze yugs dme shan nal btsog dang : mnol btsog zas gos gnas stan grib: ro grib bag grib la sogs pa: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: lta nad smyo dang bdud nad 'thibs: rgyal nad smyo 'bogs gza' nad lkugs: btsan nad gzer 'thab ma mo'-i yams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: klu nad mdze dang dmu nad rmugs: gshin rje'i khram kha sde brgyad byad: rbod gtong rbad 'dre'i gdon grib rnams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: brgyal nad mig ser bal nad 'brum pa dang : rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs rnams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: lha klu bdud btsan gza' rgyal po: dmu gnyan the'u rang ma mo dang : gshin rje gnod sbyin phyogs skyong bcu: gdon rigs thams cad byang gyur cig: bgegs rgyal bi na ya ka sogs: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs dang : gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu rnams: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang : gtso bo'i gdon chen bco brgyad dang : phal pa bcu bzhi la sogs pa: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dang : ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dang : glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig sogs: thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad dang : chag che nyams nga mi mthun rkyen: gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog dbang gyur pa: thams cad byang dag gyur cig: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes byab par bya'o/ gsum pa rjes la yas glud bsngo zhing las mtha' bsdu ba ni/ yas glud rnams la chu chang bran/ ting lo sbar/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gam/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/

de nas mgron 'gugs pa ni rnal 'byor pa khro bo'i nga rgyal la gnas pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bca' la/ na mo/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/ lo rgyal po'i keg /zla ba blon po'i keg /zhag dmag mi'i keg /dus tshod mtshon cha'i keg /gzhan yang keg sum brgya drug stong*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu/ glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad/ bdud bzhi tshe yi bar gcod/ rgyal bsen dam sri the'u rang*/ mo 'dre bse rag chung sri/ god sri dgra sri/ nad sri yams kyi bdag po/ sgab 'dre yul 'dre 'khyams po la sogs pa/ gnod byed 'byung po thams cad glud gtor len pa la mchis par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sarba bigh+nān aṅku sha ya dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug kha 'bar ma'i mdo las byung ba'i sngags 'gyur khyad can rgya chen shugs ldan du grags pa/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na a wā lo ki ta oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags gang mang gis bsngos/ de nas glud 'phyong gyer ba ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : glud dang yas la dbang ba yi: bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la: sku glud rgyan ldan bsngo ba ni: ya mtshan ltad mo 'di ltar lags: mthing gi skra lo nyi li li: mgo sig ral pa yengs se yeng : shel gyi klad pa lung thang mig: lta stangs mig 'gyur hrig ge hrig: sna mdzes 'gron bu ya la la:

byi ru'i lce la rna ba dung : smra brjod sgra snyan lams se lam: dar skud rtsa la mu tig byams: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem nyigs se nyig: zho sha'i snying la a ru'i sha: bsam dang bkrag mdangs ya la la: mtshal gyi khrag la chu shel rus: bcud dang zhag g.yo me re re: me shel drod la rlung gi dbugs: bag dro sna bshugs kyu ru ru: rin chen sman sna'i nang khrol ldan: kun tshang dbang po nyi li li: lag pa g.yas g.yon gser dang dngul: phyag rgya pad kor lings se ling : rkang pa g.yas g.yon lcags dang zangs: rdog bro gar stabs khyugs se khyug: sku gsung thugs la dkar me lnga: sku lnga rang byung ta la la: dbang po rnams la ting lo drug: tshogs drug ma 'gags na ra ra: rnam shes brgyad la sha dum brgyad: skye gnas rnam bzhi byad dang ldan: phung khams lnga la 'brang rgyas lnga: 'byung ba'i bcud ldan khrigs se khrig: skye mched gtor chung bcu gnyis te: srid pa'i spyod 'gros kun kyang tshang : 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i na bza' gsol: snang srid kun gyi yid sems 'phrog: dkor nor shel tshig dpag yas stong : mnga' thang rgyal po chas pa 'dra: bang ba khyim gang yas rtags glud: tshong dpon lam du chas pa 'dra: gri khrab go mtshon rgyan dang ldan: dpa' bo dgra la chas pa 'dra: gser g.yu dar zab khro lo lo: mo btsun bag mar chas pa 'dra: bzhad gad rtse gar khrigs se khrig: lha phrug rtse rar tshogs pa 'dra: de bas ya mtshan ldan pa'i glud: mi bas glud dga' ngo mtshar che: mi la ya mtshan gang yang med: khog stod dug lnga me ltar 'bar: khog smad mi gtsang mtsho ltar 'khyil: tshe rabs bag chags mun ltar gtibs: las sgrib can gyi mi'u bskyur: yon tan ldan pa'i glud 'di longs: snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul: lan chags bu lon 'khor gyur cig: sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig:

ces brjod/ de nas lam bstan cing brdzangs pa ni/ glud kha phyir bsgyur la/ hūm̐: da ni bgegs la lam bstan 'tshal: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: lcags ri mun pa'i pha rol na: rin chen gser gyi pho brang na: longs spyod mi zad dkor nor yod: yid mtshar pho mo grangs med yod: de ru khyod kyi lam bstan no: bgegs kyi sa yul de ru che: bgegs kyi 'du tshogs de ru bzang : ya ga dmod pa'i mi rnams kyis: bgegs rgyal de ru byon zhes zer: mgron dang ston mo grabs yod skad: de ru bgegs la lam bstan no: 'di ru sdod pa'i gnas ma mchis: yul yang drag po e yi klong : phyi nang khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: mi rnams khro bo khro mo ste: drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: chas rnams dur khrod drag po'i chas: bgegs dpung gzhom pa'i mtshon char 'bebs: de bas chags pa'i gnas ma mchis: gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi bar mdzod: ces glud dang khrus khu 'dre lnga bdud gcod gnas pa'i sar bskyal lo/ thun dang drag sngags kyis gzir rjes/ gter gzhung rtsa bar/ dmigs bya sme ba brtsegs par bskyed: gnas gsum byin rlabs rdo rje'i go: kro ta rak+ṣas srung sngags brjod: ces pas bsgrub bya la dbang bskur zhing go bgo ba ni/ bum pa thogs la/ 'o/ khyed rang rnams skad cig dran rdzogs su khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i skur lam gyis gsal thob/ de la bdag gis dbang bskur ba'i tshe bdag nyid sme ba brtsegs pa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo dpag tu med pa thon nas/ khyed rang la ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: lhun grub bum pa chos kyi dbyings: rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan ye shes bcud: byin rlabs nus rtsal dbang bskur bas: nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra bhur khung ma hā pra ma na ye bhur rtsi bhur khi bhi ma le u tsuṣ+ma kro ta rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

zhes mgo thog tu 'jog cing khong du blud/ de nas go bgo ba ni/ de ltar khyed rang rnams khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i skur lhun gyis grub pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab dang khro chung gis bzhu lugs su gtams pas cis kyang mi shigs pa/ rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi rnam rol du rgyas thebs pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/ hūm̐: sgo gsum lha sngags ting 'dzin ldan: 'jigs med rdo rje'i go khrab brjid: bar mtshams khro chung 'bum gyis gtams: bzhu lugs lta bur dbyer med dang : cis kyang mi 'gyur mi shigs pa: chos nyid don la gnas gyur cig: badz+ra ka wā tsi rak+ṣa dhā tu āḥ zhes bsgrub bya'i gnas lnga dang tshigs bzhir rdo rje'i rgya gram bkod/ do gal shin tu che na grib srung bsam gtan nyal chog 'khor lo yang btags/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri? sogs kyis shis pa brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed nyer bsdu ni/ e ma ho/ gdod nas rig pa ka dag la/ /mtshan ma'i zhal phyag grub pa med/ /glo bur dri ma sbyang ba'i slad/ /gsal mdangs lhun grub lha skur shar/ /de yang rtags mtha' las grol phyir/ /gnyug ma zang thal spros bral ngang*/ /bcos bslad med par lhug par bzhag /gdod ma'i sa la grol bar 'gyur/ ces brjod la gting gsal ka dag gi dgongs pa mi g.yo bzhin du/ lam snang gi rig pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi gnad la gzir nas snang bzhi zad sar bskyel ba ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad thun mong ma yin pa'o/ 'dir smras pa/ dam pa'i rigs can drwa ma lnga po yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa spyod dang rgyal po dza'i/ khang steng glegs bam bab pa'i tan+t+ra las/ /spyi mdo dgongs 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bcud/ /pad+mas phyi rabs don du sgrub thabs su/ /bsdebs nas stag tshang gsang phug bskungs pa yi/ /bka' 'di shrī sing shākya pra bha la/

/babs nas klong dgu'i brda rtags bcud du smin/ /bka' bab rig 'dzin zhi bar gzims pa'i rjes/ /'das pa'i pra ni dha yis mtshams sbyar nas/ /bya las 'di ko bdag skal babs pa'i tshe/ /pha nor bu yi yin snyam lhur len byas/ zhes pa 'di ni gter chen bla ma mchog gi rigs kyi gdung rgyud mchog sprul bstan 'phel dge legs rgya mtsho dang*/ rje de nyid kyi zham ring gi thu bo/ dharma'i mtshan can gyis bkas bskul ba las/ theg mchog rnal 'byor la mos pa lam du byed pa'i sgrub pa po mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis/ rgyal zla chu srin gyi khyim zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal ri gsang sngags pho brang du sbyar ba dge'o// // (ta) mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i dbang bskur gyi cho ga bklag par rnam grol ye shes drwa ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud/ /gang gi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam bzang por/ /thar 'dod skal ldan 'jug sgo'i smin byed dag /bklag par rnam grol ye shes drwa ba spro/ /bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i dbang gi chog khrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro bsham bkod sgrub bzlas gnang bar zhu ba dang*/ dngos gzhi 'jug pa dbang bzhi/ rjes phrin las kyi mtha' sdud pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhung las/ thog mar dkyil 'khor cha tshang gzhung bzhin la: dbang rdzas dang ni mkho ba'i yo byad bsags: phyi nang 'byor ldan mchod tshogs legs par bshams: sngon 'gro dbang sgrub la sogs spyi ltar bya: maṇ+ḍal me tog bca' gzhi tshang bar bkod: ces gsungs pas/ gzhung ltar ram yid mthun gyi gnas su dkyil 'khor rdul tshon ras bris/ yang na stegs mthing nag la 'bru nag dza gad kyis brgyan pa'i tshom bu bkod/ gang gi tshe'ang dbus su rnam rgyal bum pa chas rdzogs bcud ldan kha rgyan tsakli dang bcas pa bkod/ mdun du me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang*/

shel rdo dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ g.yas su dpal gtor 'dab bzhis bskor ba gdan 'dab brgyad chos 'byung bsnol mas btegs pa la rin chen mkha' 'gro dar gdugs can/ rgyab tu mtshan ldan bhan+dha bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar dar dmar gyis bkab pa dang pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ g.yon du rdo rje rgya gram dang phyag mtshan dpal chas las kyi mkha' 'gro/ mdun du mchod gtor gru gsum bshos phran dang*/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka /byang shar du las bum/ gzhi mtshams ci rigs su bka' gter chos skyong gi gtor ma/ khor yug tu phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor/ gzhan yang sngon gtor tshogs mchod/ rdor dril/ ḍā ru/ rkang gling*/ spos thun/ me tog maṇ+ḍal sogs yo byad rnams bsags la/ bsgrub pa ni/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig gis las gzhung rgyas bsdus gang rung gtong*/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi mthar dzap khang dbye zhing spro bsdu dang bcas te dzap bzlas las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil bas brlabs/ chos skyong spyi dang dgos srung rnams rgyas par bskangs shing tshogs mchod bsgral bstab dang bcas pa bya/ lhas gnang ba'i mtshan ma mthong na ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang blang ngo*/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i 'jug sgo ni/ gzhung las/ de nas slob mar khrus bstsal gral du 'khod: chab chu sbyin nas bgegs bskrad maṇ+ḍal phul: rgyu 'bras lo rgyus khrid dag sngon du btang : zhes pas khrus sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐: bcom ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis: byin brlabs ye shes chu yis ni: skal ldan las can bu rnams kyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐: oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa sogs nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā g ba liṃ d+ya swā hā/ gsum gyis bsngo/ na moḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi? chos kyi bka'? dge 'dun? gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bdud 'dul ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir gsang ba zab mo'i byin rlabs kyis dbang bskur bar byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig / ces drag sngags dang sum+bha ni'i sngags kyis bskrad la gtor ma gtong*/ hūm̐/ thugs las spros pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i me: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig ngang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta'i 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra dz+wa la karma raṃ raṃ tsakra hūm̐ rak+ṣa ye swā hā: srung 'khor bsgom/ deng 'dir bka' gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang bla med shes rab ma rgyud don gyi theg pa rin po cher 'jug pa la las su rung phyir/ snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod ltos pa dang bcas pa yongs su 'bul snyam pas zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul te gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis zhwa chos bcas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bka' gsang bla na med pa bdud 'dul ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dbang bskur zab mo legs par gsan nas/ tshul bzhin nyams su blangs te/

bdag gzhan 'gro ba spyi dang khyad par du phyin ci log tu gyur pa mi bsrun bdud kyi sde tshogs mtha' dag nyon mongs pa'i snang ba rtsad nas gcod cing*/ gdod ma'i kun bzang mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pa sogs/ chos gsan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod rnams legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de'ang rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ bla ma sman pa dam chos sman dang ni/ /rang la nad pa'i 'du shes nyer bzhag ste/ /nan gtan brtson pas sman nyid bsten tshul dang*/ /zhi bde nad las grol ba'i 'bras thob bzhin/ /bsten tshul gzhan rnams tshul des dpag byas la/ /dag pa'i 'du shes bzhi yis bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ gang gsan bya'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ rgyal ba tshad med pa'i thugs rje mnga' ba rnams kyis gdul bya thar lam la 'dren par bya ba'i slad du/ chos kyi rnam grangs zab cing rgya che ba dag bka' bstsal la/ de dag thams cad kyang bsdu na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin la/ de dag gnyis kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su nges par gcig mod kyang*/ khyung dang bye'u'i gshog rtsal 'gran na myur khyad che ba ltar/ gsang sngags khyad chos du ma'i sgo nas/ khyad par du 'phags shing lam myur ba yin te/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs shing*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bus khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang sngags de nyid kyi 'jug sgo ni smin byed kyi dbang kho na ste/ dbang tshul bzhin du ma thob par ye shes lha'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor sogs bgyi ba'i skal ba dang nges par mi ldan la/ der ma zad gsang sngags kyi rgyud tshig zab mo klog pa dang phrin las kyi tshig shar du gyer ba'ang mi dbang ste/

dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ gang zhig rig sngags dbang bskur cho ga med/ /gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang*/ /gang dag bya ba sems dang mi ldan par/ /de yis gsang sngags bklag na phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /thob pa'i phan yon ni bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sogs/ gsang sngags kyi zab lam rnams nyams su len pa'i skal ba dang ldan zhing*/ de dag nyams su blang ba la bar chod nyung ba dang*/ dngos grub ring min du 'thob pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa ste/ klong gsal las/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid/ /tshe 'dir 'dod pa kun 'grub cing*/ /phyi ma mngon par rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de lta bu'i dbang de nyid lha dang dkyil 'khor ji lta bu la bsten nas bskur ba'i tshul ni/ gsang sngags phyi nang rgyud sde gong 'og sogs mtha' klas par bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rang re bod yul du sngags gsar rnying gnyis su byung bas/ gsar ma las khyad par drug gis 'phags par gyur pa ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ rnying ma de nyid la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang ste brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum du mchis pa las/ da lam zab mo gter ma'i ring lugs su gtogs pa yin/ gter ma de la'ang*/ gter ston dang gter kha'i rnam grangs ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ da lam gyi skabs 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar las byon pa/ rig 'dzin sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pa'am o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter las byon pa/ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zab lam ston pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la yid ches dang nges shes kyi lam la drang ba'i phyir/ lo rgyus mdo tsam zhig snyad na/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi bstan pa'i mjug tu/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gi bu mo seṅge'i gdong can bdud kyi sde tshogs dang bcas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs shing*/

'khrug rtsod nad yams mu ges bskal pa stong la nye ba na/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ thugs rje ye shes kyi spyan gyis 'dul thabs gzigs pas/ rang 'dra'i cha byad can gcig gis 'dul bar mkhyen te/ yab ma hā dhe wa dang*/ yum su kha sid+dhi'i sras su byin gyis brlabs pa/ seng gdong srin mo'i cha lugs su sku 'khrungs nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang ldan pas srid gsum dbang du bsdus/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas las chos nyan/ dbang chen rta mgrin gyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ mtshan mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul mar gsol/ ye shes thugs rje'i rtsal shugs chen pos bdud mo seng gdong ma 'khor mu stegs dregs pa'i sde tshogs dang bcas pa tshar bcad/ de'i tshe mu stegs kyi ngan sngags sha da ra sa mā ra ya zhes pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang sngags a ka sa ma ra tsa phaṭ kyi them du bcug ste/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i byad zor bzlog pa'i rig sngags su byin gyis brlabs/ phung po mkha' 'gro'i gzhal yas khang du mchod rdzas su bkram/ sems nyid ye shes mkha' 'gror gnas spar te/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung mar dbugs dbyung*/ 'khor phra men dregs pa'i sde tshogs dang bcas pa'i srog snying blangs shing dam la btags te srung mar bskos/ mu stegs sogs bdud rigs kyi ming yang mi grags shing*/ re zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i thugs rje dang smon lam gyi bden tshig gis bskal pa ma zhig gi bar du/ gdug pa 'dul ba'i mtshams legs par sbyar te/ dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su thim zhing*/ slar yang gang 'dul thugs rje'i sprul bsgyur mi bzad pa ston par lung bstan/ de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ dur khrod gsang chen bsnol du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas/

phyag zhabs kyi sor mo rnams mtshon cha'i rnam par snang bar mdzad pa de dag gcig tu dril ba las/ gnam lcags kyi sgrom bu 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba zhig tu gyur pa de'i nang nas/ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul ma zhes seng gdong rigs lnga'i rnam par byung ste/ de rnams kyis gnam lcags thog gi rgyud ces bya ba yi ge bcu gnyis pa rkang lag med pa/ gnam lcags ur mo'i gzugs sbrul bcun pa'i ris su byas pa 'dra ba zhig phul/ de la sangs rgyas kyi thog mar pha rgyud dang*/ ma rgyud dang*/ ma ning gi rgyud dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud dang*/ yang snying gsang ba'i rgyud dang lngar gsungs te gsang ba'i bdag por gtad nas/ ma 'ongs pa na gdug pa 'dul ba'i ched du dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mor gter du sbas par lung bstan/ gsang ba'i bdag pos rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs ma gha dha yi gling du/ rang byung gi mchod rten chen por gter du sbas so/ /dus phyi'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po nam mkha' shugs can dang*/ mu stegs kyi ston pa sde drug gis nang pa'i bstan pa 'joms par brtsams pa'i tshe/ dus gsum gyi ston pa'i rgyal tshab/ gu ru shākya seṅge 'khor drang srong paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang bcas pas rtsod pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyis pham par mdzad pa las/ mu stegs kyis mthu bsgrubs te gnam lcags thog gis nang pa'i rgyal po sūr+ya siṃ ha yon mchod rdo rje gdan dang bcas pa/ zhag bdun nas brlag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i springs yig sbyar bas/ nang pa'i rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad rab tu bred de/ slob dpon chen por zlog thabs zhus pas/ gu ru rin po che skad cig de nyid la/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser gshegs te/ dbyings phyug ḍāk+ki'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas/ thabs shes zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i gar gyis 'jig rten thams cad rab tu g.yos te/

ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bdud dang mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus te rdo rje mi shigs pa dgyes pa'i rang sgra las/ dpa' bo chen po gar gyi bdag /dgyes pa stobs bcu'i rtsal chen gyis/ /srid gsum zil gnon mthu stobs can/ /pad+ma badz+ra thugs rje'i rgyal/ khro zhing gtum pa'i gdul bya ba/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo yis/ khro rgyal de bzhin gshegs bskul mdzad/ /bdud dpung 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /gsang ba'i bdag por byin brlabs pas/ /rang byung mchod rten gsang mdzod nas/ /bdud 'dul drag sngags mngon du phyung*/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar byon/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ slob dpon gyis ma gha dha'i yul du byon nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ las dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro kun gyis rang rang gi srog snying phul/ khyad par gtso mo las kyi dbang mo ches/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo'i rgya bkrol te/ gnam lcags thog sgrom gyis ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i ḍāk+ki'i srog rtsa mngon du phyung*/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa spyan drangs te/ paṇa chen snod ldan bdun la bzlas lung byin par brtsams pa la/ rig sngags kyi nus pa stobs su smin nas/ pad+ma nyid khro bo seṅge sgra sgrogs kyi skur bzhengs te/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi khyon kun me dpung du bsgyur nas/ mu stegs rnams rang gshed du phab/ thog rnams rang steng du lhung nas/ ston pa sde drug 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa kha dag tu btang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ de nas slar gangs can bod kyi yul du/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis slob dpon spyan drangs/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang mthar dbyung*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rmang bting*/ rgya gar nas paṇa chen brgya rtsa brgyad spyan drangs te dam pa chos kyi sgra bsgyur/

phyi bon mu stegs pa rnam tshar bcad pa'i tshe/ bon gyis thog phab ste nang pa rnams la rgol bar brtsams pas/ jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis bdud 'dul drag sngags dmod pa'i bden tshig gis/ phyi bon rnams brtul zhing mtha' 'khob tu spyugs/ log smra'i bstan sel ming yang med par byas/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su mdzad/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel gyis mtshams legs par sbyar te/ ma 'ongs pa'i don du gangs can bod yul gyi/ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing rnams su/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i chos skor bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gu ru rin po che nas rtags ldan mi brjed pa'i shog ser la btab ste/ zab mo'i gter du sbas par mdzad pa las/ khyad par du gyur pa 'di nyid rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ gsang mtshan rdo rje bdud 'dul las rab rtsal zhes sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba rang cag kha ba ri pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa/ de nyid kyis khrom gter bdun dang gsang gter sum cu rtsa gnyis spyan drangs par mdzad pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ gsang rgya mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi'i ya gyal rmad du byung ba 'di nyid/ sa mo phag gi lo la/ mdo khams dbus kyi lte ba jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs mgul rlung 'khor dmar nag rak+ta 'khrugs pa'i mtsho chen nas/ khrom gter du gdan drangs par mdzad pa shog ser tshig brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya ma nyams par babs shing*/ slar pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal chen por shog ser mkha' 'gro'i brda yig las dpe brgyud du gtan la phab nas/ las ldan chos kyi bdag po rnams la smin grol du bstsal ba 'di nyid/ byin rlabs gzhan las myur zhing*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol med du 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzhung las/ de'ang ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i sgrub pa thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud: gu ru'i thugs kyi ti ka yin te:

byin brlabs dang nus pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags: ci'i phyir na: seng gdong ma phal cher byed bzlog dang las chas yin te: bsgrubs pas thun mong gi dngos grub tsam rnyed kyang 'khu ldog che: de la seng gdong ma dmar mo ni las chas 'jig rten la gnas pa'i sha gzugs te: 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtags ni seng zhal dkar sngon tsam las 'khor rnams kyang phra men sha zas bskor ba ni ḍāk+ki srog gzan ma'i rgyud yin: des na 'di nyid chos dbyings mthing ka ma bcos pa'i klong gi dngos po dang rtags mthun te: dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying rje'i rang sgra che'i brdar seng zhal dang ldan pa: de'ang mkha' 'gro gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshon bya: 'khor rnams kyang ye shes kyi ḍāk+ki ma dang : shugs kyis rang rtsal rnams kyang snying rje'i 'phrul du gnas pa'o: rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med phyir: rigs bdag seṅge'i sgra sgrogs kyis spyi bor brgyan pa ste: byin rlabs gzhan las khyad par 'phags so: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan la rtag tu mkha' 'gro 'du zhing gsang ba'i rten 'byung kun gyi gtso mo che yin pas 'gro ba dbang du 'du: yang dag don gyi sgrub pa yin pas mchog gi dngos grub 'thob: lus med ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yin pas tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub: mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam yin pas bgrod 'gyu mi dgos par zhing khams mthong : mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig kun gyi srog la gnas pas: log lta can la dmigs gtad kyis mthu ma btang yang bka' chad kyis sgrol nus: mkha' 'gro ma 'di dbang sdud kun gyi gtso mo yin pas: longs spyod mi 'dod kyang char du 'bebs: bsnyen sgrub phran bu las ma thon kyang : mkha' 'gro'i gsung shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pas grub rtags myur: 'di rang byung lhan skyes kyi mkha' 'gro yin pas sgrub pa la 'khu ldog mi nus: 'byung ba lnga'i bdag mo yin pas rtsa rlung dang nus stobs rgyas shing khams bkrag mdangs 'phel:

gsung dbyangs drug cu'i rang bzhin du gnas pas: mkhyen gnyis kyi rig pa ma sbyangs kyang lhums su zhugs: dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso mo shes rab kyi yum yin pas: 'di nyid bsgrubs pas gzhan thams cad gcig 'dus su 'grub: dbang bzhi'i gtso bo ye shes kyi dbang yin pas: dbang bskur yongs rdzogs su 'gro: phar phyin drug gi sdong po shes rab phar phyin yin pas: bslab pa thams cad rang rdzogs su 'gro: pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis las shes rab ma rgyud don gyi theg pa yin pas: rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bor 'jug: bskyed rdzogs gnyis las kyang shes rab rdzogs rim gtso bo yin pas 'di ni rdzogs rim du 'jug: de bas skal ldan las can rnams kyis 'di nyid kyi sgom sgrub bgyi zhing nyams su len par bya'o: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rdo rje theg pa'i las la mchog tu gyur pa/ lhag pa'i lha mchog dbyings phyug ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nyid las gzhan du ma gyur pa'o/ /de'ang zab mo gter gyi ring lugs dam par brgyud pa rnam drug dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ gter lung chen mo las/ sprul skus chos rnams gsungs pa yang : sgra tshig don las logs na med: gter yig sprul pa'i sku yi phyir: de yi brjod tshig sgra yang yin: de nyid go ba don yin no: zhes snyan brgyud tshang ba dang*/ dgongs brgyud de nyid las/ rgyal ba dgongs pa gnyis kyi tshul: dgongs pa bka' bab dbang gi mchog: ces dang*/ brda rgyud tshang ba ni/ rim pa bdun pa'i rgyud las/ brda dang brda yis mtshon pa ni: dbang gi nang nas dbang dka'o: zhes gsungs pas/ thugs rje byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gter lung chen mo las/ gang gis byin rlabs zhugs pa de: dbang gi dam pa mchog tu dbang : zhais dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gter rgya'i brgyud pa tshang ba ni/ gter gtad rgya ma las/ gtad rgya gang la gtad pa ni: sangs rgyas kun gyis 'dzin pa'o: zhais dang*/

smon lam dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa tshang ba ni/ yang de nyid las/ smon lam dbang ni dbang bskur yin: zhes gsungs pas/ a 'thas log rtog gi 'dam du byings pa kha gcig gis/ gter gyi dbang la bum pa'i chu chad pas bskur du mi rung zer ba'i smra mchu can rnams kyis/ mtha' bkag cing sgro skur bsal ba'o/ /de lta bu dang ldan pa'i brgyud pa 'di la/ bar snang du rig 'dzin gyi gral ma zhig /sa gzhi ru sman raka gi mtsho ma skam/ brgyud pa dang mi'i bar du khyi ma shor/ 'dres khyer dang rtog ges bsre bslad ma zhugs/ gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal bar brgyud thag nye ba la khungs btsun pa yin/ de ltar brjod pa'i dgos pa'ang*/ pha rgyud lta ba klong yangs las/ dad pa rab tu 'thob bya'i phyir/ /lo rgyus de dag brjod par bya/ /zhes so/ /brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos la/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang*/ smin nas grol bar byed pa'i nyams khrid/ srung bzlog gi las tshogs sogs shin tu zab cing don dril bar mchis pa las/ da lam smin byed spel ba'i skabs su bab pa yin pas/ de la'ang slob dpon gyis bgyir 'os pa/ sgrub bzlas gnang bar zhu ba sogs legs par grub nas/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la thun mong dang khyad par gnyis te/ thog mar thun mong gi sngon du 'gro ba ni/ rang rgyud 'dul zhing mdo las/ bsam pa med par nyal te gnyid log na/ /'jig rten 'di yi nyi ma sgo ru nub/ /ces gsungs pas/ rang cag rnams skye bar dka' ba lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ 'thob par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mjal ba'i skabs 'dir/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob par bya dgos shing*/ gal te de dag ma thob na mi lus thob kyang stong log yin par/

blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las/ skye ba mang po thob gyur cing*/ /yun ring bar du bed spyad nas/ /chom pos 'phrog pa ji bzhin du/ /sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos kho na la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa bskyed dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ klong gsal las/ skyabs 'gro thun mong nas brtsams te/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur bar bya/ /zhes pas skyabs rten mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' zer 'od phung khyab brdal gyi klong nas/ bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i/ gu ru rdo rje thod phreng mthing gsal rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mtsho rgyal dkar mo dang gnyis med du sbyor ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa de la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro chos srung*/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa der/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig ste sngon chad ma thob pa rnams 'thob par bya ba dang*/ thob pa rnams gong nas gong du spel ba dang*/ gal te nyams chag byung ba rnams sor chud par bya ba'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams deng nas ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir/ phar phyin drug gi spyod pa la lhur len pa dang*/ gzhan don du ye shes dbyings nas spyan drang ba/ tshad med bzhi'i phrin las rdzogs par gsol ba gdab/ gdul bya'i mos ngor bzhugs su gsol ba/ sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba/ las nyon shes bya'i sdig pa bshags pa/ rmad byung gi phrin las la yi rang ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ mya ngan la mi 'da' bar rtag tu bzhugs su gsol ba/

dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo ba ste/ tshig don yid la bsam bzhin du sdom gsum cig car du nod snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ ma: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed do: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho dbyings nas gshegs: rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: ma chags pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: dkyil 'khor gsang bar rjes yi rang : bla med chos 'khor dam pa bskor: 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: yang dag ye shes chen por bsngo:

lan gsum/ de ltar sdom pa gsum la rtag tu mi 'da' bar bsrung dgos snyam pa'i sgo nas slar yang 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdoms pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bya/ lan gsum/ dpal mchog las/ sdom pa dam tshig kun gyi gnas/ /de bsrungs dngos grub myur du thob/ /ces gsungs/ de ltar skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ba khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ rang nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro ba kun gyi dad dpon mchog tu gyur par bsams la/ slob dpon dang gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs gnyis su med pa'i spyan sngar/ dngos gzhi'i dbang gi slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kyaiḥ dpa' bo rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: yang dag ye shes sa mkhan gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag cag la: 'ja' lus ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ kye hoḥskal ldan las can nyon: 'di ni ye shes ḍāk+ki'i dal: snod ldan rnams kyi spyod yul mchog: skal med tshogs rnams phyir dengs shig: oṃ ḍāk+ki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐: glags lta'i bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ nang mchod nas dam chu sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐: 'di na dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs 'thob: ma bsrung las kyi mkha' 'gro yis: na rag ltung ba'i bka' chad 'bebs: de bas dam tshig chu 'di 'thung : oṃ sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig: ces dam bsgrag /de ltar dbang gi bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyis bka' bsgo ba rnams cha tsam yang ma nyams par bsrung bar khas blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: lan gsum/ de'ang klong gsal las dam tshig khas len gyur na sbyin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin bka'i gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gzhi bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/

ye shes dbab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyi chu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag gzhan snod bcud dang bcas pa mi dmigs par gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs 'di nyid e las chos 'byung mthing nag zur gsum pa: gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs shing rtse mo phra ba mthur du zug cing rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su: pam̐ las pad+ma dang : ram̐ las nyi ma: a las zla ba: de'i steng du bam ro smug nag mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i snying khar: khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes ba'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las: skad cig gis ma cig yum chen dbyings phyug seng gdong can sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis mas: g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i: gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten cing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa: rngam par khro ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa: me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i spyi bor gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs mthing nag gis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub mdzad nas bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa: gtso mo'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma sde bzhi ni: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs te thams cad kyang rang mdog rgyan dang ldan pa'o: de'i mtshams bzhir sgo skyong ma bzhi: gzhan yang ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad sprin bzhin du gtibs pa'o: de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ ha ri ni sa'i rang mdog can du gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag nyid slob dpon ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad 'phros pas/

rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings dang*/ mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing mchog rnams nas/ ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' bar snang gang bar spyan drangs/ de'ang sku che ba rnams ri rab tsam/ chung ba rnams yungs 'bru tsam/ bar pa rnams rang lus kyi bong tshad tsam/ steng nas byon pa thams cad char babs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa thams cad sa rlung rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal bar sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brdar sbyar nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki siṃ ha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ zhes ye shes dbab/ de ltar dam ye dbyer med du brtan par bya phyir sangs rgyas sku lnga'i rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyis spyi bor rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes rdo rje me tog dang bcas pas spyi baur rgya gram du bkod/ de nas khyad par du dbang dngos la/ klong gsal las/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*/ phrin las dag gi dbang bskur bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sku bum pa'i lha dbang*/ gsung bdud rtsi'i sngags dbang*/ thugs dkyil 'khor gyi don dbang*/ yon tan gtor ma'i rdzas dbang*/ phrin las phyag rgya'i spyod dbang*/ brtul zhugs bdud 'dul gyi chas dbang*/ phyag mtshan drag po'i sgrol dbang*/ yongs rdzogs dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod/ mtha' rten gtor ma'i bden tshig dang dgu las/ thog mar bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bum pa 'di nyid ye shes 'od lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ bum bcud bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mngon sum du bzhugs pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bskur ba'i mod la/ lha rnams bdud rtsir mer gyis zhu ba spyi bor sib kyis thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/

skye ba thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i las nyon thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gnyis med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bum pa dbyings phyug rdo rje'i mkha': bdud rtsi ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku+u yi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum chu blud/ de nas lha sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba las/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas gnas pa'i nges shes brtan pa dang*/ slob dpon yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dngos su mos pa bskyed la/ de'i thugs rje'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi rgyud bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ snod bcud thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par bzhengs pa'i klong las/ sku'i rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo grangs med 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas zhe sdang gi rtog pa sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas nas/ zhi ba'i las kun thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpral bar bzhag cing*/ hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: zhe sdang rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhi ba'i las kun yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung gi rang bzhin pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas 'dod chags kyi rtog pa sbyangs/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ dbang gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid: 'dod chags rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

dbang sdud phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro seng gdong thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas gti mug gi rtog pa sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mchog gi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces snying khar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: gti mug rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yang dag ye shes mngon rdzogs shog: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi yon tan gyi mkha' 'gro ma ser mo grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas nga rgyal gyi rtog pa sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rgyas pa'i las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces lte bar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: nga rgyal rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rgyas pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi phrin las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu grangs med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas phrag dog gi rtogs pa sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ /drag po mngon spyod kyi las thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gsang bar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phrag dog rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i gtso: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: drag po'i mngon spyod yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar gyi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas byams pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje shugs 'gro ma dkar sngon grangs med 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi dpung g.yas tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/

rtag par lta ba gnas su dag nas/ tshogs lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dpung g.yas su bzhag la/ hūm̐: byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid: rtag par lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tshogs lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ha badz+ra aṅku sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lho'i sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor lho nas snying rje'i bdag nyid rang bzhin rin chen shugs 'gro ma ser dmar grangs med 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi dpung g.yon tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ chad par lta ba nas su dag nas/ sbyor lam shes rab kyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dpung g.yon du bzhag la/ hūm̐: snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid: chad par lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sbyor lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ri rat+na pa sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nub kyi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas dga' ba'i ngo bo pad+ma shugs 'gro ma dmar ljang grangs med 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi pus g.yas kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ dngos por lta ba gnas su dag nas/ mthong lam phyir mi ldog pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pus mo g.yas su bzhag la/ hūm̐: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid: dngos por lta ba rnam dag pa: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: mthong lam theg chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ ni pad+ma s+pho ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang gi sgo ma thogs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs nas btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin karma shugs 'gro ma ljang dkar grangs med 'phros pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi pus g.yon tshigs kyi 'khor lo la thim pas/ bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag nas/ sgom lam mthar phyin gyi bstan srid zin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pus mo g.yon du bzhag la/ hūm̐: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid: bdag tu lta ba rnam dag pas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: sgom lam mthar phyin yongs rdzogs shog:

oṃ sa karma ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rigs bdag thogs la/ de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas nyon mongs lnga'i sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa mngon du byas/ phrin las bzhi'i bden pa tshad du phyin/ bdud 'dul ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i rdzu 'phrul sku'i phyag rgya rdzogs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbu gtsug rigs lnga'i zhing khams nas/ bde gshegs sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs la/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing*/ byin rlabs gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas/ rigs thams kyi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mo cher gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin kun dngos mchog: gti mug rgol ba rab 'joms pa: dpa' bo seṅge'i sgra dang ldan: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ gu ru siṃ ha swa na gaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ mchog gi dngos grub la mnga' brnyes shing*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog 'thor/ bum dbang gi gtang rag dang sngags dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnyis pa gsung gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba la/ dung chen bde ba chen po ye shes lnga'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams rigs kyi dpa' bo yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar bcud du 'khyil ba'i/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen po dngos grub kun gyi dbyig tu gyur pa 'di nyid mgrin par bskur zhing myong ba la brten nas/ tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum grags stong skye med rgyal ba'i gsung mchog mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/
