ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bhan+dha chos dbyings skye med klong : bdud rtsi ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: gsung gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi blud/ de ltar gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas/ ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod rtsa rlung la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog 'thor/ gsang dbang gi gtang rag dang sher dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ me long thogs la/ gsum pa thugs kyi dbang bskur ba la/ me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid chos 'byung kha sbyor gyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs yab yum rnams/ bde stong chen por zhu ba'i thig le lnga ldan khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pas/ tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i yid sgrib sbyangs/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chen po ka dag zab gsal rgyal ba'i thugs mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces snying khar bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba gsum gyi ngang : maṇ+ḍal ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes snying khar sin+dhu ra'i thig le bya/ de ltar bde chen ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ sems gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag /thig le bde ba chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog 'thor/ shes rab dbang gi gtang rag dang*/ rtsal dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gtor ma thogs la/ bzhi pa yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba la/ gtor ma 'di nyid 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi nus stobs rdzogs pa/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i yon tan gyi rang bzhin ye shes 'od kyi snying po mchog thun dngos grub kyi dam rdzas rmad du byung ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar bzhag pa tsam gyis las rlung dhū tir dag ste/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces lte bar bzhag hūm̐: gtor ma rmad byung bla med rdzas: ngo bo ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar rmad byung yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi 'dzin pa rnam par dag /chos thams cad mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rol rtsal du sbyang ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog 'thor/ rtsal dbang gi gtang rag dang*/ spyod dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje rgya gram thogs la/ lnga pa phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba la sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram 'di nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can 'di nyid/

khyed rang rnams kyi gsang bar thim pas/ ye shes kyi rlung lnga'i nus rtsal stobs su smin te sgrib byed dbyings su yal/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad lhun grub kyis gzhi la rtsal rdzogs pa'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gsang bar bzhag hūm̐: mi 'gyur ting 'dzin yang dag rgyal: phyag mtshan ye shes ḍāk+ki dngos: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de ltar phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang bskur bas/ srid pa gsum gyi bdar sha chod de/ 'khor 'das dbyer med phyam brdal du gyur nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs phyi nang gsang gsum phrin las kyi nam mkha' dang mnyam par spyod pa'i skal ldan du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la me tog 'thor/ sku lnga'i gtang rag dang*/ mtha' rten zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dpal chas thogs la/ drug pa brtul zhugs kyi chas dbang bskur ba la/ de ltar dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid du che ba bskyed cing*/ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i che rtags kyi dpal chas rnams mngon du phul bas/ srid pa gsum na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba/ bdud dpung zil gnon gyi mthu stobs yongs su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces gnas so sor brgyan pa ni/ hūm̐: prog zhu glang ko zhing gi lpags: thod phreng rus rgyan stag sham sbrul: me long cod pan khrag zhag tshom: dur khrod chas rdzogs dbang bskur ro: oṃ sha ma sha na ar+bha sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdun pa phyag mtshan drag po'i sgrol dbang bskur ba la/ bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod pa'i gnam lcags kyi gri gug /nyon mongs zad sar brlag pa'i thod khrag /dug lnga dbyings grol gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ste/ bdud 'dul dpa' mo'i phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i rang bzhin du gtad pa tsam gyis/

srid pa gsum gyi log 'dren bdud tshogs dpa' stobs drag po'i rtsal ngar dang ldan pas cig car du gzhom pa'i phrin las mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: gri gug 'bar bas bdud dpung 'joms: bhan+dhas 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: kha ṭ+wāṃ dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: skal ldan bu la phyag mtshan sbyin: oṃ ta ka ri bhan+dha tri shu la ka ra rta ra hūm̐: bum thod shel rdo gcig tu dril ba thogs la/ brgyad pa dbang thams cad kyi brten par byed pa dbang bzhi yongs kyi brda don gcig tu ngo sprad pa la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bcud 'dus bum pa'i dbang bskur ba tsam gyis phung khams skye mched snod bcud dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor du rgyas theb pas snang ba sprul sku/ bhan+dha'i dbang bskur bas rlung lnga'i 'du 'phro thams cad bde stong ye shes su rdzogs pas longs sku/ man shel 'od kyi phung po gsal stong 'dzin med kyi brda don gyi ngo sprad pas chos sku/ kun gzhi gnas lugs 'pho 'gyur bri gang dang bral ba'i ngang du/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye grol ka dag zad sar 'khyol ba'i rten 'brel mngon du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bskyed rim sprul sku bum pa gzhal yas khang : 'byin 'jug gsang dbang ā li kā li'i sgra: shes rab gnas lugs gsal ba shel gyi mdangs: ye shes chen po rdzogs rim dri ma med: 'od gsal ngang la dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs pas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: brda sprod gcig la dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum chu dang bdud rtsi blud/ dgu pa mtha' rten gtor mas dbang bskur bar byed pa la/ gtor ma 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal pa ma yin par gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa 'ja' zer 'od phung rab tu 'khrigs pa'i steng gi cha la rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/

bar gyi cha la bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la gnas yul gyi dpa' bo ḍāk+ki/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad/ 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rnam par khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad sangs kyis dag /mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rje btsun dus gsum sangs rgyas gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa: rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje nas drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang : chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sprul sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dbyings phyug ḍāk+ki seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku sprul rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: gsung sprul pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: thugs sprul sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: yon tan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: phrin las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rnam thar bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: khyad par ma sring ḍāk+ki bye ba 'bum gyis skal ldan gyi slob ma 'di la: sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol: steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa: 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa: bar gdon btsan dang the'u rang gi gnod pa la sogs mi mthun pa'i bgegs rkyen thams cad zhi zhing byang bar gyur cig: lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du smin par gyur cig grol bar gyur cig /'bar bar gyur cig /gsal bar gyur cig /brten par gyur cig /oṃ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ye dharma sogs/ lha tshogs rnams deng nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/

'gal rkyen bsal zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i gnang ba bzang po dang bcas te/ bdud rtsi zhu ba khyed rang rnams kyi myong ba la brten nas/ sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor rgyas theb pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la gtor zan gyi ras ma dang bdud rtsi sbyin/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa dbang srog rgyud la 'dzin par byed pa dam tshig yin te/ de ltar rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi legs par thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad sgom sgrub las mtha' phyi nang gi bya ba thams cad byed du rung*/ mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig lnga mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung dgos/ dam tshig lnga gang zhe na/ gter gzhung las/ sku'i dam tshig tu bskyed rim mi spang : gsung gi dam tshig tu bsnyen sgrub mi g.yel: thugs kyi dam tshig tu dbyings phyug gsang ba'i ye shes la rgyun du gnas: yon tan gyi dam tshig tshogs gtor skong bshags sogs dus kyi mchod pa mi bcag: phrin las kyi dam tshig tu las bzhi'i bya ba brtsam zhing mthar phyin par bya: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i dam tshig tu bud med rnams la smad par mi bya: skyon du mi blta: sdang bar mi bgyid: 'bu shu mi bskul: rtsa khams bde ba chen po'i zag med la rab tu gnas par bya: khyad par gyi dam tshig ni: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa grol nas: zhag bdun gyi bar mal stan mgo mjug mi ldog: 'og rta mo rigs mi zhon: bud med kyi grib mar mi 'gom: tha na phran tshig tsam yang spang : dbyangs snyan pa'i bye'u ku dir mi bya: gos hrul po mi gyon: ci'i phyir zhe na: thog mar phrin las lnga'i dam tshig dang mi ldan na: ye shes lnga dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor rten ma mchis: bar du gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams na: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro mi gzugs su mchis pas phrag dog skyed phyir sgrub grogs mi byed: ye shes mkha' 'gro bsgrub na phyi thag ring :

khyad par gyi dam tshig dang 'gal na rten 'brel nyams pa ste: phyin chad sgrub pa'i 'phro mi gcod: khyad par du tshe 'di nyid la grub pa thob kyang : pho nya'i gsang lam mi rnyed: ci ste rnyed kyang bdud dbang gi skyon can no: de bas mkha' 'gro'i phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig la mi 'gal bar bya'o: zhes ji ltar bgo ba bzhin yongs su bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum mo/ /de ltar gyur pa de nyid la: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas me tog 'thor zhing*/ shis pa brjod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i 'od: rab dga'i mdangs ldan g.yo ba mo: seng gdong ḍāk+ki'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor ro/ /bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ des rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zab gter las byon pa bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa yin pas/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byed cing*/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba yongs sgrol shog / ces dge ba bsngo zhing slob ma rnams phyir grol/ spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs lhag gtor skyong sogs/ bkra shis kyi bar rdzogs par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams mi mngon par bsdu bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang bdag blun rmongs skyid grong smyon pas bkod pa dge'o/ /gu h+yas slar zhus shing kha 'gengs dgos pa sab la dag bcos phran bu byas so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// (tha) byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun bklag chog tu bkod pa byad kyi sprin nag gzhom pa'i rdo rje'i 'thor rlung bzhugs so/

srid gsum byad gdon phas rgol glang khyu'i klad/ /gcig car 'gems mdzad gdong lnga drag mo yis/ /las sbyor gnam sa g.yo ba'i nga ro 'dir/ /sgrogs la dam can mkha' 'gros gnang ba stsol/ de la byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi lag len la 'jug pa'i thog mar sbyor ba brtsam pa la/ sgrub khang gi phugs su stegs bu'i kheb ldan steng du/ bdag bskyed seng gdong ma'i gtor ma gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ de steng chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de steng dpal gtor leb zhal zur thon keng mgo'i pad 'dab can/ mdun du zor gtor gtso 'khor gsum pa khrag kyu gsum gyi nang du ling chung gsum bsnan/ tshe nyungs sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ g.yas su sman g.yon du rak+ta nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga sogs bsham/ mdun du zangs gzhong lta bu'i khar 'phang hom steng*/ phung sa rdo sol bye nag skyer sol bsres pa'i tsha nag dang*/ de steng mda' hom steng cu gang*/ cong zhi/ ka la ma bcas bsregs pa'i tsha dkar byad thag gis dkris pa/ nya bo ling kheb ldan pa/ bya rog dang 'ug sgro/ gu gul/ thun rdzas sgrol phur/ gri gug ral gri byad thag dar tshon sna lnga sogs 'du bya/ gzhan yang rdor dril rnga rol bcas dang*/ dkar bgegs tshogs gtor bcas ji ltar dgos pa 'du bgyis pa dang*/ dmigs bsal byad zlog sogs kyi skabs chad brtan bskul gsum/ sna sel dkar gtor/ grangs gsog tshe 'bul rgyus gtor chung liṅga sogs dgos kyang*/ byad khrol rkyang pa'i skabs de rnams mi dgos/ mdun bskyed bum sgrub ni/ stegs bu'i steng ras dkar dri med g.yogs pa'i khar 'bru tshom bkod pa'i thog bsgrub bya mang nyung gi ldang tshod shong ba'i/ bum par rgyun ldan gyi chu la dri bzang chos sman blugs/ mgul chings dar ljang dang kha rgyan ku sha rma bya'i mdongs kyi khrod/ dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi 'khor lo yig rgod kyi lte bar khyad par gyi pho 'khor mo 'khor gnyis dpe ris bzhin la/

gla rtsi/ shu dag /spru nag /thang khrom/ gu gul/ shing kun bcas byugs/ thog lcags/ sbal sha/ nya sha/ sbrul sha/ sdig sha/ lcags sdig sha/ lcung ka'i snying*/ pho rog gi snying*/ glag nag gi snying*/ spyang ki'i snying*/ stag gzig dom dred rnams kyi mche ba dang sder mo/ dur bya'i mchu/ khrung khrung gi rgyus pa/ g.yag rgod kyi rwa/ phag rgod kyi mche ba bcas dar nag gis thum bu bgyis pa 'khor lo'i lte bar bzhag cing dar tshon sna lnga'i chings rgyan spras pa dang*/ de'i mdun du nyer spyod phyi nang sogs kyang bsham/ rgyas pa gter gzhung ltar glud kyang tshan pa bcu gnyis dang*/ chog bsgrigs bzhin la ngar glud tshar gsum gyis 'thus shing*/ glud rdzas ting lo dpal 'bar changs bus brgyan pa yang bsham/ dur rdo gsum mam ri gnyan gsum nas btsal ba'i rdo la thod skam bris pa'i sgyed pu'i steng du lcags slang du drag shing gis me hom gru gsum brtsegs/ byad ma'i liṅga dug shog la bris pa'am zan ling rkyang pas kyang rung*/ mdun du bsgrub bya 'god yul stan nag chos 'byung gis mtshan pa bcas/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rdzas mtha' dag kyang mngon par 'du byas la/ /dngos gzhi bdag bskyed gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa/ gnas gsum ḍāk+ki'i bka' rgya ma ltar gzhung bsrangs la/ bdag nyid dang zor gtor bskyed bzlas rtsa sngags dang*/ sgrub sngags bcas grub nas/ zor las la dmigs nas yang bzlog ni/

spyi bor aḥkaḥ mgrin par saḥmaḥ snying khar raḥtsaḥ lte bar shaḥdaḥ gsang bar raḥsaḥ brla g.yas su maḥraḥ brla g.yon du ya phaṭḥ ces bkod pa ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro phra men shugs 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying drag tu bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa drag tu khol zhing phyur ba las srid gsum thams cad drag sngags thog rgod kyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsregs bcom rjes shul med par brlag /slar yang thugs rje'i shugs las bskal ba'i 'thor rlung g.yos pas 'dzin snang bag chags dang bcas pa dbyings su gtor te sbyang*/ snang srid thams cad khro mo'i sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i rta bros gzir bas dgra bgegs byad gdon log 'dren thams cad nam yang ldang med thugs rje'i dbyings su rgyas btab par mos la/ a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ ces ci mang dang/ yang bzlog go ldog ni/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ kham̐ e ka tsa na e sa bh+yo zlog: ram̐ dza tri mun tri rmug thum bh+yo zlog: yam̐ sha ma sha na du shan bh+yo zlog: ces bzlas mthar thun rdzas la yang bsngags/ hūm̐: rang nyid khyab bdag bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su: dgra bgegs byad ma'i yul mkhar mngon du gsal: rig sngags dmod pas gnam sa brdab pa'i tshe: dgra gdon phye mar rlog cig mā ra ya: las ngan bag chags gtor cig hūm̐ yaṃ phaṭḥ lhag med dbyings su bstab bo satwaṃ bha ya: 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor cig a a āḥ zhes thal rdeb bya/ tsha nag la dmigs te/ tri dzaḥ snang srid 'jig rten phung rdzas dregs pa'i dpal: phung 'dre byad gdon rbod gtong 'dus pa'i srog: ngan sngags dmod pa nag po'i ri bo la: dmod cing gzir mnan nus rtsal rdzogs par gsal: sha da ra sa ma ra ya bha bi na a ri sha bar wi thun thun dza dzaḥ

zhes phung rdzas byad kyi ri bo nad mtshon dug rlangs gtibs pa'i klong las dregs pa'i srog yig 'byung lnga pa so so'i kha dog gi zer zhags snang srid kyi khyon gang bar 'phros pas bdag gzhan phyi nang 'byung lnga'i byad rgyar chud pa'i drwa ba thams cad gru gu 'thor ba ltar bsdus te tsha nag dang tshon skud kyi drwa bar thim par mos la/ sngags stong phrag gcig tsam du bzlas/ tsha dkar la dmigs nas/ thabs mchog srid pa'i hom chung bsil ba'i 'od: shes rab bh+yo yig zung 'jug 'khrul 'khor gyis: ye shes lha mo seṅge'i gdong can dkar: gcer bu rgyan med gzi 'od bkrag mdangs 'bar: phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum bzang chu rgyun 'bebs: 'khor 'das dmod pa'i rig sngags byad zor sogs: nyes tshogs drungs nas 'byin pa'i mthu ldan gyur: a ka sa ma ra tsa phaṭḥ e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: zhes ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa thugs rje'i 'od zer dkar la reg na bde ba'i bdud rtsi rang bzhin can steng 'og khor yug mu med du 'phros pas snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum byad grib kyis 'thum pa'i nyes tshogs thams cad sbyangs nas lus shel sgong g.ya' bral ba lta bur dga' bde'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs te snang stong lha sku'i rol pa chen por mos la sngags stong phrag las mi nyung ba bzlas pa'i 'phang hom tsha nag byad kyi ri bo dang*/ mda' hom tsha dkar ye shes 'khor lo chabs cig tu sgrub la stong tshig 'bul/ mdun bskyed khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu bum pa la dmigs nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon rtse las: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: mchod yon me tog bdug spos dri: mar me dri chab zhal zas bshos: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: blo yis sprul lam lhun gyis grub:

t-ing 'dzin mnyam med chen por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bya: mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang? om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma āḥlas zla ba ste gdan sum brtsegs kyi dkyil 'khor steng du baṃ dmar po tāṃ ljang gu mūm̐ dkar po ste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las/ bskyed pa'i rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs can: g.yas zhal gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkar mo 'dzum bag dang ldan pa: rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma sgrol ma ri khrod dgyes mar bzhad ma: g.yon zhal dmar mo rdo rje khro gnyer can mche ba gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gdugs dkar dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin ma bar ma gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thogs ma: mtha' ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'geng ma: dbu la rin po che rgyan drug gis spras ma shing lo'i cod pan rab tu g.yo ma: sku stod la dar ljang gi yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan drug gis spras ma sku smad dar dmar gyi ang rag gsol nas zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis bzhugs: ma sku la ye shes kyi 'od zer dang me dpung 'bar mas bskor bas bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bar gcod ma: khor yug tu gdugs dkar lha mo nyer gcig: rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi gnas nyul bye ba 'bum sde: steng du gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba la: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa ltar: snang la rang bzhin bral ba'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐:

rang bzhin rtogs med dbyings nas mkha' 'gro ma: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dpa' mo'i tshul: 'phags ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan drangs dbyer med bzhugs par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: a be sha ya ā a swa tī sarba satwaṃ: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal zhing : hūm̐: ye shes pho brang nyams re dga': pad+ma dri med mdangs dang ldan: nyi zla spel ma 'od re gsal: thabs shes spel ba'i khri 'phang mtho: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho dgyes par bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis lha phyag 'tshal: dam tshig gdung bas rab tu 'dud: om̐ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje gtum mo g.yul las rnam par rgyal: sha za 'bar ma gnas nyul ma mo 'bum: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la: mchod yon 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi 'bul: bzhes nas dug mtshon byad zor zhi bar mdzod: zhabs bsil dag gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan 'bul: bzhes nas 'byung ba'i byad zor zhi bar mdzod: me tog sna tshogs yid mtshar dpag med 'bul: bzhes nas me chu'i byad zor zhi bar mdzod: dri bsung phyogs bcu'i zh-ing khams kun khyab 'bul: bzhes nas rig sngags byad zor zhi bar mdzod: snang gsal nyi zla gzi 'od 'bum 'khyil 'bul: bzhes nas gtad khram rbod gtong zhi bar mdzod: dri chab sman mchod ngad ldan gtams pa 'bul: bzhes nas sngon las byad zor zhi bar mdzod: zhal zas bcud bzang ro brgya'i dpung 'khyud 'bul: bzhes nas 'phral rkyen byad zor zhi bar mdzod: sgra dbyangs theg chen chos rnga 'bir ba 'bul: bzhes nas pha rol byad zor zhi bar mdzod: om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes lta na yid sdug tshul bzang 'bul: bzhes nas rgyal po'i chad pa zhi bar mdzod: sgra snyan gar ma sgeg mo dbyangs can 'bul: bzhes nas mi kha dmod tshig zhi bar mdzod:

dri mchog sman spos sbyar ba'i ngad ldan 'bul: bzhes nas chom rkun 'jigs pa zhi bar mdzod: ro mchog sna tshogs byed las rnam 'phrul 'bul: bzhes nas zas ngan dug sbyor zhi bar mdzod: reg mchog lha yi yug gos sna tshogs 'bul: bzhes nas reg dug mdze lhog zhi bar mdzod: phyag rgya gsum ldan chos kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas bsam sbyor ngan pa zhi bar mdzod: ma nges mchod sprin gling bzhi'i khyon bkang 'bul: bzhes nas 'khor 'das byad zor zhi bar mdzod: om̐ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she dharma dhā tu pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye swā hā: bstod pa bya ba ni: om̐: ye shes lha mo 'od rab 'byin: nyon mongs kun las sman pa mchog: sdug bsngal nad las grol mdzad ma: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren: mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing : nyon mongs sgrib pa sbyong mdzad pa: rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bstod: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od: lha mo'i sku yi gzi brjid kyis: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags dang : dug dang nad mtshon chu la sogs: pha rol rgol ba'i byad gtad rnams: lha mo khyed kyis zhi bar mdzod: de nas rig sngags bzlas pa ni/ gzung thag blangs la/ gtso mo'i thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje gsum mtshon rgya gram 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du nyi dkyil la baṃ yig dmar po'i mthar/ badz+ra mūm̐ ka ra'i sngags phreng dmar nag me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba g.yas su 'brug stong ldir ba ltar drag tu 'khor shing baṃ yig lte bar zla gdan la mūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sngags phreng dkar gsal 'od zer 'bar ba g.yas su 'khor ba mūm̐ gyi khong seng du dwangs ma lnga ldan gyi 'od gur 'khyil ba'i nang du tāṃ yig ljang gsal ring cha tsheg drag rtsal dang bcas pa'i khong seng nṛ yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar/ pi sha tsi'i sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor zhing*/

srog yig gsum po gcig nang gcig zhugs kyis sngags phreng so sor bskor bar bsam/ om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba u pa smra ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā: zhes pa bzlas pas/ bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed tām̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad de gsal brtan thob pa dang : de las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod: thugs rje'i byin rlabs bsdus bdag gi nus stobs bskyed gzi byin cher 'bar bas: 'od kyi dkyil las mūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer gyi rdul ltar lnga ldan gsal la 'tsher ba: ka gdung tsam dang nyi zer grangs med 'phros pas snang srid 'byung lnga'i byad 'dre gtad bdag thams cad ldang med du mnan cing : tsha zer rno ngar kyis lus srog dum bu stong du gas pa'i khong snying nas: bsgrub bya'i bla tshe srog rten thig le dkar po dngul chu'i mdog ltar 'tsher ba 'od kyis sbu gus 'ub 'ub drangs te: srog rten nṛ yig la drangs pas bla tshe nyams pa thams cad sor chud srog mi 'gyur mi shigs pa'i ngo bor gyur par mos la: om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba u pa smra ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā: om̐ sarba uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi ma le: pra t+yam̐ ghṛr+ṇa bir+ṇa tsakra na maḥ sa mān+ta a dzi te: dz+wa la te dz+wa pra dz+wa la: khan+dha khan+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ om̐ dzam+bha ni: satwaṃ bha ni: laṃ bha ni: mo ha ni: ha ha phaṭḥ he he phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ da ha pa tsa phaṭḥ ma tha ru na phaṭḥ shri gh+ri badz+ra sarba ka ri hūm̐ druṃ: hriṣ+ṭaṃ kriṣ+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces btags la bzla/ de ltar gsal brtan du gyur pa dang thugs srog sngags phreng nang rim bzhin ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pas/ thugs rje'i gzi byin ches cher 'bar ba'i shugs kyis baṃ mthar sngags 'khor ba las/ 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa dus mtha'i zhugs me lta bu 'khor ba ltar 'phros pas sku'i cha thams cad nas/

me zer gnam lcags thog gi bu yug 'tshubs pas/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs khro bcu sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa rnams kyang*/ sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug stong ltar ldir zhing*/ rig sngags dmod pa'i stobs bskyed pas stong khams tshwa zer dang mtshon cha'i char gyis gang bzhin drag tu 'khrugs pas/ pha rol byad zor rbod gtong gtad 'dre thams cad gzhob tu btul zhing*/ snod bcud 'byung ba'i gzhi 'dzin gnam sa rus sbal kha sbyor gyi rnam par 'khod pa'i 'og nas/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre sa bdag klu gnyan sde rigs dang bcas pa 'jig rten gnyis med du gnas pa la/ ye shes thugs rjes phyag rgya mi 'gyur mi shigs pa mkha' 'gro'i srog yig dgu dgus/ rab tu mnan cing rgyas gdab pas srid pa'i byad gdon gang gis kyang 'da' ba mi nus par dam tshig shugs la gnas pa'i nges shes brtan pa'o/ gong sngags dang*/ badz+ra mūm̐ kā ra: badz+ra bai ro tsa na: badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra ma tri ṇi phaṭḥ badz+ra sa ma ya phaṭḥ badz+ra sa ma ye phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra ra tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ta tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ko au ma ri kun lan+dha: badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha bh+yo bh+yoḥ badz+ra na mo dha ra ya: baṃ ka ra phe ka ra bh+yo bh+yoḥ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang byad du bcug pa khrol khrol: mnan pa dang bskrad pa dang gzir ba dang dmod pa dang mu stegs kyi ngan sngags: ban bon gyi hom sbar sogs gnod pa thams cad shig shig 'ur 'ur om̐ badz+ra me thun satwaṃ bha ya byer byer: hrī karma ku ru kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rig sngags gsum dril brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzla zh-ing thun mtshams su/ hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed yum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'dzab kyi phrin las bskul phyir mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos sgrub stsol ba'i phyir: ye shes lha mo'i tshogs la bdag bstod do: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

'dod don gsol ba ni/ na mo: 'phags ma bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dus 'dir bdag la nye bar dgongs su gsol: thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i 'od zer gyis: 'gro rnams skyong zhing byang chub lam la 'god: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: 'dul bya mthar phyin mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi: tshe rabs las kyi bag chags sdig sgrib dang : nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor rba rlabs gzhom du gsol: gnas skabs nad gdon dgra bgegs glau bur rkyen: dug mtshon me chu byad zor 'jigs pa brgyad: bdud kyi cho 'phrul yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams: thugs rje dpung gis ma lus zhi bar mdzod: ces gzhol zhing*/ lha rnams 'od du zhu nas 'khor lo dang bum chur dbyer med du gyur par mos la/ om̐ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa uṣ+ṇi ṣa: a na le bhi shud+dhe: bai ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa mā ya: badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la: sarba pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri: u pa dz+wa la pra sha bī ma tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab tu gnas so/ gsum pa ni/ gtad sprug nag po'i 'khor lo me long gi ngos su 'char ba bya zhing sngags 'di brgya tsam bzlas nas las bum chus khrus bya/

om̐ badz+ra bi dho bi dho bhi dza ya: a dzi ti ma a par dzi te: ma ma tshin+dha ya ha ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang bcings pa thams cad khrol khrol shig shig sarba nā ga hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ku lu mi li tsi lu: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri: sarba u pa dhe sha: bhur+khung ma hā pra ma ṇa ya: bhur tsi bhur khi bhi ma na se u tsuṣ+ma a kro te hūm̐ phaṭḥ pha rol rig sngags kyis byad du bcug pa dang mnan pa bcings pa bskrad pa gzir ba thams cad: byer byer khrol khrol shig shig: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: sarba tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa sarba maṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ yan byas/ rtsa gsum dril ba'i gzungs ring dang nye snying*/ om̐ badz+ra bi dho bi dho bhi dza ya: a dzi ti ma a par dzi te ma ma tshin+dha ya ha ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa'i mthar khrus chu rnams bum par blugs/ chos srung gi bskang gso sogs spyi 'gro lta bur bgyid/ tshogs mchod bskang ba yan grub nas/ de nas dngos gzhi las la sbyor ba ni/ bsgrub bya stan nag chos 'byung gi mtshan pa'i khar bzhag la/ byad thag gis bcing*/ slob dpon gyi mdun byad thag gcod byed ral gri sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bsags la/ zhwa chos dang bcas/ ma gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub par byed pa la/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di nyid la rag las shing*/ de'ang rnyed par dka' la 'bral sla ba 'chi rkyen rags shing 'tsho rkyen nyung ste/ gling gzhan rnams kyi mi lus rin po che la ni tshe tshad nges pa can yod pa dang*/ rang cag dzam+bu gling pa rnams la ni tshe tshad nges pa can med cing*/ tshe'i dbang skal ji tsam yod pa de'ang gnas skabs 'phral rkyen dam sri 'byung po gdug pa can rnams kyis tshe rku ste 'khyer ba dang*/

'phrog ste khyer ba dang*/ bcom ste 'khyer ba sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu yang mang la/ khyad par sngags pa nang gyes pa dang*/ phyogs kyi gzhan mthus bskul ba dang*/ mi chen drag rim rnams mtho gnon chags sdang gis nye bar bskul ba'i/ ban bon mu stegs ngan sngags mkhan gyis mthu gtad zor gsum gyi sbyor bas/ rnal 'byor pa'i mi nor phyugs zhing yul mkhar gnyen srid dang bcas pa/ byad du gzhug cing ngan sngags kyi dmod pa 'dor ba dang*/ phur pa'i dbal gsor ba/ mtshon zor gyi rno brdeg pa sogs bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rten 'brel stobs su smin pas/ mi rnams tshe thung zhing bu tsha dang rigs rgyud mi 'phel/ mi kha dang gshe skur sdang*/ nor rdzas la gtor brlag mang*/ sgo phyugs la god yams ldang*/ khyim du dbul 'gong 'tshang ba dang*/ zas kyi bcud nyams/ gdong gi bkrag shor/ gos kyi mdangs yal/ yul gyi bcud nyams pas ri la rtswa mi skye/ lo tog la 'bu srin dang sad ser sdang*/ med snang dang ltogs snang 'char/ nad kha dang rims kha zug /'phung gyod dang kha mchu mang*/ yan lag zha rengs dang*/ ngag lkugs/ lces lab mi shes par skrang ba dang*/ og ma mgul pa 'gags nas na ba dang*/ sngags bgrang mi shes pa dang*/ bgrang yang sgra mi dag pa dang*/ gdong sbos pa dang*/ so na ba dang*/ lce la phur pa btab pa rmis pa dang*/ chos po ti dang mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan pa dang*/ dong gting ring du tshud pa dang*/ re ba nag pos btums pa dang*/ mun pa nag po'i phug tu tshud pa dang*/ brag phug khang stong yul stong du slebs pa dang*/ gcig nas gcig la 'dzul ba dang*/ khang stong rdib la khad kyi nang phyin pa dang*/ zam pa dang lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du nyal ba dang*/ ri rong dog po'i rtse nas rbab tu lhung la khad pa dang*/ ro khur ba'i gling du phyin pa dang*/ lha khang dang lder bzo 'gul ba/ gos mi gtsang ba gyon pa/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab tu phyin pa dang*/

nad pa lkug log pa dang*/ mtsho dang chu mig na gling gi 'dam rdzab dang*/ grog rong chen po'i gting du tshud pa dang*/ chus khyer la khad pa dang*/ ri nyil ba dang 'ja' tshon zug pa dang*/ brag khung gting ring du tshud pa dang*/ rdo'i char babs pa dang*/ thog dbab pa dang*/ sngags bon gyis bskor ba dang*/ mi ngo ma shes pa dang*/ mon pa dang*/ a tsa ras rang la gri mdung rgyab pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang*/ ri gzar nas rdo byung ba dang*/ gcan gzan dang bya nag gis bskor zhing ded pa dang*/ bud med mang po dang*/ mdzo dang bong bu dang*/ dre'u sogs la sga stong gtad nas rang gi sgor nyal ba dang*/ dmag gis bskor ba sogs rmi ba dang*/ dngos su'ang rang nyid nyams shed chung ba dang*/ khro zhing tshig pa za ba dang*/ snying mi dga' ba dang*/ lus lci ba dang*/ 'thibs pa dang*/ shes pa rnal du mi phebs par yed yed pa dang*/ mi la 'thab 'dod pa dang*/ ca co 'bog snying 'dod pa dang*/ nang du 'thab mo mang ba dang*/ bskyed rim mi gsal ba dang*/ sgrub pa byas kyang chad lhag mang zhing nus pa zhan pa dang*/ ltas ngan gyi sems can sna tshogs byung ba dang*/ rang gi gos la don med gris rma byung ba sogs/ rtags de rnams byung na pha rol gyi mthu kha zug pa'i ltas yin pas/ de lta bu'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bshig cing 'grol bar byed pa la/ gang las byung ba brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po gang nas byung na sngon rgya gar bha ga la'i rgyal po a shwa ka zhes pa la mchod gnas mu stegs pa bhi ru sha bya ba nang pa'i chas su ste: rgyal po'i pho brang rdo bcal mthil du 'khar gsil gyi kha ru rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs par skad: de'i zhogs la rgyal po'i pho brang rtse nas khrus byas te gzigs pa dus mnyam du gyur: blon po rnams kyis pho brang rtser spyan 'dren zer: blon po'i kha bzhin rgyal po yang ya mtshan skyes nas zhabs tog bsgrubs nas bla mchod bgyis pas:

sras mos de'i 'thad rmi ltas la legs tshogs kyi rgyur mthong : mu stegs de kha che ho phen ta bya ba'i bla mchod yin te: nang pa'i rgyal sa bcom la mngags pa'o: zla ba bdun gyi ring du mu stegs rlung gi spu gri klu nā ra chu 'thung bsgrubs nas grong khyer 'bum tsho bdun liṅgar bkod pas: rgyal po rmi lam 'khrugs pa'i tshe nyin gcig rgyal po pho brang shar phyogs logs kyi ri siṅga la mthong ba'i rtser bud de bltas pas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas sprin nag po zhig byung nas de'i nang du: mu stegs phra man ral pa dmar ser yod pa ma he nag po la bzhon nas lag tu thog ser gyi sgrom bu tshwa tshwa khol ba zhig 'brug sgra ha cang che ba dang bcas byung bas: rgyal pos mu stegs kyi byad kha zhig yin nam bsams te cung bred pa dang nang du log par chas nas o rgyan la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i mod la: siṅga la nas 'ja' dmar ser zhig lhag ge shar ba'i steng du gu ru nyi ma 'od zer mngon sum du mdun du byon: khyod bred mi dgos gsungs nas mdung rtse gsum pa de'i phyogs su gdeng bas 'brug gi skad chags mu stegs kyi dmu rtsa mo de shin du bred te rang log tu song : rgyal pos gsol ba lan bdun btab pa dang : lung bstan te sang nyi ma rtse shar gyi skabs su khyod kyi sras mo lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron gdams ngag len du thongs shog siṅga la'i brag phug rasmi ko ṭi la'o: de ltar ma bgyid na: mu stegs bhi ru shas khyod kyi mnga' thang stong nges so: zhes sgra de thos ma thag tu nang du log pas: mu stegs pas rgyal po byon pa'i shul du ri rlung thams cad byad kyi gtad bkram nas rang yul bros thabs kyis song ngo : rgyal pos phyi bsnyags pas rting ma zin par gyur to: phyi nangs snga zhogs rin chen gsal sgron bya ba de rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sprul pa mkha' 'gro seng gdong gi rnal 'byor ma yin pas:

rgyal pos rin chen sna tshogs maṇ+ḍal bskur te: khol mo zhig bcas siṅga lar brdzangs: rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer mjal maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab: slob dpon la zhus pa: kye hoḥ mu stegs bla mchod bgyis nas ngan sngags mthu dang 'grogs: mchod gnas brtag gzhig med pas bar chod bdud kyis bslus: rgyal sna blon gyis bsgyur bas phung gtad sa gzhi gang : gnod rdzas phug tu bzhag na god kha rgyun mi 'chad: mi ngan grogs su bsten na gtam ngan rgyun mi 'chad: rdzas ngan lus la btags na dri ngan rgyun mi 'chad: phung shig yul la gtor na 'thab rtsod rgyun mi 'chad: des na nged kyi rgyal po blon 'bangs la: zhang zhung ngan sngags mkhan gyis tshad btsugs pas: dam pa rig 'dzin nyid kyis rjes bzung nas: 'di las grol ba'i gdams pa stsal du gsol: ces zhus pas gu ru'i zhal nas: lha lcam rin chen gus pas rtser son la: khyod nyid rgya gar ḍāk+ki'i gnas mchog tu: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chas 'dzin nas: lo ma mun pa'i nags la gnas pa'i tshe: g.yul las rnam rgyal 'bar ba zhes su grags: res 'ga' sha za mo yi cha lugs 'chang : gdams pa 'di ko 'od zer dpal mos 'chang : zhag gsum bsgrubs nas rgyal blon 'bangs rnams la: khrus bstsal dbang bskur srung ba 'di ltar 'chang : yul gru sa gnad ri mtho skyed mos tshal: byad du gang bcug gzungs chus 'khru bar gyis: lha khrus gtsang khrus byad khrus rnam pa gsum: 'grub par bgyis na grol nges the tshom med: byad kha rig sngags kho rang steng du 'gro: lha 'dre mi 'khu bar chad sel bar byed: klu gtad nag po'i shog bu rul ba'am: byad khang nang du sdod kyang ya mi nga : de bas gud du sbos shig sa ma ya: khyod kyis gdams pa 'di ri ri dhi pa la sprod nas dbang lung bgyid de rgyal po'i mchod gnas gyis: zhes gsungs shing man ngag de lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron la gdams pa bzhi skor shog dril ma bu gsum bgyis nas snyan brgyud gter rgya gnyis yod pa:

gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi them med skor ro: sa ma ya: de ltar gu ru'i bka' bzhin rje'i drung du zhag gsum bsgrubs pas dngos su yi dam gyi zhal gzigs: gsang mtshan la lha mo 'od zer can btags: rjes byin rlabs dang rab tu gnas nas rgyal po'i rang yul du brdzangs: rgyal po la sngar bzhin rje'i zhal gdams bshad pas shin tu dad pa thob: sras mor phyag 'tshal khri brtsegs nas khri gdan kha ru bzhag: yul der bram ze ri ri dhi pa zhes bya nags la gnas pa spyan drangs: rgyal po dang drang srong nang blon rnams la rin chen gsal sgron gyis gdams pa byin: de'i tshe drang srong bla mchod bgyis: rtag tu phan pa'i srung ba btags: lha lcam dang drang srong dpon slob kyis byad zor zlog pa'i lag rdeb yi ge bcu bzhi dang gdugs dkar g.yul bzlog sngags phra men ma tri ma'i sngags sbrags pas: kha che'i grong khyer bdun stong nus pa'i gdeng tshad thob: des mu stegs pa'i dmag byad zor thams cad rgyal po'i mnga' 'og lo stong phrag bdun la mi 'byung ba'i rten 'brel byung : de nas slar yang siṅga la bha ga la sham+bha la bcas gsum la gu ru nyi ma 'od zer rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs rgyal pos pho brang du gdan drangs: lha lcam rin chen gsal gyis brtsams pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi phung po bsam las 'das pa phul: rgyal po smon lam bzang pos rgyud smin par mdzad: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer dang lha lcam rin chen yab yum dur khrod so sa gling du spyod pa la gshegs nas lo gsum bzhugs: slar rin chen gsal siṅga la'i shar phyogs shrī bha tra'i gnas la spyod pa la gshegs: lhar skye ba'i tha ma bod khams kyi dpung gnyen du 'byung bar lung bstan pa'o: de ltar gsang ba'i man ngag gdams pa bzhi skor la shog dril ma bu gsum bgyis nas/ snyan brgyud dang gcig brgyud gter rgya gnyis yod pa las/

gcig rin chen gsal gyi sprul pa mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa shin tu zab pa rtsa ba gsum dril/ phra men zangs 'bar gdong gi bsad las gdugs dkar g.yul bzlog gi 'phang ba sogs: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i cha lag tu bsam yas mchims phu'i brag mar ke'u tshang du mi snang bar rgyas btab ste bzhugs pa la/ tshe lo nyi shu pa'i rtags dang 'dul zhing dus la bab pa'i tshe/ nges don rgyal ba sku gsum bdag nyid rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng dang dbyer med rung*/ drang don du gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che'i thugs rje'i rnam rol du byon pa/ rig 'dzin sprul pa'i skyes mchog o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i dam pa de nyid kyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi zab gter ji snyed cig spyan 'dren par mdzad pa'i nang tshan/ bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi yum bka' phrin las rab 'byams kyi cha lag /lha mo khro gnyer ma rtsa ba gsum dril gyi las tshogs mchog tu gyur pa 'di nyid la rgyud lugs dang*/ bram ze'i lugs kyang zer/ spyir ni bram ze'i lugs te/ rgya gar du nang pa rnams kyis bram ze'i rnal 'byor ma zer/ phyi pa mu stegs pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor grub thob ma zer yang*/ don la phyi nang gnyis ka'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa ste ri khrod mar grags so/ de nas nags ma'i khrod du bsgoms pa'i ming yin/ zas su 'tsho ba shing 'bras/ skom du ram shing gi khu ba/ gos su shing lo gyon cing*/ grub pa brnyes ma'o/ 'di ni 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i bar chad kyi rigs thams cad mthong thos dran reg dang*/ snying po bzlas pa tsam gyis mchog par 'gyur zhing*/ byad ma 'bum thub/ sngags pa khri thub/ mu stegs stong thub/ bsam gtan nyal chog gi gdams pa/ lha srin gdug pa kun sgrol ces shin tu dam lci'o/

gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos la/ zhi ba sbyin pa btang ba/ dmod pas rig sngags khru zhing phyi ba/ skyob pa'i srung ba 'dogs pa drag po zor 'phen pa sogs phrin las rnam pa bzhir 'gyed pa las/ thog mar las byed ma mo khrag ral ma'i rgyud nas byung ba phra men zangs 'bar gdong gi las tshogs/ sreg pa zangs sgrom dmar po'i sgo nas/ pha rol gdug cing sdang ba'i byad zor gyi bdag po thams cad rang gshed rang la phab ste/ tshar gcod pa mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las brtsam pa la/ rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag gis ji ltar dmod pa'i bden tshig de kho na bzhin du/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang sdang dgra gnod byed log 'dren thams cad dmigs yul du bkod la/ khyed shes kyi thugs 'dun mi g.yel bar mdzad par zhu lags/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos rdzu 'phrul drag mo'i sku: snang srid 'di ru gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral: nga nyid drag mo khros pa seṅge'i gdong : nga las che ba med do kun gyis nyon: maḥ nga nyid pho brang gnas chen u tsa la: dur khrod chen po rngams chen me 'bar rong : ri bo rus pa 'bab chu khrag dang zhag: rtsi shing thams cad mda' mdung mtshon cha gzengs: sgra skad thams cad rgyob sod 'brug ltar sgrogs: ro lang keng rus gcan spyang nyi li li: ngan sngags 'brug sgra gnam lcags sha ra ra: sha za srog gcod dbugs len rongs se rong : 'chi bdag phra men srog len zhungs se zhung : me 'bar mun rab sprin nag 'u ru ru: sprin gseb gnas nyul ma mo glog ltar myur: srid pa'i ri rab yom yom shig shig 'gul: de 'dra'i gnas nas bzhengs pa'i dbang mo che: che ba lha rnams thams cad nga yi 'khor: chung ba dregs pa sde brgyad nga yi bran: srid pa 'dir gnas nga yi las mkhan te: nga yis dmod pa'i las 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: phyi nang lha dang srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal: dbyings la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i lha tshogs rnams:
rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: kun kyang bdag nyid las bcol dpung la bzhengs: dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces phyogs bcur gtor/ hom bskyed pa ni/ phaṭḥ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma drag tu khros pa khro gnyer seṅge'i gdong pa can: shin tu gtum pa dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas srog gcod las kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing : g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum thog ltar 'bebs pa: zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas pa: mdun du phrin las kyi sprul pa drag mo lcags gdong nag mo gcer mo mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon nas nu ma gyen thor du 'khyil ba: phyag g.yas spu gri dang g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs kyi srog la dbang ba'i rnam par gsal: ma mo gsod byed ma'i g.yas g.yon du bya rog dang 'ug pa'i gdong can dgra bgegs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas thun nag po thogs pa: mdun du bla 'gugs kyi ma mo srog 'phrog gsum ni: dmar mo me mdog: sngon mo chu mdog: nag po mun pa'i mdog can thams cad kyi lag tu bla 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu: bla 'ching ba'i zhags pa: bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba: bla dwags kyi ring cha: bla 'bod kyi gri rkang : g.yab mo 'debs pa'i rnga ma dmar nag bcas thogs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: bh+yo ba singha ḍāk+ki kro ti kā li ma mo bh+yo bh+yoḥ a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ ma tri thun ma bh+yo dza: bh+yo trag rak+mo bh+yo bh+yoḥ kha la rak+mo e ka tsa ti bh+yoḥ kha khā hu lu ma mo bh+yoḥ tri dza tri dza baṃ shag byin tu bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo tri rak+mo dza tri ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ thun thun bh+yo bh+yoḥ o kaṃ shaṃ nṛ tri thun dza phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub hom khung nag po zur gsum kha dogs mthil yangs pa bang rim dgu kha khyer gsum dang ldan pa: kha khyer dang po la sgrol byed shan pa nag mo glog ltar 'gyu ba: gnyis par lha bdud nag mos gshin skad 'o dod drag tu 'bod pa:

gsum par bla 'gugs dus kyi pho mo srid gsum gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes skad cig la 'gugs pa: las kyi brub khung chen po de la mngon spyod kyi rtags kun tshang ba gshin rje'i bsad khang bdud kyi bsha' ra: sde brgyad kyi 'du sa: pho nya'i 'gyu lam: klu bdud kyi gre ba: gza' bdud kyi lto ba: srog gcod nyi khri dgu 'bum tshogs pa'i gling chen po: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i rnam par mngon sum du bkod pa'i mthil du: nṛ tri dmar nag gnyis las bskyed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs: byad ma sdig can de nyid lus sngo zhing ham pa mig shi mig can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: yan lag mya ngan gyi cha byad can la lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa: gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas phyur ba la grang dmyal brgyad kyi ngad dang ldan pas rab tu gzir nas smre sngags kyi keg bu 'don pa'i dbyibs su bskyed pa'o: bsad khang nag po de'i nang las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru 'tshubs pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba: bar du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa: logs na phrag dog gi thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: las kyi bdud mo dam sri ma dang mtshan mo rgyu ba: srod la nyul ba sreg ma 'phrog ma skem byed ma bcas bdud mo thams cad cho nge lhang lhang byed pa ste las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun? gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi? gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rig sngags kyi bdag mo khro mo rnams kyi? khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas:

ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la'i dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can: gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bh+yo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis: dgra lha dmu tsa mo rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i lha mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rigs sngags drag po 'di la brten nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma ming nas dmod de 'gugs pa'i las su bcol ba ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyen po gtor ba: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi brgyud 'dzin: dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos gral mtshon pa'i 'dus sde rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsug pa ya bor bzung ba do bsdo ba phod btsugs pa 'gran btsal ba mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba:

gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: tshe la bar du gcod par byed pa'i mtho gong nas brgal ba dma' chad du 'bebs pa: sde chen la gnyer ba: chu chen la sgug pa: zam chen nas bkag pa: 'phrang chen nas gcod pa: la so nas bsrung ba: lung gsum nas rku ba: sngon sgug rgyab 'ded byas pa: longs spyod za lam du dug 'debs pa: 'gro lam rkang zhabs su rtsang btsugs pa: shag ngan gyi sna 'dren byas pa: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: kha dar las 'jam pa: khog tsher las rtsub pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: dgra kha dang mi kha zug pa: nad kha dang yams kha rims kha 'tshub pa: bdud srin bgegs dang 'byung po byur yul khyad par du'ang dgra mgo thog nas bab pa: dgra ri rtse nas langs pa: dgra lung gsum nas langs pa: dgra mi chen nas langs pa: dgra yul mi nas langs pa: dgra mthun gsum nas langs pa: dgra pha spun nas langs pa: dgra khyim mtshes nas langs pa: dgra sgo them nas langs pa: dgra bzhi gshed nas langs pa: snga dgra yid la sems shing : da dgra thad nas langs pa: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: sgos dgra rbab ltar brgyugs pa: zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' dang dam las log pa la sogs khyad par gdug cing sdang ba'i ban byad bon byad skye bo'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor: yugs sa'i thal zor: rigs sngags kyi thun zor: zhang zhung gi mthu zor: la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byes gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la bkod pa bla shog bu la bris pa:

rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig: lha'i dkar byang la phob cig: btsan gyi dmar byang la phob cig: bdud kyi nag byang la phob cig: gshin rje'i khram byang la phob cig: tshe phyi ma la dus ma btab skye 'chi gnyis la khung ma g.yar: las kyi rnam par smin pas bkug ma dgos par gzugs liṅga 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya'o: pho nya 'gyed pa ni: dza bh+yoḥ snang srid bdag mo srog bdag har len mo: pho nya mi bsrun bdud kyi dbang mo che: nag mo srog la myur byed dus la bab: dam nyams byad ma'i bla srog khug la shog: keṃ keṃ me 'bar rtsar nas rgyug byed ma: dmar mo zangs 'phar gdong can dus la bab: byad ma'i bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: sngo dmar rlabs phyur 'phyo ma mun par gtibs: gcan spyang lag ring gdong can dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo bla 'khyams khug la shog: bh+yoḥ bla 'dzin lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: bla 'ching zhags pa nag pos sdoms la shog: bla 'dzin drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: bla 'bod gri rkang gling bus sdus la shog: phyags pa'i rnga ma dmar nag g.yobs la shog: ring cha tshon skud sna lngas sgril la shog: bla 'ded bya can rnams kyis chum la shog: dgra bo'i bla dwags ming byang 'di la phob: byad ma gdug pa'i bla tshe rten dang phrol: gzugs byang 'di la khug cig mā ra ya: tri tri nṛ tri aṅku sha ya dzaḥ thun thun ma tri ma tri dgra bo bla sha re ma tri thun dza dzaḥ bla 'gugs skabs dang bstun bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la: bh+yo dzaḥ mun pa nag po khā kha mu kha ma: dgra bgegs ban bon byad ma lha dang phyes: sdig can brnag pa'i dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha skyes lha phyes: dgra lha srung skyob ban bon rnams dang phyes: bh+yoḥ hu lu nag mo dug 'debs 'ug gdong ma:

ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra bgegs bdud dang sprod: dmigs pa'i byad ma 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: dmod pa'i dgra bo srog bdag bdud dang sprod: byad ma sdig can phung bdud nag por sprod: satwar thogs bdud kyi bu mo'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs lha dbye bdud sprod dus la bab: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: tri tri nṛ tri thun thun rbad nan: de nas phur pas gzir la mchod g.yog pas thun brdeg cing : dzaḥ las byed chen po dus la bab: dgra bo'i phung po bshig pa'i phyir: dmod pa nag po thun gyis brdeg: dzaḥ nyungs thun drag sngags dmod pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: dug thun smyo 'bog thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: chu thun sbos 'gad 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: khrag thun nad rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mtshon thun rno ngar zengs se zeng : dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mda' thun thog rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: gnam lcags phur thun hril li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka aḥ thun bh+yo thun bh+yoḥ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ las la khros pa'i sha za mo: phra men nag mo lcags gdong can: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams: yar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga yis: ye shes mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'chang bzung zlum skor chu srin kha: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: dbal so zangs gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i sgo dgur dzaḥkhraṃ ya: phyag g.yon gnam lcags mkhar phur bsnams: mar rtses dug gsum rtsad nas chod:

'chang bzung gza' bdud pho nya 'gyu: chu srin mtshon cha'i zi ra khol: zur gsum gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs: srog bdag ma gsum dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chod kyis: dbang po sgo dgur kī la ya: rtsa mdud lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: 'byung 'dus gzugs la kī la ya: pho rgyud mo rgyud kī la ya: rigs rgyud bcas par kī la ya: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud phung po shigs: mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra lo ka ma tri ya: sarba ka ra ti ka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: badz+ra kī li kī la ya: tri shu la dgra bo'i snying rtsa myog myog mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces gri gug snying khar gdab nas gnas spar ba ni: hoḥ rnam shes ngo bo āḥdakar de: phung po bshig nas klong du bstim: phaṭḥ lan gsum gyis spar: de nas spu gri sogs kyis: bh+yoḥ gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha char phab pas: ming shul tsam yang med par gyis: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: lha'am 'on kyang brlag par byed: bcad cing gtub pa'i dus la bab: gtubs nas rdo rjes gtun du brdung : rig sngags dmod pa'i byad zor rnams: phye mar shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badz+ra ka ra ti ka dgra bo gtub gtub: kha ra ka dgra bo shig shig: a yu dha dgra bo myog myog: badz+ra kī li kī la ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbad rbad nan nan chod chod bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ shog ling zan ling skabs dang bstun/ de nas me hom bskyed pa ni: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ mdun du drag po e'i me thab zur gsum pa kha khyer mtshon cha drwa bas bskor ba de'i dbus su ma bh+yo dzaḥ gsum las bskyed pa'i gru gsum du me sdig dmar po: chu'i sdig pa sngo nag: lcags kyi sdig pa sngon po: de'i dbus su khro mo za byed kha la rgyas 'debs ma lcags gdong nag mo zhal gdangs pa'i dbus su:

dug gi gdong can sdig pa kham nag lus thams cad gnyer mas gang ba mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa: lus thams cad mig gis gang ba zhal thams cad bar snang du gdangs pa: mche ba spu gris gtams pa'i so ltar gtsigs pa: lce hom gzar ltar dmar nag gnyis brkyangs pa ngo bo srid pa las kyi ma mo gnam sa sdig rgod 'bar ba ltar bskyed pa'i zhal du dgra bgegs byad ma pha rol gyis rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba'i ban bon byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa byad ma rang gshed phab nas zhal du gsol ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: bh+yoḥ za byed 'bar ba las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: gnam lcags sdig rgod 'bar ba zhal gdangs nas: dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed zhal du bstab: rigs sngags byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: om̐ badz+ra ma tri rak+mo bh+yo lo ha bhiṣatsha kha byad ma a pa ya mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas rigs sngags kyi mthu gtong ba'i ban bon byad ma rnams/ pho nya las kyi ma mos zhal du bstabs nas byad ma rang gshed phab par bsams la las mtha'i sngags 'bul ni/ dzaḥ 'joms byed chen po srog bdag ma mo gsum: dgra bgegs srog la dbang phyir hoṃ zhal phyes: dgra bgegs byad ma'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: srog bdag ma mo gsum gyi zhal du 'bul: om̐ ma tri ma bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi: om̐ dza tri ma bh+yo bh+yo dgra bo'i phung po lnga la kha kha khā hi: om̐ tri tri rak+mo kha la rak+sha bh+yo bh+yo: dgra bgegs kyi lha srung dang bcas pa kha kha khā hi: baṃ raṃ bh+yoḥ phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka a: ma tri lo ha kā li yak+sha pra mo mi mu: raṃ mu tsa dza bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog pha rol byad ma rnams dang rigs sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad nan brub: ruṃ ha la bhig nan thum thum myog myog rbad rbad:

ces pas phul/ shog ling yin na bsregs/ zan ling yin na gtub la/ dgra bo zhal du bstab pa kha sgyur yin: 'di gzhung bsreg gtor sbyangs bkrus gdams pa yin: de nas slob dpon bdud 'dul drag mo'i phyag gis gnam lcags kyi ral gri 'bar bas 'byung lnga'i byad thag gis bcings rgya rnams dum bur gtubs pas 'byung bzhi rang byung gi klong du thim zhing*/ dmod pa'i phung rdzas ban bon mu stegs byad ma mkhan gyi bla rten dang gnyis su med pa srog bdag ma mo 'bum gyi zhal du bstabs pas/ snang srid kyi byad zor phur kha ldang med ye shes kyi 'khor lor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ de nas tsha dkar byad thag bcad pa ni/ spu gri gri gug gang rung gis/ bh+yoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong mas: phyag na gnam lcags mtshon cha thogs: ban bon mu stegs dmod pa yi: snang srid yongs kyi byad thag chod: bh+yoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ om̐ sarba karma ṇi ka khor+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces byad kyi thag pa bcad/ de nas bsreg pa ni/ bh+yoḥ ma tri mu raṃ dza tri kha la shig sarba ka khor+dha raṃ raṃ ye swā hā: byad thag bcad cing hom du bsregs/ de nas dngos gzhi rig sngags kyis sbyor ba ngan pa 'khru zhing sbyang bar byed pa la/ 'byung ba phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen byed las mtshungs phyir/ pha rol dgra bo byad mas khyed rang rnams rig sngags kyi dmod las drag po byad du bcug pa la gnyen po'i gshed ma rang chas su gnad la dbab pa'i tshul ni/ 'phang hom gyi steng tsha nag byad kyi ri bo 'byung po'i bla rten nag po dang*/ mda' hom gyi steng du tsha dkar srid pa'i gangs chu ye shes 'khor lo'i chu rgyun lugs 'byung yas babs kyi rten 'brel ting 'dzin drag pos dmigs pa mi g.yel bar mdzad par zhu/ tsha dkar la khrus gsol zhing*/ bh+yoḥ ye shes seng gdong dkar mo yi: thugs kyi 'od zer bdud rtsi yis:

byad kyi ri bo nag po shigs: dmod pa'i phung shig nag po gtor: om̐ mu mu mu laṃ mu: saṃ dha mu: khaṃ mu: raṃ mu: yaṃ ye swā hā: khrus chu tsha nag gi steng du dbab la tsha nag byad kyi ri bo 'phung rdzas lhag rjes med par sbyangs/ de nas khyed rang rnams la rig sngags kyis 'khru zhing phyi ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par ye shes 'od lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ khro gnyer gtum mo ye shes kyi gzi 'od 'bar nas/ 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i byad zor mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad cig car sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sku las/ ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad thams cad rnag khrag /gdon thams cad srog chags/ byad grib thams cad 'ja' tshon sngo dmar gyi rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs sangs thon cing*/ lus shel sgong g.ya' bral ba lta bur gyur/ srid pa'i rus sbal kha sbyor gyis dbang bskur zhing byabs pas/ 'byung lnga'i gtad 'dre thams cad dmigs med du bcom/ rtswa mchog ku sha g.yab pas dug lnga'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa lhag med du phyags nas ngar glud la sib kyis thim/ lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin dar gyis phyis pas dug lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor rgyas thebs te phu+ung khams lha'i 'khor lo gsal rdzogs su gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba u pa smra ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā: badz+ra shwa dha shwa dha hūm̐ hūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta satwaṃ bha ya khrol khrol: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐: ha he badz+ra phaṭ swā hā/ om̐ sarba uṣ+ṇi ṣa bī ma le: pra treṃ gh+ri ṇa: bir ba tsakra na ma sa man+ta: a dzi te dz+wa la dz+wa la: pra dz+wa la khan+dha khan+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ om̐ dzam+bha ni: satwaṃ bha ni: laṃ bha ni:

mo ha ni ha ha phaṭḥ he he phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ da ha pa tsa phaṭḥ ma tha dhu na phaṭḥ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra sarba ka ri hūm̐ drun: hriṣ+ṭom̐ kriṣ+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra muṃ ka ra badz+ra bhai ro tsa na badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra ma tri ṇi phaṭḥ badz+ra ya ma ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ra tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ta tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ko au ma ri ku lan dha badz+ra singha mu ha hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra na mo dha ra ya baṃ ka ra phe ka ra bh+yoḥ gzhan gyis rig sngags dang byad du bcug pa khrol khrol: mnan pa dang bskrad pa dang gzir ba dang : dmod pa dang mu stegs kyi ngan sngags ban bon gyi hoṃ sbar sogs gnod pa thams cad shig shig 'ur 'ur: om̐ badz+ra me thun satwaṃ bha ya byer byer hri karma ku ru kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gzungs sngags kyis bsgrubs pa'i bum chus khrus bya zhing ngag tu blud/ de nas bum sgro'i dbus su tsakra 'khor lo bzhag pas byab cing*/ gong gi sngags sham du/ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad phyogs skyong dregs pa pho mo ma ning gi sde tshogs thams cad kyis byad du bcug pa dang : mnan pa dang : bsdams pa rig sngags kyi dmod las byad zor phur kha'i gnod pa thams cad shig shig khrol khrol: bhi dza ya ma hā bā la a dzi te tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces byab cing glud la bstim pa sogs bya/ yang dar tshon sna lngas phyis la/ gong gi sngags sham du/ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i? sogs bhi dza ya ma hā bā la a dzi te tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brjod la dar tshon gyi dbyi ba sogs lan grangs ci rigs mthar/ phyi ras dar tshon me hom du bsregs pa bcas yongs rdzogs grub nas me hom bshig pa ni/ hoḥ bsreg bya sreg byed rang bzhin me: dgra bo'i phung khams ma gtogs pa: pho nya mo rnams skye med hoḥ phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ sreg thal tsha nag rnams mthar chu chen du dor la/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mā ma kī:

'byung ba chu yi gsher brlan la: byad ma bsregs gtor bkrus nas su: skye med dag pa'i klong du thim: chu yis khyab pa'i sems can rnams: byad dang gtad las grol gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra dharma shud+dhe ye muṃ sa ma ya: mā ma kī ye swā hā: des 'byung ba gsum gyis gtor bsregs spur nas 'ja' yal ba ltar byad ma bcas rtsa med du btang bar bsgom: dmigs med cho rol ka dag ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes shes bya: de nas glud la chab bran dpal 'bar sbar la/ om̐ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan sna lnga dang ldan par gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis brlab/ rgyas pa gter gzhung ltar ram/ bsdu na/ hūm̐: snang zhing srid pa'i khams 'di na: ma gshin pho mo ma ning sogs: srid pa'i gdon chen bsam yas kyang : bdag dang rgyu 'byor 'khor bcas kyis: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i tshogs rnams la: 'dod yon yas glud 'di bsngos pas: tshe rabs lan chags sbyangs pa dang : dus kyi chad pa grol bar gyis: gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang : rig sngags dmod pas rbad pa sogs: 'dod yon glud 'dis 'khor bar gyis: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: phyin chad gnod pa ma mdzad cig: sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong : mkha' la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong : sa la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong : chu la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong : me la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong : rlung la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams:

glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong : rdo la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: rtsa rgyus glud 'di shing la gtong : shing la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: nang rol glud 'di lam la gtong : lam la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: pags pa'i glud 'di thang la gtong : thang la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: gos kyi glud 'di sprin la gtong : sprin la gnas pa'i lha srin rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di bzhes la: byad dang gtad las grol bar mdzod: snying rje'i sems dang ldan gyur cig: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yis: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a ā badz+ra mu swā hā: zhes hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang yungs thun kyis brab/ rol mo 'tsham rngam bcas ngar glud phyir rol du dor/ de nas zlog pa bya ba ni/ dar nag dang drag rol bcas/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig ma sring dbyings nas bzhengs: lha mo nyer gcig dbyings nas bzhengs: 'phags ma sha za chen mo bzhengs: khro gnyer rdo rje gtum mo bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mu stegs 'dul ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: dam sri sgrol ba'i mtshon cha thogs: mtshon cha rdo rje'i mda' thogs ma: 'bar ma rtse gsum thogs pa mo: g.yul las rgyal ba'i gdugs dkar 'dzin: sha za dgra satwa thogs pa mo: khro gnyer mche gtsigs zhags thogs ma: ma mo'i lus la gzi brjid 'phro: mo ni srid gsum g.yo ba mo: dug mtshon me chu'i byad kyis ni: 'jigs par mi nus gtum pa mo: nyid kyi sprul pa'i rol rtsal las:

gnas nyul phra men srin mo'i gzugs: srod la rgyu zhing sha la za: mu stegs khrag la dgyes pa mo: dzā phran chen mo'i dus la bab: srid pa'i ma mo glog ma sprin: dzā min gshin rje'i las byed ma: gsod la dga' zhing gcod la rngam: phyag na gnam lcags thog mda' bsnams: byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog: mo rgyud khro mo'i thun sngags zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar zlog: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad zlog: mu stegs rnams kyi ngan sngags zlog: sde brgyad dregs pa'i rbad 'dre zlog: lha srin yongs kyi rbod gtong zlog: drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa zlog: nag po klu la gtad pa zlog: sa bdag gnyan la bcol ba zlog: rig sngags zor kha 'debs pa zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' g.yos pa zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen langs pa zlog: dam sris phyi nang dkrugs pa zlog: phung sris kha gyod 'phen pa zlog: 'gong po'i rbab 'dre thams cad zlog: lo dang gza' skar mi mthun zlog: gshed bzh-is dur kha 'debs pa zlog: gzugs med gshin skad 'don pa zlog: dur nas bla 'bod byed pa zlog: srid kyi phywa g.yang nyams pa zlog: dbul sri phugs su tshud pa zlog: 'byung pos mgo skor byed pa zlog: than dang cho 'phrul 'gyed pa zlog: srung rta'i rgya ma chags pa zlog: sme ba rlung rta nyams pa zlog: pho skag mo la rtsub pa zlog: mo skag pho la rtsub pa zlog: che skag chung la rtsub pa zlog: chung skag che la rtsub pa zlog: rgas skag gzhon la rtsub pa zlog: gzhon skag rgas la rtsub pa zlog: nor skag mi la yo ba zlog: mi skag nor la yo ba zlog: rgyal skag blon la yo ba zlog: blon skag rgyal la yo ba zlog: rje skag 'bangs la yo ba zlog: 'bangs skag rje la yo ba zlog: dus skag nad skag 'chi skag zlog: tshe zad za 'grangs thebs pa zlog: brgyag dang gos grangs them pa zlog:

nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: dar sri gri sri thams cad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro dgra la bsgyur du gsol: pha rol byad ma sdig can gyi: rang mthu rang nus steng du zlog: dgra bo'i lha srung gshed du phob: sde brgyad za kha dgra la ston: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka aḥ e ka du ru bh+yo zlog: ma tri ya tri re ma tri bh+yo zlog: na sha tsa tu du ma ya āḥ trig khroṃ bh+yo zlog: ma ṇi ma ra bh+yo zlog: mā ra ya du bh+yo zlog: rbad sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: ha la ha la hal ta hal ta bh+yo zlog: sarba ka khor du mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces lag rdeb bcas grangs gsog la/ bye brag khyad par gyi las byad zlog sogs spros bcas dang ma 'brel tshe 'og gi gtor 'phang hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i? mthar 'phang la mnan pa dza bh+yoḥ rim pa dgu yi sa 'og l sogs kyis mnan pa'i rjes dbang la 'jug par bya'o/ /yang skabs 'gar byad zlog spros pa bya na/ ye shes pa nam mkhar gtegs la/ sde brgyad gser skyems sngon du 'gro bas/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug khros pa'i drag mo seng gdong ma: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro phra men tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mthu rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: om̐ ḍāk+ki singha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi: dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /'og min bsam yas gze rgyal gangs ra ru/

/sku gsum mkha' 'gro pad 'byung yab yum dang*/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog gter bdag gling pa yis/ /rgyud gsung gter la sbas dang gdan drangs tshe/ /dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dregs sde gter srung rnams/ /so so'i gzugs bstan khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ kro ta kro ti rā hu la ma tri shu la tsa tri nā ga ti pa ra tsa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ de nas gser skyems sngon du 'gro ba'i zor chen 'phen pa ni/ me hoṃ sbar zhing*/ gtor mar dpal 'bar btsugs la 'di skad do/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig mi mngon chos sku'i klong nas bzhengs: brgyud ldan rig 'dzin grub thob dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud 'dul gtso mchog seng gdong dbyings nas bzhengs: srog gcod ma mo mched bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: myur mgyogs khrag ral bdud smin dbyings nas bzhengs: bskal pa'i me 'bar dug mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs: dug rlangs bu yug 'tshub ma'i klong nas bzhengs: srog len mun ltar gtibs pa'i dbyings nas bzhengs: dam rdzas khrag mchod 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: sngags 'chang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig cing rtsad nas bcad: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad cing kha yog bkal: dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dkrugs dbyen phyung brtson: dge bcu khyad gsod mi dge dwang du blangs: mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: chos skyong sngags kyi srung mar do bsdo ba'i: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'dis: steng nas gza' nad char ltar 'bebs su chug: bar nas btsan gzer rlung ltar 'tshub tu chug: 'og nas rlung nad mun ltar gtib tu chug: bskul lo rbad do mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : g.yab bo chos shig sha za rtsal ma zhan: nyes can bstan pa'i ru tra nag po 'di: lo zla zhag dang za dus 'da' ma byed: da lta skad cig bla srog chod la shog:

pho rgyud rnams kyi sha zo khrag la 'thung : mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal skom skye rgyud chod: mthun grogs yul khyim rten gnas chags yul rnams: gnam lcags thog gis ri rab bshig pa ltar: thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ baṃ singha ḍāk+ki bai ro tsa na badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li ha ri ni sa ma mo rak+sha kha kha mu kha ru lu mu kha nag mo bhe tri nag mo dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ e sa bh+yo zlog:

ces zlog sngags dang bcas dgra bgegs byad ma'i phyogs su 'phang ngo*/ dmigs pa ni gtor ma gnam lcags kyi ri rab zur gsum pa rno dbal gdug pa'i mtshon 'debs pa'i shugs bcas ri rab mgo mjug ldog pa ltar 'phang bas/ pha rol byad ma'i yul zhing srung skyob ban bon mkhar khang dang bcas pa/ mgo mjug ldog nas thal me'i 'obs su chu blugs pa ltar phyur zhing brgyal nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom/ de nas sgo drung du brtan ma bshams la/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring chen mo'i tshogs: ma mo bcu gnyis sman phran bye ba 'bum/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tring tring spreng spreng kha kha khā hi/ mnan pa bya na bsreg ling gi thal ba cha gcig sgo drung ngam/ 'gyu lam lta bur dong brus pa'i nang du mnan pa la 'gugs gzhug dang bcas/ dza bh+yoḥ rim pa dgu yi sa 'og nas: sa srin nag mo lcam dral mas: lag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: srid pa las kyi kha gdangs nas: 'gyu byed dbal gyi lce rkyongs shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs khyod la gtad: zhal du bstabs nas kha bsdams te: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: nag mo ti pa sha ka li dung dung tri mun thun thun satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: zhes sa'i g.yogs la gnon/ rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐ maḥ kun gzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor du: phrin las gang 'dul brda 'gros yis: so so'i gar gyis bro brdungs pas: nga bdag mtshan ma'i ru tra bcom: gnyis med ye shes lhun gyis grub: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: ru tra nan: mā ra ya nan: laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: yang na me ro mnan pa ma byas par dgra phyogs su 'phang rung 'thus/ de nas nang du log / slob ma lhar bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma āḥlas zla ba ste/ gdan gsum brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ dmar po tāṃ ljang gu mūm̐ dkar po ste/ yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las bskyed pa'i rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs can: g.yas zhal gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkar mo 'dzum bag dang ldan pa: rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma sgrol ma ri khrod dgyes mar bzhad ma: g.yon zhal dmar mo rdo rje khro gnyer can mche ba gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gdugs dkar dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin ma/ bar ma gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thog ma/ mtha' ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'geng ma/ dbu la rin po che rgyan drug gis spras ma/ shing lo'i cod pan rab tu g.yo ma: sku stod la dar ljang gi yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin po che'i rgyan drug gis spras ma/ sku smad dar dmar gyi ang rag gsol nas zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyis bzhugs ma/ sku la ye shes kyi 'od zer dang me dpung 'bar mas bskor bas bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bar gcod ma: khor yug tu gdugs dkar lha mo nyer gcig: rdo rje'i pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi gnas nyul bye ba 'bum sde'i steng du gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba la: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa ltar: snang la rang bzhin dang bral ba'i skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ lha bskyed dang*/ hūm̐: rang bzhin rtog med dbyings nas mkha' 'gro ma: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med dpa' mo'i tshul: 'phags ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan drangs dbyer med bzhugs par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: a be sha ya ā a swa tī sarba satwaṃ:

zhes byin dbab la/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: rdzu 'phrul bum pa gzhal yas khang : rig sngags 'dzin ma sku gsum dngos: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dbang bskur de bzhin khrus bstsal nas: rdzas mchog ku sha'i rlung spros te: 'byung lnga lha mo'i sku phyis pas: byad gtad zhags pa khrol gyur cig: om̐ sarba bhi dha ya hūm̐: badz+ra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐: hoḥ khyed rnams la bum pas dbang bskur bas lus lha'i gzhal yas su tshud: khrus bstsal bas gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags sde brgyad kyi byad kha las grol: rtswa mchog ku sha g.yabs pas mthu gtad dang rig sngags dmod las gdug pa'i dbal kha la sogs zhi bar mos mdzod/ tsha dkar la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas byas la srung sgo'i steng du bzhag de nas sbrul nag po stong thub kyi 'khor lo spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur/ rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor brgyan/ hūm̐: rdo rje gcod pa'i ral gri las: 'phros pa'i rang bzhin steng 'og khyab: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bgegs dang 'byung po'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐: sbrul nag po stong thub kyi tsakra rdzas ldan lteb cing gri lcags kyi gwa'u'am thum pos g.yogs pa'am/ dar gyi thum du bsgril zhing dmigs bya'i lus la gdags/ bsgrub bya mang zhing tsakra mi lcogs tshe/ 'gyu lam zhig gi gong du bzhag kyang 'thus so/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ des khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs rgyud kyi byad kha/ slob dpon rgyud kyi byad kha/ pha mes rgyud kyi byad kha/ yul ris sa phyogs kyi byad kha/ tshe 'di'i mngon zhen mtho gnon gyi byad kha las gyur pa dang*/ phyag rgya las gyur pa dang*/ bsam gtan las gyur pa dang*/ sbyor ba las gyur pa dang*/ stobs las gyur pa dang*/ smon lam las gyur pa dang*/ rang bzhin las gyur pa dang*/ rang gi sbyor ba dang rang nyid la log pa sogs/

mdor na phra man ngan sbyor gyi byad gdon thams cad/ 'dod yon glud gtor gyi za kha khengs shing*/ skye ba dang tshe rabs kyi lan chags thams cad byang bas 'byung po'i za lam gtong ste/ pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rang log tu gyur pa/ bum pa'i dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas byad grib nyes tshogs thams cad sangs te lus lha'i gzhal yas su tshud/ dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi tsakras khyab cing*/ srid pa'i byad rgya thams cad ting 'dzin ye shes kyi sngags rgod drag po'i rgyas btab pas gtad 'dre byad gdon gdug pa'i lto ba dkrugs shing*/ tshe srog bla rten byad du bcug pa thams cad dbang med du skyugs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'byung ba'i stobs rtsal bskyed cing gzi mdangs 'bar/ lha mo lnga'i rang bzhin dar gyis phyis pas 'byung ba sor chud cing ye shes kyi 'khor lor rgyas thebs/ tsakra lus la bcings pas srid pa'i byad gdon phung 'dre gang gis kyang bltar mi bzod cing 'da' bar mi nus te/ srid gsum gyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid rtag brtan mi shigs pa/ rdo rje'i sku 'grub phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor 'di ltar sgoms 'tshal zhing*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs phung gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa che zhing brjid pa/ khro chu zhun ma ltar tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'phro ba'i lte bar/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag gcig tu sgoms/ rdo rje'i steng gi nam mkha' 'od snang las grub pa'i gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa la/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis bdud 'dul gyi rgya can srung skyob kyi tshul du gsal/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba go mtshams med par gtams pa las mtshon cha sna tshogs 'khrugs shing mched pas/ srid mtha' sdud pa rdo rje'i rwa gur gyi lte ba rnams su khro mo kha dog sna tshogs pas/ bh+yo bh+yo dang phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra bsgrags pas srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing ma rungs bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod:

ces brda sbyar la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro mas: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: gnyis med bh+yo dang phe ka ra'i: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: hūm̐ nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya phrag tsam bzla/ de nas bsgrub bya stan dkar g.yung drung gi mtshan ma can gyi khar bzhag la gos dkar bskon/ tshe dbang sogs grub na skabs 'dir bya/ om̐ ye dharmā sogs brjod/ de ltar gyur pa de nyid la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ spyan gzigs bde gshegs stong rtsas mnga' gsol ba bde legs bstsal de gnyis med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: ces me tog 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ byang chub snying rjer gshegs pa ni/ /sa rnams rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byad/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/ /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ brgya byin tshangs pa lha dang ni/ /'byung ba kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sems can byad las rab grol zhing*/ /nus pa mchog dang ldan gyur cig / ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ dam tshig bsgo ba ni/ de ltar byad khrol gyi dam tshig tu/ zhag bdun gyi bar 'khrig pa'i las dang*/ sha dmar sogs grib la 'dzem/ them skas rim pa bdun 'das nas mi 'bab/ gdugs dkar gyi gzungs khri rdzogs par 'don/ rtag tu srung 'khor lus drod dang mi 'bral/ gzhan dag la rku 'phrog mi brtsam/ yugs sa mor mi spyad/

dge ba can gyi thugs rgyud mi dkrugs pa sogs mdor na mi dge ba'i las rags pa mtha' dag spangs shing dge bcu dwang du len par bya'o/ zhes go bar bsgrag go /rjes kyi bya ba rnams mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya'o/ /lhag chad bzod gsol ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzla/ brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon 'gyur shog: a a āḥ bsngo smon bkra shis gzhung bzhin bya'o/ de ltar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun bklag chog tu bkod pa byad kyi sprin nag gzhom pa'i rdo rje'i 'thor rlung zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rig 'dzin chen po skyid grong thugs mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dgongs rgyan ye shes chu rgyun dang*/ byad khrol gser gyi lde mig bca' chog nag po phyag len 'gro shes su bkod pa thugs mchog rdo rje'i zhal lung*/ gang gi thugs sras kong smyon kra ti sngags 'chang gi mdzad pa'i bca' bsham zin bris rnams bsdebs shing*/ rtsa ba rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter gzhung byad khrol gser gyi lde mig dang*/ sregs pa zangs sgrom sog le dmar chung*/ bum sgrub khrus kyi rdzing bu sogs gzhan du zhal 'phang ba rnams dkyus su bcug /sogs khongs su bzhag pa rnams nar gyis bshangs te/ go rim 'khrugs bsdebs spyi dang mthun par byas te/ bklag pas grub par bgyis pa 'di'ang lugs 'di'i phyag len 'dra min rnams rgyun mi nyams pa'i ched du e wam̐ dpe skrun khang gis dpe bsdu dang nyams pa slar gso'i cha rkyen du dmigs te man+t+ra shā sa dhā ras bkral zhing gu h+yas sug bris su btab pas 'gro kun byad phur mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
// 'di nyid phyag rgyun mi nyams phyir dbang chog phyogs bsdus kyi khongs su bzhag pa yin no// //
